name: Riding Turtle
source: Dropped by Lunarfall Cavedweller in Lunarfall (Garrison). Dropped by Frostdeep Cavedweller in Frostwall (Garrison). / The Trading Post (seasonal)Cost: 600 / Trading Card Game: Saltwater Snapjaw from Heroes of Azeroth set. / "The great teacher of Azeroth school" promotion (China only). / The Black Market Auction House (rarely)
description: Originally obtained as rare loot from the Trading Card Game, this Riding Turtle can be obtained from the Trading Post during the month of September, 2026. This mount can also be found (rarely) on the Black Market Auction House, or as rare loot from Cavedweller murlocs in your Garrison's fishing pond in Draenor. The murlocs can be summoned with Lunarfall Carp (Alliance) or Frostdeep Minnows (Horde), which can occasionally be caught from the same pond once you advance your Fishing Shack to level 3.This turtle is one of only a few special mounts that can be ridden by level 1 characters without any riding skill. It will also increase your speed in water to that of a normal mount on land. It can be used in any body of water. Its speed is not affected by effects that increase or decrease mount speed.

description: In order to buy this mount your faction must be in control of Halaa, a PvP sub-zone of Nagrand in Outland. Otherwise the vendor is absent. Two different currencies are required for the purchase, Halaa Battle Tokens and Halaa Research Tokens.In Warlords of Draenor a large cache of these tokens (more than required for one mount) is given as the reward of a very rare garrison follower mission, Mysteries of Lok-rath.Otherwise you can earn your tokens by the traditional method: Halaa Battle Tokens are awarded for killing opposing faction players at Halaa (which can be painfully slow as the zone is no longer popular), and Halaa Research Tokens are obtained by farming Oshu'gun Crystal Powder (200 for 20 tokens) from the denizens of Nagrand and handing it in to an NPC when your faction controls Halaa.See also the Dark Riding Talbuk.

name: Vicious War Steed
source: Necrolord Sipe in Stormwind City. Cost: 1
description:
To purchase this armoured steed you must be victorious in a great many rated arenas or battlegrounds in a single PvP season. The procedure is as follows:

You must reach the PvP rank of Combatant. You can obtain this ranking by reaching a rating of 1400 by competing in 2v2, 3v3, or 10v10 arenas and battlegrounds.
Once you've reached Combatant ranking you must win further matches in the same season, until your progress bar reaches 100% (2400 points). You'll then receive the current season's mount (not this one).
For each subsequent time you fill your progress bar during the season you'll receive a Vicious Saddle, which you may use to purchase older Vicious mounts, including this one.
It appears the 1400 rating is specific to the match type you earned it in. For example, if you only earned the rating in 10v10 then you cannot progress towards the mount in 2v2 (until you also earn a 1400 rating in the latter).
The number of matches required to fill your progress bar depends on the type of match. According to comments on Wowhead, by Rainewater, you require 40 wins from 10v10 (60 points / win),  80 wins from 3v3 (30 points / win), or  240 wins from 2v2 (10 points / win).

This latter method is probably slower, but there's also a rare chance the murlocs will drop a Sea Turtle or Riding Turtle mount.Before the addition of Mount Equipment this mount was one of only two that were adept at water-walking. name: Vicious Kaldorei Warsaber
source: Necrolord Sipe in Stormwind City. Cost: 1
description:
To purchase this armoured warsaber you must be victorious in a great many rated arenas or battlegrounds in a single PvP season. The procedure is as follows:

You must reach the PvP rank of Combatant. You can obtain this ranking by reaching a rating of 1400 by competing in 2v2, 3v3, or 10v10 arenas and battlegrounds.
Once you've reached Combatant ranking you must win further matches in the same season, until your progress bar reaches 100% (2400 points). You'll then receive the current season's mount (not this one).
For each subsequent time you fill your progress bar during the season you'll receive a Vicious Saddle, which you may use to purchase older Vicious mounts, including this one.
It appears the 1400 rating is specific to the match type you earned it in. For example, if you only earned the rating in 10v10 then you cannot progress towards the mount in 2v2 (until you also earn a 1400 rating in the latter).
The number of matches required to fill your progress bar depends on the type of match. According to comments on Wowhead, by Rainewater, you require 40 wins from 10v10 (60 points / win),  80 wins from 3v3 (30 points / win), or  240 wins from 2v2 (10 points / win).

The Bloody Coins required to purchase this mount may be obtained by engaging in a special type of PvP:
You are awarded a coin if you get the killing blow on a PvP opponent while you are transformed into an Ordon Fire-Watcher.
To transform into an Ordon Fire-Watcher you need to purchase the item, Fire-Watcher's Oath, sold by Speaker Gulan on the Timeless Isle for 100 Timeless Coins. Timeless Coins are earned easily by killing NPCs/opening chests/performing various quests on the Timeless Isle.
The Fire-Watcher's Oath buff should work anywhere where PvP is allowed (including battlegrounds).
The  Censer of Eternal Agony (toy) can be used instead, but it has many downsides: its usage is restricted to the Timeless Isle, it has much longer cooldowns, and it debuffs the victim so that they won't grant more than one coin within a 10-minute period. On the other hand it allows you to kill members of your own faction who are similarly flagged, which the Fire-Watcher's Oath doesn't.

name: Vicious War Ram
source: Necrolord Sipe in Stormwind City. Cost: 1
description:
To purchase this armoured ram you must be victorious in a great many rated arenas or battlegrounds in a single PvP season. The procedure is as follows:

You must reach the PvP rank of Combatant. You can obtain this ranking by reaching a rating of 1400 by competing in 2v2, 3v3, or 10v10 arenas and battlegrounds.
Once you've reached Combatant ranking you must win further matches in the same season, until your progress bar reaches 100% (2400 points). You'll then receive the current season's mount (not this one).
For each subsequent time you fill your progress bar during the season you'll receive a Vicious Saddle, which you may use to purchase older Vicious mounts, including this one.
It appears the 1400 rating is specific to the match type you earned it in. For example, if you only earned the rating in 10v10 then you cannot progress towards the mount in 2v2 (until you also earn a 1400 rating in the latter).
The number of matches required to fill your progress bar depends on the type of match. According to comments on Wowhead, by Rainewater, you require 40 wins from 10v10 (60 points / win),  80 wins from 3v3 (30 points / win), or  240 wins from 2v2 (10 points / win).

description: The Challenger's War Yeti was the Silver Dungeon Challenge mode reward for Warlords.

name: Sunhide Gronnling
source: Dropped by Poundfist in Gorgrond.
description: This novel humanoid mode of transportation is one of six new mounts set to drop from rare, open-world NPCs in Draenor. The drop rate of the mount is 100% and guaranteed for every player who tags it.

name: Llothien Prowler
description: This sleek fox is the reward for completing an involved quest chain which begins when you receive a Torn Invitation. The chain requires you to complete several class hall missions, and then a final hands-on quest, Volpin the Elusive, in which you disrupt the fox hunt.The Torn Invitation has several sources, but the most common is chance loot from the "Nightfallen Hoard" cache which is awarded by completing four world quests for The Nightfallen when their emissary quest is available (see your Broken Isles continent map). Players are also reporting receiving the invitation from chests looted during the Withered Army Training Scenario. You will have to have progressed in the main Suramar quest chain for access to either of these things. The third reported source is from a chance class hall mission, but this isn't as well documented.

name: Garn Nighthowl
source: Dropped by Nok-Karosh in Frostfire Ridge.
description: Nok-Karosh, the source of this shadowy wolf mount, is not rare (it respawns frequently), but it currently takes a large party to defeat it and it only drops one mount per kill.

name: Bloodfang Widow
source: Sold by The Mad Merchant in The Toy Shop, Dalaran (Broken Isles). Cost: 2 000 000
description: This elegant, beautiful and creeeepy spider mount is sold by a vendor known as "The Mad Merchant" in Dalaran in the Broken Isles. The Mad Merchant isn't there all the time - he only appears in the The Wonderworks sporadically and reports between sightings range from a few hours to a few days! He seems to stay for about an hour before vanishing again.

name: Emerald Drake
source: Achievement: Awake the Drakes.
description: The Emerald Drake has made its debut in 6.0.2 as the reward for the drake mount collection achievement. A fitting tribute since, for a very long time, it was the last unavailable regular drake mount.

name: Chauffeured Mechano-Hog
source: Achievement: Heirloom Hoarder.
description: This mount and its Alliance equivalent - the Chauffeured Mekgineer's Chopper - are earned by completing an achievement to collect 35 different heirloom gear items. These mounts are special in two ways: they are usable by level 1 characters, and they come with chauffeurs. The Horde chauffeur is Koak Hoburn. Your character sits in the sidecar.The mount arrives in the mail once you complete the achievement. As the achievement is account-wide you will automatically receive the equivalent mount for your characters on the opposing faction.

The portal has multiple known spawn points (at least sixteen, perhaps more) across all zones, with the possible exception of Ashran. The portal leads to a mini-instance called The Edge of Reality, containing a dead NPC - The Last Voidtalon - and a single, lootable egg which teaches the mount. If there are complications and you can't enter the instance properly you should receive the mount in the mail.

Each gift costs 5 Merry Supplies, which is exactly the number you get from one day's worth of Winter Veil dailies. The dailies that award Merry Supplies are listed here.

 Explore Draenor
 Master Treasure Hunter
 Loremaster of Draenor orLoremaster of Draenor
 Securing Draenor orSecuring Draenor
 Tanaan Diplomat orTanaan Diplomat

name: Prestigious War Steed

description: This warhorse is the Alliance mount reward for a Legion PvP world quest meta-achievement, Free For All, More For Me, which involves completing each of four different PvP-related world quests 20 times each. You only need to complete this achievement once, as you will automatically gain the mount for the opposite faction. For the Horde mount, see the Prestigious War Wolf.

description: This bright dragonhawk is purchasable from Cupri, a vendor in Shattrath City in Outland, only present during Burning Crusade Timewalking Events. Purchase requires Timewarped Badges, which are earned by running Timewalking Dungeons during the events, with a bonus 500 by handing in a quest item which drops at the end of your first dungeon for the event.

name: Spirit of Eche'ro
source: Archaeology quest, Laying to Rest in Broken Isles.

This happens only rarely as there are at least thirteen different archaeology quests and only one is up in any two-week period, in an ordered rotation. The quest is offered by Dariness the Learned in Dalaran.The Spirit of Eche'ro flies as of Patch 8.1.5.

name: Felsaber
description: The Felsaber is the first class mount for Demon Hunters. They earn it in the starting zone, Mardum, after completing their first few quests.

description: This armoured infinite drake is a rare drop from any Timewalking dungeon boss during any of the Timewalking events. Check your in-game calendar for the next event period.

For more information on capturing the companion pet and starting the quest chain, see the well-written and detailed blog post by Quintessence of WarcraftPets.

source: Crafted by Profession: Blacksmithing.
description: This fel-green version of the Core Hound is crafted by a Blacksmith - obviously they just make the restraining harness, not the core hound! It doesn't require any Blacksmithing skill to use, and the object that teaches it can be traded or purchased on the Auction House.If you wish to craft your own, however, you need a Legion Blacksmithing skill of 100 to learn the plans.The plans drop from Tichondrius in The Nighthold in at least regular mode and above. The drop rate is not 100%.

name: Flarecore Infernal
source: The Trading Post (seasonal)
description: This orange infernal was added to the database in Legion, but has remained unavailable.  It's now flagged as a future Trading Post mount, but at this stage we don't know when it will appear, and whether it'll be sold for Traders Tender or offered as a monthly bonus reward.

name: Brinedeep Bottom-Feeder
source: Conjurer Margoss in Dalaran. Requires Best Friend with Conjurer Margoss. Cost: 100
description: One of the more unusual mounts to be added in Legion. To obtain this aquatic mount you must attain Best Friend status with a new fishing NPC, Conjurer Margoss, located on one of the small floating islands surrounding Dalaran. Margoss may be reached by fishing up an Emblem of Margoss from Swirling Whorls in the Dalaran Underbelly. The currency used to purchase this mount is Drowned Mana, which may also be fished up in Legion. You'll also need a lot more Drowned Mana to achieve Best Friend status with Margoss!

name: Long-Forgotten Hippogryph
source: Ephemeral Crystal puzzle in Azsuna, Broken Isles.
description: This beautiful older hippogryph may be obtained after a small adventure. The Wowhead community worked out the method of obtaining it - which involves being the first to locate 5 randomly-spawning purple Ephemeral Crystals in Azsuna and clicking on them within an eight-hour period, without dying. For maps and directions to all the crystals, see Warcraft Secrets' guide, or check out Wowhead's comments.

name: Mastercraft Gravewing
source: Dropped by Stygian Stonecrusher in Korthia.
description: This brown gravewing can be obtained by turning in a quest item that can drop from the Stygian Stonecrusher during the Broken Gatecrasher vignette event. This event is located in southern Korthia (around 46, 80), and can be reached by taking the Flayedwing Transporter in Keeper's Respite. If the event is available there's a star labelled  "Broken Gatecrasher" at its map location, and when someone starts it there's a zone-wide echo: Drippy yells: For Sinfall!. Only players in the Venthyr Covenant can start this event, and they do so by speaking to Drippy who is located nearby. During the event, waves of NPCs will appear, followed by the Stygian Stonecrusher boss. name: Fathom Dweller
source: Kosumoth the Hungering in Eye of Azshara (open world).
description: The unsaddled version of this eerie, jellyfish-like mount has actually existed since Cataclysm, and originally served as a mount for Faceless NPCs. Now with a saddle, this is the first time it's been available to players.To obtain it you first have to unlock the World Quest for Kosumoth the Hungering, which involves clicking orbs at various places around the Broken Isles (killing Kosumoth the Hungering without unlocking the quest will not award you the mount). The procedure is too involved to document here, but you can find all the steps in Warcraft Secrets' guide or the comments section for Kosumoth the Hungering on Wowhead. Check out the WoW Secret Finding Discord for other mysteries they're working on.

name: Vicious Gilnean Warhorse
source: Necrolord Sipe in Stormwind City. Cost: 1
description:
To purchase this warhorse you must be victorious in a great many rated arenas or battlegrounds in a single PvP season. The procedure is as follows:

You must reach the PvP rank of Combatant. You can obtain this ranking by reaching a rating of 1400 by competing in 2v2, 3v3, or 10v10 arenas and battlegrounds.
Once you've reached Combatant ranking you must win further matches in the same season, until your progress bar reaches 100% (2400 points). You'll then receive the current season's mount (not this one).
For each subsequent time you fill your progress bar during the season you'll receive a Vicious Saddle, which you may use to purchase older Vicious mounts, including this one.
It appears the 1400 rating is specific to the match type you earned it in. For example, if you only earned the rating in 10v10 then you cannot progress towards the mount in 2v2 (until you also earn a 1400 rating in the latter).
The number of matches required to fill your progress bar depends on the type of match. According to comments on Wowhead, by Rainewater, you require 40 wins from 10v10 (60 points / win),  80 wins from 3v3 (30 points / win), or  240 wins from 2v2 (10 points / win).

name: Smoldering Ember Wyrm
source: Dropped by Nightbane in Return to Karazhan.
description: This mount drops from Nightbane in the Return to Karazhan dungeon.Drop chance: Blizzard confirmed that the chance of this mount appearing is 20% multiplied by the number of players in your group that are eligible for loot (i.e. not loot-locked for that week). Party members who already have the mount still add to the drop chance, though they cannot receive it again. So, if you have 5 members in your party who are eligible for loot there's a 100% chance that the mount will drop for someone who doesn't already have it, and if only one member of a party of 5 doesn't have this mount then they're guaranteed it. But if you only have three players in your group and one is loot-locked, the chance drops to (3-1) x 20 = 40% that one eligible player will receive it. This loot rule hasn't changed in Battle for Azeroth.

name: Vicious War Fox
source: Necrolord Sipe in Stormwind. Cost: 1
description:
To purchase this armoured fox you must be victorious in a great many rated arenas or battlegrounds in a single PvP season. The procedure is as follows:

You must reach the PvP rank of Combatant. You can obtain this ranking by reaching a rating of 1400 by competing in 2v2, 3v3, or 10v10 arenas and battlegrounds.
Once you've reached Combatant ranking you must win further matches in the same season, until your progress bar reaches 100% (2400 points). You'll then receive the current season's mount (not this one).
For each subsequent time you fill your progress bar during the season you'll receive a Vicious Saddle, which you may use to purchase older Vicious mounts, including this one.
It appears the 1400 rating is specific to the match type you earned it in. For example, if you only earned the rating in 10v10 then you cannot progress towards the mount in 2v2 (until you also earn a 1400 rating in the latter).
The number of matches required to fill your progress bar depends on the type of match. According to comments on Wowhead, by Rainewater, you require 40 wins from 10v10 (60 points / win),  80 wins from 3v3 (30 points / win), or  240 wins from 2v2 (10 points / win).

name: Honeyback Harvester

It can be earned by Alliance players through a series of quests and lengthy, reputation-related tasks in Stormsong Valley.To begin this chain you must have already collected one of two bee companion pets: Bumbles (obtained through a week-long quest chain in Stormsong Valley - see the comments on the linked page for details) or the Seabreeze Bumblebee  (purchasable for 250 pet charms from the quartermaster if you're Revered with Storm's Wake). Once you have your pet out, go see Barry near Mildenhall Meadery in Stormsong Valley, who starts you on your unbeelievable adventure. Once you've unlocked the Honeyback Hive faction, most of your activities will be related to grinding reputation through collecting  Thin Jelly, killing Honey Smasher daily, and engaging in Honeyback Harvester assault events which periodically appear around the zone. The full details are a too complicated for this space, but see Wowhead's fantastic guide for more information.

name: Vicious War Basilisk
source: Deathguard Netharian in Orgrimmar. Cost: 1
description:
This armoured basilisk was the Horde rated PvP match reward for Battle for Azeroth Season 3. You can still obtain this old mount but it's now more complicated: you must first obtain the Vicious mount for the current season, then compete enough times to obtain a second mount within the same season. The full procedure is:

 Reach the PvP rank of Combatant during the Season. You can obtain this ranking by reaching a rating of 1400 by competing in 2v2, 3v3, or 10v10 arenas and battlegrounds.
 Once you've reached Combatant ranking you must win further matches in the same season, until your progress bar reaches 100% (2400 points). You'll then receive the mount.
 It appears the 1400 rating is specific to the match type you earned it in. For example, if you only earned the rating in 10v10 then you cannot progress towards the mount in 2v2 (until you also earn a 1400 rating in the latter).
 The number of matches required to fill your progress bar depends on the type of match. According to comments on Wowhead, by Rainewater, you require 40 wins in 10v10 (60 points / win),  80 wins in 3v3 (30 points / win), or  240 wins in 2v2 (10 points / win).
 For each subsequent time you fill your progress bar you'll receive a Vicious Saddle, which you may use to purchase older Vicious mounts .

 It appears the 1400 rating is specific to the match type you earned it in. For example, if you only earned the rating in 10v10 then you cannot progress towards the mount in 2v2 (until you also earn a 1400 rating in the latter).
 The number of matches required to fill your progress bar depends on the type of match. According to comments on Wowhead, by Rainewater, you require 40 wins in 10v10 (60 points / win),  80 wins in 3v3 (30 points / win), or  240 wins in 2v2 (10 points / win).
 For each subsequent time you fill your progress bar you'll receive a Vicious Saddle, which you may use to purchase older Vicious mounts .

name: Darkforge Ram
description: This heavily-armoured ram is the paladin class mount for the Alliance Allied Race, the Dark Iron Dwarves. This race must be unlocked before you can create a Dark Iron Paladin. To begin the unlocking process, you must reach Exalted with the Battle for Azeroth Alliance faction 7th Legion. Wowhead also has a useful Dark Iron Dwarves Allied Race Guide.

name: Dawnforge Ram
description: After sharing the human paladins' Warhorse for fourteen years, the dwarf paladins of Ironforge were finally given their own magnificent ram mount in Battle for Azeroth!

name: Dark Iron Core Hound
source: Achievement: Allied Races: Dark Iron Dwarf. Requires Dark Iron Dwarf character. Quest: Dark Iron Dwarves. Requires Dark Iron Dwarf character.
description: This slender, one-headed core hound is the racial mount of the the Dark Iron Dwarf allied race. After unlocking the Dark Iron Dwarves by recruiting them to the Alliance, this mount is usable by all Alliance players on your account. To begin the unlocking process, you must reach Exalted with the Battle for Azeroth Alliance faction 7th Legion. Wowhead also has a useful Dark Iron Dwarves Allied Race Guide.

name: Undercity Plaguebat
description: This sinister plaguebat was the reward for completing the Battle for Azeroth pre-expansion quest chain for Horde, which is paced over several weeks and culminates with the quest Killer Queen. The Alliance equivalent reward is the Teldrassil Hippogryph. You receive both mounts for your account when you complete either the Horde or Alliance quest chain, though they can only be used by characters of the appropriate faction.

name: The Dreadwake
source: The Trading Post (seasonal)Cost: 500
description: This flying pirate ship has returned to the Trading Post for the month of September, 2026. Visit the Trading Post in your faction's capital city for more information.The Trader's Tender used to purchase this mount can be earned through a wide range of in-game activities listed in the "Traveler's Log" tab of your Adventure Guide. You also receive a bonus 500 Tender a month just by visiting the Trading Post and opening the chest.

name: Underrot Crawg
source: Dropped by Unbound Abomination in The Underrot (Mythic Dungeon). Found in Challenger's Cache in The Underrot. / The Black Market Auction House (rarely) / Chance loot from Reins of the Quantum Courser dropped by Chrono-Lord Deios in Dawn of the Infinite (dungeon)
description: This taupe grey Crawg drops from the Unbound Abomination in the The Underrot dungeon in Nazmir, Mythic difficulty only. It is also listed as reward from the Challenger's Cache for the same dungeon.

name: Teldrassil Hippogryph
description: This dark hippogryph was the reward for completing the Battle for Azeroth pre-expansion quest chain for Alliance, which is paced over several weeks and culminates with the quest From the Ashes.... The Horde equivalent reward is the Undercity Plaguebat. You receive both mounts for your account when you complete either the Horde or Alliance quest chain, though they can only be used by characters of the appropriate faction.

name: Nazjatar Blood Serpent
source: Dropped by Adherent of the Abyss in Stormsong Valley.
description: The colour of old blood, this variant of the Abyss Worm drops from the Adherent of the Abyss, a rare elite in Stormsong Valley, Kul Tiras.

name: Cobalt Pterrordax
source: Natal'hakata in The Great Seal, Dazar'alor, Zuldazar. Requires Exalted with Zandalari Empire. Cost: 10000
description: This blue armoured pterrordax is a reputation purchase after reaching Exalted with Zandalari Empire.

name: Captured Swampstalker
source: Provisioner Lija in Nazmir. Requires Exalted with Talanji's Expedition. Cost: 90000
description: This bright green pterrordax may be purchased from the quartermaster after reaching Exalted with Talanji's Expedition.

name: Voldunai Dunescraper
source: Hoarder Jena in Vol'dun. Requires Exalted with Voldunai. Cost: 90000
description: This magnificent purple pterrordax may be purchased from the quartermaster after reaching Exalted with Voldunai.

name: Expedition Bloodswarmer
source: Provisioner Lija in Zul'Jan Ruins, Nazmir. Requires Exalted with Talanji's Expedition. Cost: 10000
description: This pale bloodswarmer is a reputation purchase after reaching Exalted with Talanji's Expedition.

name: Dusky Waycrest Gryphon
source: Quartermaster Alcorn in Arom's Stand, Drustvar. Requires Exalted with Order of Embers. Cost: 90000
description: This beautiful burgundy-tinged gryphon may be purchased from the quartermaster after reaching Exalted with Order of Embers.

name: Stormsong Coastwatcher
source: Sister Lilyana in Brennadam, Stormsong Valley. Requires Exalted with Storm's Wake. Cost: 90000
description: This beautiful grey gryphon may be purchased from the quartermaster after reaching Exalted with Storm's Wake.

name: Proudmoore Sea Scout
source: Provisioner Fray in Boralus Harbor, Tiragarde Sound. Requires Exalted with Proudmoore Admiralty. Cost: 90000
description: This beautiful light-grey gryphon may be purchased from the quartermaster after reaching Exalted with Proudmoore Admiralty.

name: Great Sea Ray
source: Caught by Profession: Fishing.
description: This teal green variant of the Darkwater Skate may be fished up in the open waters around the zones of Zandalar and Kul Tiras. It doesn't require any particular fishing skill to catch it. It doesn't appear to be obtainable from inland waters..

name: Frostshard Infernal
source: Achievement: No Stable Big Enough. Achievement: No Stable Big Enough.
description: Perhaps a relic of the last Legion invasion, this icy-blue infernal is the reward for collecting 350 mounts that usable by any single character on your account.

name: Fiery Hearthsteed
description: This fiery-red flying horse was given away to WoW players who logged into Hearthstone during latter's 10th anniversary. The event ran for only one week: from 11-18 March 2024. Hopefully it'll return for future anniversaries!

name: Surf Jelly
description: This teal variant of the Fathom Dweller is a reward from the new Island Expeditions content system in Battle for Azeroth. The chance of receiving this reward seems to be very low.

name: Conqueror's Scythemaw
source: Achievement: Conqueror of Azeroth. Achievement: Conqueror of Azeroth.
description: This green krolusk is the reward for a World PvP meta-achievement in Battle for Azeroth: Conqueror of Azeroth / Conqueror of Azeroth.

name: Broken Highland Mustang
source: Dropped by Knight-Captain Aldrin in Dabyrie's Farmstead, Arathi Highlands.
description: This Horde-branded steed has a chance of dropping from Knight-Captain Aldrin located in the north of Dabyrie's Farmstead in the Warfront phase of the  Arathi Highlands.

name: Highland Mustang
source: Dropped by Doomrider Helgrim in Go'Shek Farm, Arathi Highlands.
description: This Alliance steed has a chance of dropping from Doomrider Helgrim - located in the north of the Go'Shek Farm area in the Warfront phase of the Arathi Highlands.

name: Twilight Avenger
description: This beautiful, wine-red Twilight Drake is a reward from the new Island Expeditions content system in Battle for Azeroth. The chance of receiving this reward seems to be very low.This dragon is a non-armoured version of the retired Cataclysmic Gladiator's Twilight Drake.

name: Craghorn Chasm-Leaper
description: This rufous variant of the Minion of Grumpus is a reward from the new Island Expeditions content system in Battle for Azeroth. The chance of receiving this reward seems to be very low.

name: Qinsho's Eternal Hound
description: This stone quilen is a reward from the new Island Expeditions content system in Battle for Azeroth. The chance of receiving this reward seems to be very low. Unlike previous quilen mounts it doesn't fly.

name: Palehide Direhorn
source: Sold by Talutu in Zuldazar. Sold by Tricky Nick in Tiragarde Sound. Cost: 500000
description: A previously-unused variant of the Mists of Pandaria direhorn mounts, this elegant beauty comes with a hefty price tag!

name: Swift Albino Raptor
source: Dropped by Beastrider Kama in Arathi Highlands.
description: Finally available in Battle for Azeroth! This lovely white raptor is one of only two previously-unused colours of the old swift raptor model (the other is the black). It has a chance of dropping from Beastrider Kama - located in the Witherbark Village area in the Warfront phase of the Arathi Highlands.

name: Lil' Donkey
source: Dropped by Overseer Krix in Drywhisker Mine, Arathi Highlands.
description: This rescued donkey has a chance of dropping from Overseer Krix - located in the Drywhisker Mine area in the Warfront phase of the Arathi Highlands.

name: Skullripper
source: Dropped by Skullripper in Arathi Highlands.
description: This bare raptor mount has a chance of dropping from its namesake - Skullripper - who may be found north of Go'shek Farm in in the Warfront phase of the Arathi Highlands.

name: Witherbark Direwing
source: Dropped by Nimar the Slayer in Arathi Highlands.
description: This armourless bat mount has a chance of dropping from a revamped version of Nimar the Slayer - located in the north of the Witherbark Village area in the Warfront phase of the Arathi Highlands.

name: Pureheart Courser
source: Achievement: 100 Exalted Reputations.
description: This handsome horned steed is a reward for achieving 100 Exalted reputations. Factions / individuals with reputation levels that do not have a literal 'Exalted' rank are unlikely to count (such as the Brawler's Guild, which has numerical ranks, and various NPCs that have friendship levels). Originally this achievement was purely single-character, but it's now account-wide, though you have to log on the other characters for their reputations to register. However (i) the same Exalted reputation on two characters will only count as one, and (ii) paired reputations from opposite factions only count as one. For example, Orgrimmar and Stormwind will only count for one reputation, as will Kurenai and The Mag'har. This part can be confusing!

name: Frenzied Feltalon
source: Achievement: A Horde of Hoofbeats. Achievement: A Horde of Hoofbeats.
description: A relic of the last Legion invasion, this fel-green flametalon is the reward for collecting 400 mounts that are usable by any single character on your account.

name: Prestigious Bloodforged Courser
description: This fiery horned steed is the reward for reaching Honor Level 500 in the new PvP Honor level system in Battle for Azeroth.

name: Meat Wagon
source: Warcraft III:Reforged Spoils of War Edition.
description: This mount is a promotional reward for players who buy the upcoming remastered game, Warcraft III:Reforged Spoils of War Edition. Although the game isn't out yet, it's available for pre-purchase in the Blizzard Shop (US / EU).

name: Kul Tiran Charger
description: This fancy steed is the racial mount for the Kul Tiran allied race, added in Patch 8.1.5. After unlocking Kul Tirans as an allied race, this mount will be usable by all Alliance players on your account.  Wowhead has a useful Allied Races Overview to help you recruit all the races.

name: Blackpaw
source: Dropped by Agathe Wyrmwood. Dropped by Blackpaw.
description: This dark bear mount drops from Agathe Wyrmwood (for Alliance) or Blackpaw (for Horde) in the new Darkshore warfront and may require proper faction control in order to kill the right NPC. This is our first bear mount that doesn't have a riding harness.

name: Ashenvale Chimaera
source: Dropped by Alash'anir in Darkshore.
description: This purple chimaera is likely to be rare loot from an NPC in the new Darkshore warfront. It uses the same base model as the rylaks of Draenor.

name: Frightened Kodo
source: Dropped by Frightened Kodo in Darkshore.
description: This previously-unavailable kodo colour is awarded from a rare NPC of the same name in the new Darkshore warfront. But this mount isn't obtained by fighting an NPC - instead, you have to watch out for the Frightened Kodo rampaging around Darkshore. This seems to be a rare event. If you can intercept the kodo and calm it down, you earn both its trust and a great new mount!

name: Umber Nightsaber
source: Dropped by Moxo the Beheader in Darkshore. Dropped by Athil Dewfire in Darkshore.
description: This dark brown nightsaber is rare loot from vignette NPCs (one for Alliance and one for Horde) in the new Darkshore warfront.

name: Sandy Nightsaber
source: Provisioner Stoutforge in Tiragarde Sound. Provisioner Mukra in Zuldazar. Cost: 350 or 350
description: You must complete the Battle for Darkshore on Heroic difficulty (added in Patch 8.3) before you can purchase this mount.

name: Kaldorei Nightsaber
source: Dropped by Shadowclaw in Darkshore. Dropped by Croz Bloodrage in Darkshore.
description: This dark nightsaber is rare loot from a pair of vignette NPCs in the new Darkshore warfront. It currently looks like one is for Alliance and one for Horde.

name: Blue Marsh Hopper
source: Sold by Gottum in The Frogmarsh, Nazmir. Cost: 333 333
description: This dark blue spawn of Krag'wa is sold by Gottum in the Frogmarsh, Nazmir for a substantial sum of gold. Gottum is located in a cave under some arching tree roots on the south side of the swamp, west of Krag'wa's Burrow, and north of the pterrordax nests.

name: Yellow Marsh Hopper
source: Sold by Gottum in The Frogmarsh, Nazmir. Cost: 333 333
description: This chartreuse spawn of Krag'wa is sold by Gottum in the Frogmarsh, Nazmir for a substantial sum of gold. Gottum is located in a cave under some arching tree roots on the south side of the swamp, west of Krag'wa's Burrow, and north of the pterrordax nests.

name: Saltwater Seahorse
source: Captain Klarisa in Tiragarde Sound. Captain Zen'taga in Zuldazar. Cost: 500
description: This lovely seahorse will be for sale from Horde and Alliance vendors, for the Island Expeditions currency: Seafarer's Dubloons. This is a departure from previous Island Expeditions mounts, which were all rare rewards.

name: Stonehide Elderhorn
description: This sable version of the Highmountain Elderhorn is a rare reward from Island Expeditions scenarios, added in Patch 8.1.

name: Bloodthirsty Dreadwing
source: Provisioner Mukra in Zuldazar. Cost: 750
description: This black and red bat mount may be purchased for 750 Honorbound Service Medals. This currency may be earned in both battlefields and warfronts in Battle for Azeroth content.

name: Bloodgorged Hunter
description: This really stunning silver-blue bat is a rare reward from Island Expeditions scenarios, added in Patch 8.1.

name: Island Thunderscale
description: This purple version of the Valarjar Stormwing is a rare reward from Island Expeditions scenarios, added in Patch 8.1.

name: Risen Mare
description: This classic skeletal steed is a rare reward from Island Expeditions scenarios, added in Patch 8.1. Unlike the Forsaken mounts, this one doesn't have a saddle.

name: Azureshell Krolusk
source: Provisioner Stoutforge in Tiragarde Sound. Cost: 200
description: This handsome blue krolusk can be purchased with 7th Legion Service Medals. This currency may be earned in both battlefields and warfronts. If you purchase this mount on an Alliance character you will automatically learn the Rubyshell Krolusk for your Horde characters.

name: Rubyshell Krolusk
source: Provisioner Mukra in Zuldazar. Cost: 200
description: This fiery red krolusk can be purchased with Honorbound Service Medals. This currency may be earned in both battlefields and warfronts. If you purchase this mount on a Horde character you will automatically learn the Azureshell Krolusk for your Alliance characters.

name: Priestess' Moonsaber
source: Provisioner Stoutforge in Tiragarde Sound. Cost: 750
description: This stunning, armoured nightsaber may be purchased with 7th Legion Service Medals. This currency may be earned in both battlefields and warfronts in Battle for Azeroth content..

name: G.M.O.D.
source: Dropped by High Tinker Mekkatorque in Battle of Dazar'alor (Raid). / The Black Market Auction House (rarely)
description: This fancy mech suit can drop from all difficulties of the Battle of Dazar'alor raid.

name: Dazar'alor Windreaver
source: Achievement: Glory of the Dazar'alor Raider.
description: This armoured pterrordax is the meta-achievement reward for the Battle of Dazar'alor raid. Its armour is a little different to the previous Cobalt Pterrordax as it lacks tusks on its headgear.

name: Glacial Tidestorm
source: Dropped by Lady Jaina Proudmoore in Battle of Dazar'alor (Mythic Raid). / The Black Market Auction House (rarely)
description: This new water element mount drops from the Mythic-only Jaina Proudmoore encounter in the Battle of Dazar'alor raid. Note that the images here are still missing some of their effects.

name: Bruce
description: Bruce, the Brawler's Guild legend, was the mount reward for Brawler's Guild season 4. Unlike previous seasons, this mount was obtained through a quest chain rather than purely combat prowess. See Wowhead's excellent Brawler's Guild - Murder Mystery guide for more information.

name: Hogrus, Swine of Good Fortune
source: Battle.net Shop (US/EU)
description: Celebrating the Year of the Pig (2019), this stone boar is available for purchase in the Battle.net Shop.

name: Vulpine Familiar
source: Battle.net Shop (US/EU)
description: Available from the Battle.net Shop, this gorgeous, otherworldly fox can also fly! See Blizzard's promotional video.

name: Sylverian Dreamer
source: Battle.net Shop (US/EU)
description: This fanciful feathered dragon is available from the Blizzard Shop, but was previously part of a 6-month subscription promotion. See Blizzard's promotional video.

name: Wonderwing 2.0
source: Achievement: Battle for Azeroth Pathfinder, Part Two.
description: This elegant mechanical parrot mount is the reward for achieving Battle for Azeroth Pathfinder, Part Two, which requires completing content in Nazjatar and Mechagon, released in Patch 8.2. Battle for Azeroth Pathfinder, Part One is also a prerequisite.

name: Crusader's Direhorn
description: This lovely direhorn is the class mount for Zandalari Troll paladins. This Horde allied race must be unlocked before you can create a Zandalari Troll paladin. Wowhead has a useful Allied Races Overview to help you recruit all the races.

name: Aerial Unit R-21/X
source: Dropped by King Mechagon in Operation: Mechagon (Dungeon).

name: Rusty Mechanocrawler
source: Dropped by Arachnoid Harvester in Mechagon. Dropped by Arachnoid Harvester in Mechagon (Alt Timeline).
description: This rusted spider tank is an infrequent drop from the Arachnoid Harvester, a rare NPC situated not far west of Bondo's Yard in Mechagon. It can also drop from the "alternative timeline" version of the same NPC, which may be found at the same map coordinates, but in a phase which is accessible on days when Chromie is present in Rustbolt (speak to her), or by activating a Personal Time Displacer (created through Junkyard Tinkering).

name: Unshackled Waveray
source: Finder Pruc in Nazjatar. Requires Exalted with The Unshackled. Cost: 250
description: This striped crimson fathom ray can only be earned by Horde characters, since The Unshackled are a Horde-allied faction. But you've added it to your collection it can be ridden by your Alliance characters too!

name: Ankoan Waveray
source: Artisan Okata in Nazjatar. Requires Exalted with Waveblade Ankoan. Cost: 250
description: This dark blue fathom ray can only be earned by Alliance characters, since the Waveblade Ankoan are an Alliance-allied faction. But you've added it to your collection it can be ridden by your Horde characters too!

name: Azshari Bloatray
source: Achievement: Glory of the Eternal Raider.
description: This golden fathom ray is the reward for completing the achievement Glory of the Eternal Raider - a raid meta-achievement for the Eternal Palace raid on Normal difficulty and above.

name: Royal Snapdragon
source: Unshackled Supplies (Paragon reward). Ankoan Supplies (Paragon reward).
description: This dark grey snapdragon is a faction Emissary cache reward in Nazjatar. There is a small chance of obtaining this mount in Unshackled Supplies (Horde) or Ankoan Supplies (Alliance), which are the cache rewards for completing Emissary quests for The Unshackled and Waveblade Ankoan factions, respectively. To earn Emissary rewards you must first reach Exalted with your faction and then continue to earn further reputation (usually through daily / world quests). For every 10 000 reputation you earn above Exalted you'll receive another Emissary cache.

name: Snapback Scuttler
source: Achievement: Undersea Usurper.
description: This crab mount runs sideways! It's the reward for the achievement Undersea Usurper, which involves completing a suite of Nazjatar exploration and participation achievements.

name: X-995 Mechanocat
description:
This customizable mechanical feline can be created through the Junkyard Tinkering feature on Mechagon. Tinkering is facilitated through Pascal-K1N6 <Junkyard Tinkering>, a robot you unlock while completing the Mechagon intro quests. You can upload blueprints to Pascal-K1N6, and he'll create handy objects for you, once you provide him with the right materials.You can buy the requisite blueprints for this mount - Blueprint: Mechanocat Laser Pointer - from Cork Stuttguard after he's unlocked.Marvelous Martini in Mechagon can recolour your Mechanocat if you happen to find one of eight paint vials for him:
Paint Vial: Fireball Red - chance loot from Mechanized Chests around Mechagon
Paint Vial: Copper Trim - chance loot from Strange Recycling Requisition, from Even More Recycling repeatable quest
Paint Vial: Big-ol Bronze - chance loot from Rumblerocks
Paint Vial: Overload Orange - chance loot from Crazed Trogg
Paint Vial: Lemonade Steel - chance loot from Oxidized Leachbeast
Paint Vial: Mechagon Gold - chance loot from Armored Vaultbot
Paint Vial: Fel Mint Green - chance loot from Crazed Trogg
Paint Vial: Battletorn Blue - reward for collecting all seven other colours, see the achievement Available in Eight Colors

name: Obsidian Worldbreaker
source: The Black Market Auction House (rarely)
description: This Deathwing-inspired drake mount is now only available (rarely) on the Black Market Auction House. It was originally a reward during WoW's 15th Anniversary celebration and was earned by defeating the three "Chromie's Memories" events, consisting of a total of nine iconic raid bosses from WoW's past.

name: Beastlord's Irontusk
source: Tempra in Stormshield. Kronnus in Warspear. Only available during Timewalking Cost: 5000
description:
This fire-tinged elekk is for sale on weeks when Warlords of Draenor Timewalking is active. This only happens every few months, so check your in-game calendar for the next dates.
This colour is particularly unusual in that it's also the base skin for the Armored Irontusk (under all that armour!).

name: Beastlord's Warwolf
source: Tempra in Stormshield. Kronnus in Warspear. Only available during Timewalking Cost: 5000
description: This Iron Horde-themed fiery wolf is for sale on weeks when Warlords of Draenor Timewalking is active. This only happens every few months, so check your in-game calendar for the next dates.

name: Bloodflank Charger
source: Achievement: Two Sides to Every Tale.
description:
This armoured steed is the Horde mount reward for the achievement Two Sides to Every Tale, after you complete both the Horde and Alliance storylines for Battle for Azeroth, up to and including the Tides of Vengeance campaigns:

 A Nation United
 Tides of Vengeance
 Zandalar Forever!
 Tides of Vengeance


You also receive the Ironclad Frostclaw for your Alliance characters.

name: Ironclad Frostclaw
source: Achievement: Two Sides to Every Tale.
description:
This armoured wolf is the Alliance mount reward for the achievement Two Sides to Every Tale, after you complete both the Horde and Alliance storylines for Battle for Azeroth, up to and including the Tides of Vengeance campaigns:

 A Nation United
 Tides of Vengeance
 Zandalar Forever!
 Tides of Vengeance


You also receive the Bloodflank Charger for your Horde characters.

name: Mechacycle Model W
source: Achievement: Mecha-Done.
description: This brilliant new monocycle mount is the reward for Mecha-Done, a meta-achievement for completing a number of exploration and quest achievements in Mechagon.

name: Junkheap Drifter
source: Dropped by Rustfeather.
description: This rusty mechanical monocycle may drop from the rare NPC Rustfeather in The Outflow region of Mechagon.

name: Child of Torcali
description: This green direhorn is the reward for the Patch 8.2 quest Wander Not Alone, which is the final step in the How to Train Your Direhorn quest chain. The rest of the chain was available with the release of Battle for Azeroth.

name: Mollie
source: Dropped by Dunegorger Kraulok in Vol'dun.
description: This handsome, brown alpaca is a new drop from Dunegorger Kraulok, a world boss in Vol'dun that has existed since the start of Battle for Azeroth. Being a world boss, this unfortunately means Dunegorger Kraulok is only up for one week out of every six.

name: Mechagon Peacekeeper
source: Dropped by HK-8 Aerial Oppression Unit in Operation: Mechagon (Mythic Dungeon). / The Black Market Auction House (rarely) / Chance loot from Reins of the Quantum Courser dropped by Chrono-Lord Deios in Dawn of the Infinite (dungeon)
description: This spider tank drops in Mythic-mode only.

name: Scrapforged Mechaspider
description: You assemble this spider tank yourself, through a quest chain that begins with Shop Project and culminates in Drive It Away Today. See the achievement Making the Mount for a checklist of the full quest chain.

name: Rustbolt Resistor
source: Stolen Royal Vendorbot in Rustbolt, Mechagon. Requires Exalted with Rustbolt Resistance. Cost: 524288

name: Deepcoral Snapdragon
description: This purple-black snapdragon mount is the reward for raising your Nazjatar bodyguard Hunter Akana to rank 20, and completing the quest Wild Tame. Earning this mount will also award you the Snapdragon Kelpstalker for your Horde characters.

name: Snapdragon Kelpstalker
description: This green snapdragon mount is the reward for raising your Nazjatar bodyguard Neri Sharpfin to rank 20, and completing the quest Good Girl. Earning this mount will also award you the Deepcoral Snapdragon for your Alliance characters.

name: Silent Glider
source: Dropped by Soundless in Nazjatar.
description: The NPC that drops this mount, Soundless, is a rare spawn in Nazjatar. It can spawn atop a number of the tall coral growths found in the Coral Forest, in the south-east of the zone.

name: Fabious
description: This unbridled hippocampus has a unique method of capture, which was first discovered by the WoW Secret Finding Community on Discord. Firstly, locate the rarely-appearing NPC of the same name: Fabious, then take a S.E.L.F.I.E. picture with him and the mount should appear in your bags! Keep an eye on the Custom section of group finder for groups.Also note that this is the only hippocampus mount without any riding harness. The saddled equivalent would be the Purple Hippocampus.

name: Silver Tidestallion
source: Plunderstore. Cost: 1500
description: When Plunderstorm is active, this mount is purchasable from the 'Plunderstore', using currency earned during the event.Plunderstorm is an occasional 'battle royale' style feature is hosted on a different server and uses different characters and abilities to regular World of Warcraft - in fact, it's pretty much a different game that happens to use WoW assets, but the rewards are available in the regular game. See Wowhead's Guide for more information.

name: Crimson Tidestallion
source: Mrrl in Nazjatar. Cost: 4 2 1
description:
This mount is sold infrequently by Mrrl, a murloc vendor at your Nazjatar faction hub, as part of a complex bartering system. Here's how to purchase one:
Complete the intro quests for Nazjatar to the point where you unlock world quests.
Find the wounded murloc - Mrrl in the north of Dragon's Teeth Basin and accept its rescue quest (A Safer Place / A Safer Place) and bring it to your faction hub - Newhome for Horde, or Mezzamere for Alliance.
Upon completing the quest, four more vendor murlocs will appear around your hub: Grrmrlg, Hurlgrl, Mrrglrlr, and Flrgrrl. Mrrl offers you one more quest to buy four items from the other murlocs.
After you complete the final quest, Mrrl also becomes a vendor. The item(s) it offers may be purchased using items bought from the other murlocs, which in turns require other items sold by the same murlocs, i.e. a kind of bartering game.
The items Mrrl sells change daily so you'll need to be patient and check back every day. In the meantime there are other things you need to do:
Obtain an Azsh'iri Stormsurger Cape. These are created (randomly) from Benthic Cloak tokens which can be purchased from the benthic gear "Vaultkeeper" in your hub for 5 Prismatic Manapearls. Depending on how lucky you are it may take a few tries. You can earn more Prismatic Manapearls by completing various daily / world quests. You won't see the Crimson Tidestallion for sale on Mrrl unless you're wearing this cape.
Two of the three epic items required as currency for the Crimson Tidestallion (see 'Cost', above) can be purchased from the other murloc vendors around your hub, but only when you're wearing your Azsh'iri Stormsurger Cape. Otherwise the items are hidden. These items have a 1-day duration so don't purchase them until the day the mount is on sale!
The third currency item you need is a Hungry Herald's Tentacle Taco. This is sold by Murloco, a murloc who appears infrequently in Murloco's Hideaway in the north-west of Nazjatar (his cave is roughly due west of the "A" in "Azshari Terrace" and due south of the second "E" of Queen in "Gate of the Queen" on the zone map). You may need to camp his cave for some time before he appears. You may also need to kill some naga guards to free him. Fortunately his item doesn't have a finite duration, so it can be purchased days in advance.
If you don't want to work out the bartering game for yourself, here's what you need to buy:
Round 1: purchase 288 Unidentified Mass from Flrgrrl; 128 Sweet Sea Vegetable from Hurlgrl; 714 Slimy Naga Eyeball from Mrrglrlr. This will cost you 1130 gold.
Round 2: using the items you just bought, purchase 238 Curious Murloc Horn from Grrmrlg; 32 Just Regular Butter from Flrgrrl; 48 Dirty Murloc Socks from Hurlgrl
Take the 48 Dirty Murloc Socks to a water source and wash them (click on them till they're all Clean Murloc Socks).
Round 3: using the items you just bought, purchase 16 Sea Giant Foot Dust from Grrmrlg; 28 Ghost Food from Flrgrrl; 14 Healthy Murloc Lunch from Hurlgrl; 16 Smelly Pile of Gloop from Mrrglrlr
Round 4: using the items you just bought, purchase 2 Pulsating Blood Stone from Mrrglrlr; 4 Cultist Pinky Finger from Hurlgrl
Round 5: using the items you just bought plus the Hungry Herald's Tentacle Taco, purchase the Crimson Tidestallion from Mrrl!

name: Inkscale Deepseeker
source: Crafticus Mindbender in Nazjatar. Dazzerian in Nazjatar. Cost: 150
description:
This teal-grey hippocampus mount can be purchased with Nazjatar Battle Commendations. These can be earned two ways:
- With War Mode on, they drop from all rare NPCs in Nazjatar, even if you've already looted them today. This is by far the easiest way to get Commendations these days.- The Battle for Nazjatar PvP event. A win awards you 5 Battle Commendations and a loss awards you 1. This event is now hard to find players for since it's old content.

name: Uncorrupted Voidwing
source: Retired
description: A void drake redeemed by Wrathion! The Uncorrupted Voidwing was an Ahead of the Curve reward for the final patch of Battle for Azeroth - a limited-time reward from a quest after defeating N'Zoth in the Ny'alotha raid on Heroic difficulty or above. It was removed with the launch of Shadowlands.

name: Alabaster Stormtalon
source: The Trading Post (seasonal)Cost: 500
description: The Alabaster Stormtalon has returned to the Trading Post for the month of September, 2026. Visit the Trading Post in your faction's capital city for more information.The Trader's Tender used to purchase this mount can be earned through a wide range of in-game activities listed in the "Traveler's Log" tab of your Adventure Guide. You also receive a bonus 500 Tender a month just by visiting the Trading Post and opening the chest.

name: Alabaster Thunderwing
source: The Trading Post (seasonal)Cost: 500
description: The Alabaster Thunderwing has returned to the Trading Post for the month of September, 2026. Visit the Trading Post in your faction's capital city for more information.The Trader's Tender used to purchase this mount can be earned through a wide range of in-game activities listed in the "Traveler's Log" tab of your Adventure Guide. You also receive a bonus 500 Tender a month just by visiting the Trading Post and opening the chest.

name: Honeyback Hivemother
source: Achievement: I'm On Island Time.
description: This elegant black bee can be earned through the achievement, I'm On Island Time, which is the meta-achievement for various activities in Kul Tiras and Zandalar. See the link for more information. Note that this achievement was added retroactively in The War Within - 3 expansions later!

name: Black Serpent of N'Zoth
source: Achievement: Through the Depths of Visions.
description: The Black Serpent of N'Zoth is a reward for completing Through the Depths of Visions, a meta-achievement for activities related to the Horrific Visions of N'Zoth in Patch 8.3.

name: Mechagon Mechanostrider
source: Achievement: Allied Races: Mechagnome. Requires Mechagnome character.
description: This nifty new mechanostrider is the racial mount of the Mechagnome allied race. After unlocking the Mechagnomes by recruiting them to the Alliance, this mount will be usable by all Alliance players on your account. To begin the unlocking process, you must reach Exalted with the Rustbolt Resistance - a Battle for Azeroth faction, and also complete the achievement The Mechagonian Threat.

name: Frostwolf Snarler
source: Retired
description: This iconically-themed wolf is only available during WoW's anniversary celebrations (starting with the 15th anniversary, in 2019). During the event, players can earn it by participating in a special "Classic" version of Alterac Valley which you can join through the Player vs. Player tab of your Group Finder. To complete the achievement and receive the mount you must earn 200 Timewarped Badges through battleground participation and related quests. You also receive the Alliance equivalent, the Stormpike Battle Ram.

name: Caravan Hyena
source: Achievement: Allied Races: Vulpera. Requires Vulpera character.
description: This handsome hyena is the racial mount of the Vulpera allied race, though it is usable by all Horde players on your account. Its canopy can be attached or removed by interacting with a Caravaneer's Pack at a Vulpera camp, which is created by the Vulpera racial ability Make Camp.You receive this mount when you unlock the Vulpera allied race by recruiting them to the Horde. To begin the unlocking process, you must reach Exalted with the Voldunai - a Battle for Azeroth faction, and also complete the achievement Secrets in the Sands. Wowhead also has a useful Vulpera Allied Race Guide.

name: Explorer's Jungle Hopper
source: Recruit A Friend reward
description: This two-seater glider plane was a reward from a previous iteration of the Recruit-a-Friend program. When current, you received this reward after your recruits subscribed for a combined total of 9 months.

name: Explorer's Dunetrekker
source: Recruit A Friend reward
description: This intrepid camel mount was a reward from a previous iteration of the Recruit-a-Friend program.

name: Ensorcelled Everwyrm
source: Shadowlands Collector's Edition.
description: This mount is one of the rewards for purchasing the Shadowlands Heroic Edition or Epic Edition. Visit the Blizzard Shop for more information: US / EU.

name: Squeakers, the Trickster
source: Battle.net Shop (US/EU)
description: Celebrating the Year of the Rat (2020), Squeakers is available in the Blizzard Shop. It was also previously part of a 6-month subscription promotion.

name: Lucky Yun
source: Battle.net Shop (US/EU)
description: Celebrating the Year of the Ox (2021), this shiny golden ox is available in the Blizzard Shop. It was previously part of a 6-month subscription promotion.

name: Stormpike Battle Ram
source: Retired
description: This iconically-themed ram is only available during WoW's anniversary celebrations (starting with the 15th anniversary, in 2019). During the event, players can earn it by participating in a special "Classic" version of Alterac Valley which you can join through the Player vs. Player tab of your Group Finder. To complete the achievement and receive the mount you must earn 200 Timewarped Badges through battleground participation and related quests. You also receive the Horde equivalent, the Frostwolf Snarler.

name: Ny'alotha Allseer
source: Dropped by N'Zoth, the Corruptor in Ny'alotha, the Waking City (Mythic). / The Black Market Auction House (rarely)
description: This many-eyed jellyfish drops from N'Zoth, the Corruptor in the raid 'Ny'alotha, the Waking City' on Mythic difficulty only. As with previous Mythic raid mounts, it is possible that the Ny'alotha Allseer will be a guaranteed drop (for all party members) at the time the raid is current, but it'll become a rare drop once the next expansion is released. Note that although Mythic difficulty has been removed from the Allseer's description in the mount journal - which might suggest it drops from other difficulties - it's still only listed among Mythic loot in the Adventure Guide. We'll have to wait and see.

name: Clutch of Ha-Li
source: Dropped by Ha-Li in Vale of Eternal Blossoms (N'zoth Assault Phase - Mogu Assault only).
description: This night-blue bird mount drops from Ha-Li, a rare added to the N'zoth Assault Phase of the Vale of Eternal Blossoms in Patch 8.3. She only appears during Mogu assault weeks (which occur in the west of the zone), not when the Old God assaults occur in the east.

name: Hopecrusher Gargon
source: Dropped by Hopecrusher in Chalice District, Revendreth.
description: This gargon can only be ridden by members of the Venthyr covenant, though it's possible (not confirmed) that the item that teaches it drops for members of other factions. It has a small chance of dropping from the rare NPC Hopecrusher at 52,52 in the Chalice District of Revendreth. If Hopecrusher is ready to be summoned then there will be a dead dredbat called 'Large Prey' on the ground in the middle of the courtyard. Interacting with the corpse will summon Hopecrusher.

name: Battle Gargon Vrednic
description: This gargon is a quest reward for completing the Venthyr campaign quest The Medallion of Dominion. This completes the "Dominion" story arc, which forms the eighth and final chapter in the Venthyr Campaign and requires Renown level 22 to begin.

name: Dreamlight Runestag
description: This runestag is a quest reward for completing the Night Fae campaign quest What's My Motivation?. This is the eleventh quest in the "For Queen and Grove!" story arc, which forms the first chapter in the Night Fae Campaign.

name: Enchanted Dreamlight Runestag
description: This runestag is a quest reward for completing the Night Fae campaign quest Drust and Ashes. This is the culmination of the "Drust and Ashes" story arc, which forms the eighth and final chapter in the Night Fae Campaign.

name: Mawsworn Soulhunter
description: There is a small chance of this mount dropping from the Gorged Shadehound in the Beastwarrens section of The Maw. This NPC is only available on weeks when the event "Hunt : Shadehounds" is active and can only be looted once during that week. The Gorged Shadehound can only be attacked after killing 6 packs of mobs first. To access the Beastwarrens safely you'll have to unlock the area on your character by reaching Ambivalent level with Ve'nari and completing her quest chain up to and including "Rule 6". After unlocking you'll then see the week's Hunt event displayed on your zone map.

name: Darkwarren Hardshell
description: This mount can be obtained from a level 60 (the highest level) mission on your Shadowlands Covenant Adventure Table. It will take some time to advance your followers and adventure ranking to a level where you're able to complete these.

name: Swift Gloomhoof
source: Night Mare in Dreamshrine Basin, Ardenweald.
description:
The Night Mare that drops this mount isn't normally visible, instead you need to use a Dream Catcher and be level 60 in order to see it:

First, head to Tirna Scithe, which is the peninsula on the south-west edge of the zone, connected by a narrow land bridge. Head around the north of the zone, to roughly the north-west corner (18, 62). If Oranomonas is the world boss this week they'll be in a different clearing just to thr south of this one. Here you should see a tree hanging off the edge of the world, with roots hanging down.
 This is the most difficult part: you need to get from the edge of the world over to the narrower winding root. It's apparently possible to jump this on a mount, but you may fail and fall. Hunters can disengage over, Venthyr can use Door of Shadows. Or you can simply use a Goblin Glider Kit.
Jump to the adjacent broader tree root, and follow it up to the base of the tree. The cross a tree root bridge back to the mainland. Carefully circle to the left around the base of the enormous tree, until you come to a cart. Click on the Cracked Soulweb at the front of the cart, on the ground. You'll now have a  Broken Soulweb.
For the next stage, you must have (i) 10 pieces of Lightless Silk, and (ii) completed two quest chains: Trouble at the Gormling Corral and Tricky Spriggans. Neither chain is directly tied to this mount, but unfortunately you can't speak to Elder Gwenna at Glitterfall Basin until they're done.
Ensure 10 pieces of Lightless Silk are in your inventory, then head to Glitterfall Basin and speak to Elder Gwenna. If she's present she'll be north-west of the flight point, on the other side of the camp, by Aldas, the General Goods vendor. Select her dialogue to receive a Repaired Soulweb.
To enchant your soulweb you need to speak to Ysera in the Heart of the Forest. If you're in the Night Fae Covenant you can simply enter and speak to her directly. If not then you can speak to an Elite Queensguard at the entrance and they'll summon her out to you.
Speak to Ysera and you'll receive your Dream Catcher.
Head to Dreamshrine Basin, which spans an arc north, east and south of the Hibernal Hollow flight point.
Activate the Dreamcatcher. This is a permanent item and you can use it as often as you want, so you don't have to worry that you might waste it. It'll give you a 5-minute buff and put you into a special phase where you can see the Night Mare. If it's currently up it'll path around the area, otherwise you may have to wait half an hour or more for it to spawn.
You must defeat the Night Mare to receive the mount. If you're only just at level and not well geared  then his can be a difficult fight to solo, but you can receive help from other players who have the Dreamcatcher. Be sure to interrupt its Cosmic Shower ability, and run out of range when it casts Total Eclipse. Good luck!

name: Sundancer
description: Note: a player who follows the instructions below should be guaranteed to receive the Sundancer mount. It has been reported that other players who have obtained the same buffs and participate in the battle are also guaranteed to receive the mount, but we haven't confirmed that.To obtain Sundancer you first need to obtain a Skystrider Glider (if you use other gliding methods you won't be eligible for the mount!). The blueprints for crafting these are earned by members of the Kyrian Covenant who have upgraded their Path of Ascension feature to rank 3 and defeated Kalisthene on Wisdom (3rd level) difficulty. Other players can buy them from the Auction House. You'll also need some friends to help defeat Sundancer, unless you're very well geared. If your friends want to be eligible to receive the mount they'll also need a Skystrider Glider.Proceed to the far south-eastern corner of Bastion (~ 60, 94). If Sundancer is currently available you'll see it slowly path north and south through the sky off the east side of the cliffs. If it's not up you may need to wait up to an hour or so for it to respawn. When you're ready, click on the Ancient Memorial, which is located close to the southermost point. It will grant you the buff Sunrider's Blessing. Helper players who wish to be eligible for the mount should also click on the memorial.You (or another player, but just one player) should then proceed north to the higher cliffs, where they'll be a little higher than Sundancer when it flies by. Wait for Sundancer to be pathing north, then a bit before it reaches you leap out and activate the Skystrider Glider. Quickly glide to the steed and click on it to mount it. At this point, a Soothe button will appear in the middle of your screen and you should start spamming it to calm Sundancer. In between soothes, you can also activate any damage mitigation or heal over time spells you have, as you'll be receiving some damage (though not extreme) as you ride. After a short while Sundancer will calm and head to land, on the southernmost section of terrain, around 60, 94.When you're ready to fight you can speak to Sundancer to challenge it to combat, but note that you'll have less than 5 minutes before your invisible Skystrider Glider buff wears off so you'll need to proceed quickly. Beforehand, helper players should activate their gliders (and ensure they've clicked on Ancient Memorial) to make them eligible for the mount. Combat with Sundancer can be hard unless you're well geared, but not too difficult with help. After defeating Sundancer in challenge combat you should receive the mount!

name: Chittering Animite
description: This mount can be obtained from a level 60 (the highest level) mission on your Shadowlands Covenant Adventure Table. It will take some time to advance your followers and adventure ranking to a level where you're able to complete these.

name: Horrid Dredwing
source: Dropped by Harika the Horrid in The Banewood, Revendreth.
description: This mount can only be looted by members of the Venthyr Covenant, but it can be used by other characters on your account. It has a low chance to drop from Harika the Horrid a rare NPC that may be activated at 46,78 in The Banewood in Revendreth. This creature can only be activated / made attackable by a member of the Venthyr Covenant who has their Anima Conductor channeling to Wanecrypt Hill. If you meet these requirements then you can loot a Ballista Bolt, which can be found at several locations in the ruined fortress on the hill just to the west of Harika's area (you can see these on your minimap and one can be found around 42,81). You should then proceed east and down the hill and speak to Wingsmash at 46,78. This giant will offer a dialogue in which hand him the Ballista Bolt. Speak to him a second time to get him to shoot Harika and initiate combat.

name: Ivory Cloud Serpent
source: Dropped by Ivory Cloud Serpent.
description: To collect this pale-rose cloud serpent you'll first have to obtain a Zan-Tien Lasso. This is a rare drop item from hostile Mogu which appear during Mogu Assaults in the west of the Vale of Eternal Blossoms. You must then use the lasso on the Ivory Cloud Serpent, a rare NPC which spawns during Mogu Assaults, to obtain the mount. The Ivory Cloud Serpent spawns every ~1.5 - 2.5 hours at coordinates ~ 27,55, at roughly 2-3 times the height of the trees, and flies rapidly in clockwise circuits around the zone. You can lasso the serpent while on a flying mount, though not while moving, so you'll have to be fast. Multiple players can also lasso and win this mount at the same time, but you'll have to be quick as it despawns mere seconds after the first player successfully lassoes it.This mount's texture has an interesting history. It initially appeared in the Mists of Pandaria game files, but was soon replaced by the icy-blue skin used by the Malevolent Gladiator's Cloud Serpent and was then deleted entirely. Fortunately someone at Blizzard located and restored it.

name: Gargantuan Grrloc
source: Battle.net Shop (US/EU)
description: This murloc brute was part of a special 12-month subscription, for a limited-time in 2022. We don't know if it'll be offered again in the future.

name: Rajani Warserpent
source: Dropped by Rei Lun in Guo-Lai Halls (Mogu Assault Phase). Cost: 1
description: While the icy-blue Rajani Warserpent is technically a loot mount from a rare NPC, it's actually sold by Zhang Ku, a Rajani Mogu vendor added in Patch 8.3. The loot rare, Rei Lun in Guo-Lai Halls (Mogu Assault phase) actually drops a Pristine Cloud Serpent Scale which you use as currency to buy the mount from Zhang.

name: Drake of the Four Winds
description: This is the only colour of Skywall Drake that wasn't made available as a mount during Cataclysm. In Patch 8.3 it'll finally make its debut - as a drop from a new Rare Elite, Ishak of the Four Winds in the N'Zoth Assault phase of Uldum.

name: Mail Muncher
source: Dropped by Mail Muncher in Horrific Visions.

name: Waste Marauder
source: Dropped by Rotfeaster.
description: This black vulture mount drops from Rotfeaster, a rare NPC found in the N'Zoth Assault phase of Uldum.

name: Wastewander Skyterror
source: Provisioner Qorra in Ramkahen, Uldum. Requires Exalted with Uldum Accord. Cost: 24000

name: Malevolent Drone
source: Dropped by Corpse Eater in Uldum.
description: This swarthy Aqir flyer can drop from Corpse Eater a rare spawn in the Aqir Assault phase of western Uldum.

name: Shadowbarb Drone
description: You can earn this fanciful, tentacled insect mount by raising it from a newly-hatched drone. The quest chain begins by locating a clutch of Voidtouched Eggs near Ankhaten Harbor in Uldum and the entire chain takes 30 days. See this Wowhead comment if you want a day-by-day description.

name: Wicked Swarmer
source: Wrathion in The Chamber of Heart. Cost: 100000
description: This fanciful, tentacled insect once served the Old Gods, but now it serves us. Wrathion sells this mount for 100000 Corrupted Mementos in the Chamber of Heart. Corrupted Mementos can be earned primarily by running Horrific Visions scenarios, added in Patch 8.3. Wowhead has a detailed guide on how to earn these.

name: Wriggling Parasite
source: Achievement: Glory of the Ny'alotha Raider.
description: This purple serpent of N'zoth is the reward for completing Glory of the Ny'alotha Raider - the raid meta-achievement for the 'Ny'alotha, the Waking City' raid on Normal difficulty and above.

name: Elusive Quickhoof
description: To obtain this mount you must be lucky and come across the rare spawn Elusive Quickhoof that wanders Vol'dun. You then need to feed it some Seaside Leafy Greens Mix, which can be purchased from many Battle for Azeroth vendors, so pre-purchase some and have them in your bags, ready! Apparently the NPC will stay up for a while, and multiple people can obtain the mount, so watch your group finder for sightings.

name: Awakened Mindborer
source: Sold by Lindormi <Mythic Keystones>Cost: 1
description: The Timelost Saddle required to purchase this mount is awarded to players after earning the current season's 'Keystone Myth' achievement, from obtaining a Mythic+ rating of 3400. It can be used to buy an achievement mount from any of the previous Mythic+ seasons, plus several previously-unused colour variants of these mounts. These are sold by Lindormi in the current expansion hub / capital. Currently, just one Saddle can be earned per season.This mount was originally a Keystone Master achievement reward for Battle for Azeroth Season Four.

name: Ren's Stalwart Hound
source: Dropped by Houndlord Ren in Vale of Eternal Blossoms (N'zoth Assault Phase - Mogu Assault only).
description: This quilen drops from Houndlord Ren in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms. Houndlord Ren is only present when a Mogu Assault is up in the west of the zone.

name: Xinlao
source: Dropped by Anh-De the Loyal in Vale of Eternal Blossoms (N'zoth Assault Phase - Mogu Assault only).
description: This quilen drops from Anh-De the Loyal in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms. Houndlord Ren is only present when a Mogu Assault is up in the west of the zone.

name: Springfur Alpaca
description: This golden alpaca is a reward from the quest Alpaca It In in the new N'Zoth Assault phase of Uldum. To achieve this you must complete the daily quest Alpaca It Up for 7 days by locating Friendly Alpacas at random locations in Uldum and feeding them Gersahl Greens. Gersahl Greens may be found around the major waterway of Uldum.

name: Sunwarmed Furline
source: Battle.net Shop (US/EU)
description: This radiant feline can also fly! It is available from the Battle.net Shop.

name: Silky Shimmermoth
source: Master Clerk Salorn in Star Lake Amphitheater, Ardenweald. Achievement: Ardenweald's a Stage. Cost: 5000
description: This blue-white moth can be purchased from Master Clerk Salorn at the Star Lake Amphitheater in Ardenweald, but only after completing the achievement, Ardenweald's a Stage. This achievement requires you to participate in all seven performances (i.e. defeat performance bosses) at the Star Lake Amphitheater. Only one performance is available on any given day, and only members of the Night Fae Covenant can start these performances, but anyone can participate.

name: Steamscale Incinerator
source: Battle.net Shop (US/EU)
description: This impressive mechanical drake is available in the Blizzard Shop. It was also previously part of a 6-month subscription promotion.

name: Colossal Slaughterclaw
source: Supplies of the Undying Army.
description: There's a small chance of obtaining this mount in a Supplies of the Undying Army chest, which is a 'Paragon'-level reputation reward. To obtain one of these chests you must first reach Exalted reputation with The Undying Army faction in Shadowlands, and then continue performing daily activities for them. Every time you earn 10 000 rep with this faction above Exalted, you'll be eligible to receive another Supplies of the Undying Army chest from Nalcorn Talsen outside the Theater of Pain in Maldraxxus.

name: Vicious War Spider
source: Necrolord Sipe. Cost: 1
description:
This menacing spider with Dark Iron-themed armour is the Alliance rated PvP match reward for Shadowlands Season 1. To obtain this mount:

 Reach the PvP rank of Combatant during the Season. You can obtain this ranking by reaching a rating of 1400 by competing in 2v2, 3v3, or 10v10 arenas and battlegrounds.
 Once you've reached Combatant ranking you must win further matches in the same season, until your progress bar reaches 100% (2400 points). You'll then receive the mount.
 It appears the 1400 rating is specific to the match type you earned it in. For example, if you only earned the rating in 10v10 then you cannot progress towards the mount in 2v2 (until you also earn a 1400 rating in the latter).
 The number of matches required to fill your progress bar depends on the type of match. According to comments on Wowhead, by Rainewater, you require 40 wins in 10v10 (60 points / win),  80 wins in 3v3 (30 points / win), or  240 wins in 2v2 (10 points / win).
 For each subsequent time you fill your progress bar you'll receive a Vicious Saddle, which you may use to purchase older Vicious mounts .

name: Vicious War Spider
source: Deathguard Netharian. Cost: 1
description:
This menacing spider with Forsaken-themed armour is the Horde rated PvP match reward for Shadowlands Season 1. To obtain this mount:

 Reach the PvP rank of Combatant during the Season. You can obtain this ranking by reaching a rating of 1400 by competing in 2v2, 3v3, or 10v10 arenas and battlegrounds.
 Once you've reached Combatant ranking you must win further matches in the same season, until your progress bar reaches 100% (2400 points). You'll then receive the mount.
 It appears the 1400 rating is specific to the match type you earned it in. For example, if you only earned the rating in 10v10 then you cannot progress towards the mount in 2v2 (until you also earn a 1400 rating in the latter).
 The number of matches required to fill your progress bar depends on the type of match. According to comments on Wowhead, by Rainewater, you require 40 wins in 10v10 (60 points / win),  80 wins in 3v3 (30 points / win), or  240 wins in 2v2 (10 points / win).
 For each subsequent time you fill your progress bar you'll receive a Vicious Saddle, which you may use to purchase older Vicious mounts .

name: Shadeleaf Runestag
source: Elwyn in The Heart of the Forest, Ardenweald. Requires Renown 23 with Night Fae Covenant. Cost: 5000
description: This mount can be purchased upon reaching renown level 23 with the Night Fae Covenant.

name: Wakener's Runestag
source: Queen's Conservatory (Night Fae Covenant) in Ardenweald.
