description: This mount can only be obtained from the Queen's Conservatory feature by players who are members of the Night Fae Covenant in Shadowlands. The Conservatory must first be activated using Reservoir Anima. The mount can appear as chance loot from the reward cache when you use an "Untamed" type spirit and there are two Wildseed Root Grains active in the adjacent catalyst plots. The higher you upgrade your Conservatory, the more plots of this type become available.

name: Winterborn Runestag
source: Spindlenose in Hibernal Hollow, Ardenweald. Requires Revered with Court of Night. Cost: 5000 5

name: Enchanted Shadeleaf Runestag
description: This mount is awarded upon reaching renown level 39 with the Night Fae Covenant.

name: Enchanted Wakener's Runestag
source: Queen's Conservatory (Night Fae Covenant) in Ardenweald.
description: This mount can only be obtained from the Queen's Conservatory feature by players who are members of the Night Fae Covenant in Shadowlands. The Conservatory must first be activated and upgraded using Reservoir Anima. The mount can appear as chance loot from the reward cache when you use an "Untamed" type spirit and there are four Wildseed Root Grains active in the adjacent catalyst plots. There's only one plot that fulfils this criterion and it requires the Conservatory to be upgraded to rank 5.

name: Enchanted Winterborn Runestag
source: Cortinarius in Ring, Ardenweald. Requires Revered with Marasmius. Cost: 5000
description: To unlock Marasmius rep you must have chosen the Night Fae covenant (Ardenweald) and complete the quest chain beginning with A Mycelial Network. You'll then unlock daily quests to advance your reputation.

name: Shimmermist Runner
description:
To obtain the Shimmermist Runner, you have to negotiate the correct path through Mistveil Tangle in Ardenweald to reach it. While there are other ways of getting there, it will be invisible unless you take the correct way. A clue to taking the correct path can be found on a blue pennant attached to a tree in the Oaken Assembly at 33, 53 - this is at the north end of a large clearing where Karon Ruz can be found and is roughly west-south-west of the Root-Home flight point. It suggests you should always choose the path with From there:

Head south to the start of the maze, which is a large archway flanked by two blue lamps (approximately 31, 55).
Follow the wide road south until you see an archway to the left with two blue lamps above it (30, 56). Choose that passage.
Proceed a short distance, then take the first passage to the right, which has an archway with one blue lamp hanging (30, 58).
Then take an immediate left through the archway with a blue lamp on the ground (29, 59) - don't be deceived by the arch to the right with a hanging pink lamp.
Then take an immediate right through the archway with one hanging blue lamp.
You should be in a clearing with four other exits. Ignore the ones with pink lamps and take the exit with the blue lamp on the ground, which is roughly straight ahead and is the third exit from the left (28, 58).
You should be in another clearing with four other exits. Take the second archway from the left, which is flanked by two blue lamps (27, 58).
You should now be in the final clearing with Shizgher and the Shimmermist Runner, who should remain visible.

Defeat Shizgher then click on a grateful Shimmerist Runner to receive your mount!

name: Duskflutter Ardenmoth
source: Aithlyn in The Heart of the Forest, Ardenweald. Requires Exalted with The Wild Hunt. Liawyn in The Enclave, Oribos. Requires Exalted with The Wild Hunt. Cost: 25500

name: Spinemaw Gladechewer
source: Dropped by Gormtamer Tizo in Mistveil Tangle, Ardenweald.
description: This mount drops from Gormtamer Tizo in Mistveil Tangle, Ardenweald, but this rare must be summoned before he'll appear. To do this, kill Bristlecone mobs in the area (Bristlecone Terrors and possibly also Bristlecone Bone-Breakers) until the death of one of them spawns a gorm NPC named Chompy. Killing Chompy will cause Gormtamer Tizo to appear.

name: Sinful Gladiator's Soul Eater
source: Retired
description: This malevolent shadow beast was the reward for Shadowlands PvP Arena Season 1.

name: War-Bred Tauralus
description: This tauralus is a quest reward for completing the Necrolord campaign quest Enemy at the Door. This is the second quest in the "The Impossible Plan" story arc, which forms the second chapter in the Necrolords Campaign and requires Renown level 5 to begin.

name: Plaguerot Tauralus
source: Su Zettai in Seat of the Primus, Maldraxxus. Requires Renown 23 with Necrolord Covenant. Cost: 5000
description: This mount can be purchased upon reaching renown level 23 with the Necrolord Covenant.

name: Bonehoof Tauralus
source: Dropped by Tahonta in Maldraxxus.
description: This mount can only be looted by members of the Necrolord Covenant who have their Abomination Factory upgraded to rank 2, and have the construct "Neena" as their companion when they kill the rare Tahonta. Even then, the drop doesn't appear to be guaranteed. Tahonta patrols a field to the south-west of the Theater of Pain.

name: Chosen Tauralus
source: Achievement: The Gang's All Here. Abomination Factory (Necrolord Covenant) in Butchers Block, Maldraxxus. Requires Exalted with Stitchmasters.
description: This mount can only be obtained through the Abomination Factory feature by players who are members of the Necrolord Covenant in Shadowlands. To obtain this mount you must complete the achievement, The Gang's All Here, which requires you to create all the possible contructs available to the Abomination Factory.

name: Armored War-Bred Tauralus
description: This tauralus is a quest reward for completing the Necrolord campaign quest The Third Fall of Kel'Thuzad. This is the ultimate quest in the "Assault on the House of Rituals" story arc, which forms the eighth and final chapter in the Necrolords Campaign and requires Renown level 22 to begin.

name: Armored Plaguerot Tauralus
description: This mount is awarded upon reaching renown level 39 with the Necrolord Covenant.

name: Armored Bonehoof Tauralus
source: Dropped by Sabriel the Bonecleaver in Theater of Pain, Maldraxxus.
description: This mount can only be looted by members of the Necrolord Covenant who have their Anima Conductor upgraded to rank 3 and have it channeling to the Theater of Pain. This allows them to summon Sabriel the Bonecleaver in the Theater. While other players can kill and loot this rare, only players who meet this condition have a chance of looting it.

name: Armored Chosen Tauralus
source: Achievement: Things To Do When You're Dead. Abomination Factory (Necrolord Covenant) in Butchers Block, Maldraxxus. Requires Exalted with Stitchmasters.
description: This mount can only be obtained through the Abomination Factory feature by players who are members of the Necrolord Covenant in Shadowlands. To obtain this mount you must complete the achievement, Things To Do When You're Dead, which is a meta-achievement for a range of Abomination Factory activities.

name: Blisterback Bloodtusk
source: Dropped by Warbringer Mal'Korak in Unyielding Assembly (House of the Chosen), Maldraxxus.
description: This dark skullboar has a small chance of dropping from Warbringer Mal'Korak, a rare NPC who appears at the base of the main tower in the Unyielding Assembly (coordinates 34,80), at the far south of the House of the Chosen in Maldraxxus.

name: Gorespine
source: Dropped by Nerissa Heartless in House of Rituals, Maldraxxus.
description: This pale green skullboar has a small chance of dropping from Nerissa Heartless, a rare NPC who appears in the south-west of the House of Rituals (coordinates 66,35) in Maldraxxus.

name: Lurid Bloodtusk
source: Nalcorn Talsen in Theater of Pain, Maldraxxus. Requires Exalted with The Undying Army. Dar Vattish in The Enclave, Oribos. Requires Exalted with The Undying Army. Cost: 30000

name: Silvertip Dredwing
source: Abomination Factory (Necrolord Covenant) in Butchers Block, Maldraxxus. Requires Exalted with Stitchmasters. The Ember Court (Venthyr Covenant) in Revendreth. Queen's Conservatory (Night Fae Covenant) in Ardenweald. Path of Ascension (Kyrian Covenant) in Bastion.
description:
This mount can be obtained in different ways depending on which of the four Shadowlands Covenants you're a member of. In each case it requires the use of your covenant's special feature (below), which must be activated and upgraded with Reservoir Anima:

Venthyr Covenant - The Ember Court. Can be purchased from Temel for 5000 Reservoir Anima after you've reached Exalted with the associated faction, The Ember Court. This doesn't require the Court to be upgraded beyond rank 1, although your reputation will increase more quickly with higher ranks.
Night Fae Covenant - Queen's Conservatory. Chance loot from the reward cache when you use an "Prideful" type spirit and there are four Wildseed Root Grains active in the adjacent catalyst plots. There's only one plot that fulfils this criterion and it requires the Conservatory to be upgraded to rank 5.
Kyrian Covenant - Path of Ascension. Can be purchased from Binkiros for 2500 Reservoir Anima after you've completed the achievement, Curse of Thirst. This requires the feature to be upgraded to rank 3.
Necrolord Covenant - Abomination Factory. Can be purchased from Atticus for 5000 Reservoir Anima after you've reached Exalted with the associated faction, Stitchmasters. This doesn't require the feature to be upgraded beyond rank 1, although your reputation will increase more quickly with higher ranks.

name: Rampart Screecher
source: Achievement: Glory of the Nathria Raider.
description: This stone dredbat is the meta-achievement reward for the Castle Nathria raid in Revendreth.

name: Harvester's Dredwing
source: Found in Harvester's War Chest.
description: This purple dredbat is a possible reward from a Harvester's War Chest. These chests appear to be awarded for Venthyr Assaults upon The Maw in Patch 9.1. These assaults can be completed by players of any covenant.

name: Endmire Flyer
source: Dropped by Famu the Infinite in The Endmire, Revendreth.
description: This mount has a small chance of dropping from the Revendreth rare NPC, Famu the Infinite at 62,47 in The Endmire. This creature can be summoned by speaking to Seeker Hilda. If she doesn't have a special dialogue then Famu isn't ready to be summoned.

name: Inquisition Gargon
source: Archivist Janeera in Halls of Atonement, Revendreth. Requires Exalted with The Avowed. Archivist Leonara in The Enclave, Oribos. Requires Exalted with The Avowed. Cost: 2000
description: This gargon can be purchased once you reach Exalted with The Avowed. This is a Revendreth side-faction that players of all covenants can participate in, but only members of the Venthyr Covenant can purchase and use this mount. The Avowed faction is unlocked after a quest chain started by The Accuser in Absolution Crypt, by the Halls of Atonement flightmaster. Reputation increases with this faction are slow, but not gated, and mostly involve farming various NPCs in the area, as well as running the Halls of Atonement dungeon. See Wowhead's Reputation Guide for more information.

name: Sinfall Gargon
source: Chachi the Artiste in Sinfall, Revendreth. Requires Renown 23 with Venthyr Covenant. Cost: 5000
description: This mount can be purchased upon reaching renown level 23 with the Venthyr Covenant.

name: Crypt Gargon
description: This gargon is a quest reward for completing the Venthyr campaign quest Mirror, Mirror.... This is the penultimate quest in the "Avarice" story arc, which forms the fourth chapter in the Venthyr Campaign and requires Renown level 11 to begin.

name: Desire's Battle Gargon
source: The Ember Court (Venthyr Covenant) in Revendreth.
description: This mount can only be obtained from the The Ember Court feature by players who are members of the Venthyr Covenant in Shadowlands. You must first activate and upgrade the Ember Court to rank 4, using Reservoir Anima. Then invite The Countess as a weekly guest until you become Best Friends with her. Following that, you should receive the mount in The Countess's tribute chest the next time you run a Court with her and she reaches a happiness level of Very Happy or Elated.

name: Gravestone Battle Gargon
description: This mount is awarded upon reaching renown level 39 with the Venthyr Covenant.

name: Battle Gargon Silessa
source: Forgotten Chest in Repared Broken Mirrors, Revendreth.
description: Silessa is only available to members of the Venthyr Covenant who have upgraded their Mirror Network to rank 3. This will take some time and a lot of Reservoir Anima.When you reach rank 3 you'll unlock the ability to repair Broken Mirrors in Revendreth, using a Handcrafted Mirror Repair Kit sold by Simone in Sinfall. When you repair a mirror you can use it to access a hidden room with a Forgotten Chest you can loot. The chest can award various goodies, including Silessa.Only three mirrors are available for repair at any one time, and you can repair each once per day. Typically, the mirror locations change with the weekly reset, but sometimes sooner. It also appears that the mirror locations are grouped, so if you find one you can determine where the other two are by looking them up. Refer to this comprehensive Wowhead article for a full list.

name: Loyal Gorger
description: To earn this dark anima gorger you first need to obtain an Impressionable Gorger Spawn, which is a rare loot item from the Worldedge Gorger world boss in Revendreth. This world boss isn't up all the time, but must be spawned by a player using Enticing Anima, which is an uncommon drop from the various gorger and devourer NPCs in Revendreth. It's better to look for Worldedge Gorger groups in group finder than try to farm this item daily.Once you've been lucky enough to obtain an Impressionable Gorger Spawn, it will  immediately be removed from your bags and you'll receive a message that the Gorger Spawn has run off towards the Endmire. You can find it again as an NPC at approximately 63, 56. Each day, for seven days, the NPC will offer you a quest and will continue to grow and form a bond with you. After completing the seventh quest you'll receive the mount.

name: Pale Acidmaw
source: Abomination Factory (Necrolord Covenant) in Butchers Block, Maldraxxus. Requires Exalted with Stitchmasters. The Ember Court (Venthyr Covenant) in Revendreth. Queen's Conservatory (Night Fae Covenant) in Ardenweald. Path of Ascension (Kyrian Covenant) in Bastion.
description:
This mount can be obtained in different ways depending on which of the four Shadowlands Covenants you're a member of. In each case it requires the use of your covenant's special feature (below), which must be activated and upgraded with Reservoir Anima:

Venthyr Covenant - The Ember Court. Chance loot from tribute chests at the end of your Court session, possibly only when Hunt-Captain Korayn or Lady Moonberry are guests, and their happiness probably has to reach Elated. This requires the Court to be upgraded to rank 3 or 4.
Night Fae Covenant - Queen's Conservatory. Chance loot from the reward cache when you use an "Untamed" type spirit and there are four Wildseed Root Grains active in the adjacent catalyst plots. There's only one plot that fulfils this criterion and it requires the Conservatory to be upgraded to rank 5.
Kyrian Covenant - Path of Ascension. Can be purchased from Binkiros for 2500 Reservoir Anima after you've completed the achievement, Bare Necessities. This requires the feature to be upgraded to rank 3.
Necrolord Covenant - Abomination Factory. Can be purchased from Atticus for 5000 Reservoir Anima after you've reached Exalted with the associated faction, Stitchmasters. This doesn't require the feature to be upgraded beyond rank 1, although your reputation will increase more quickly with higher ranks.

name: Wild Glimmerfur Prowler
source: Dropped by Valfir the Unrelenting (loot) in Mistveil Tangle, Ardenweald. Dropped by Elwyn (vendor) in Heart of the Forest, Ardenweald.
description:
There are two different methods of obtaining this mount. Both are only available to members of the Night Fae Covenant, although other players on your account can use the mount:

You can purchase it from the Night Fae Covenant Renown Quartermaster, Elwyn, for 5000 Reservoir Anima and 75 grateful offerings. This is a very costly method but is guaranteed.
You can receive it as a low-chance loot reward from Valfir the Unrelenting in Mistveil Tangle. This boss must be activated by a Night Fae player who has a rank 3 Anima Conductor channeling to Tirna Scithe, but it has been reported that other Night Fae players ave a chance of looting the mount.

name: Phalynx of Loyalty
source: Path of Ascension (Kyrian Covenant) in Bastion.
description: This mount can only be obtained from the Path of Ascension feature by players who are members of the Kyrian Covenant in Shadowlands. The phalynx is awarded after defeating the boss Mad Mortimer on Loyalty (2nd level) difficulty. To begin this you must activate the Path of Ascension at Elysian Hold, and upgrade it to rank 2 using Reservoir Anima.

name: Phalynx of Humility
source: Sold by Adjutant Galos in Elysian Hold, Bastion. Cost: 5000 100 / Found in Penitence of Purity in Temple of Purity, Bastion.
description:
There are two different methods of obtaining this mount:

You can purchase it from the Kyrian Covenant Renown Quartermaster, Adjutant Galos, for 5000 reservoir anima and 100 grateful offerings. This is a very costly method but is guaranteed.
You can receive it as a low-chance loot reward from the Penitence of Purity covenant activity. You first have to activate your covenant's Anima Conductor and set it to the Temple of Purity. Then proceed to the Temple location, pick up the Burden of Penitence (which will be nearby and appear as a yellow dot on your minimap) and avoid moving patches on the ground to reach the Penitence chest and open it. Currently, if you use a vehicle mount (such as a vendor mount), you're immune to the patches on the ground. You can open this chest daily.

name: Phalynx of Courage
description: This phalynx is a quest reward for completing the Kyrian campaign quest Building the Base. This is the culmination of the "Phaestus, Genesis of Aeons" story arc, which forms the third chapter in the Kyrian Campaign and requires Renown level 8 to begin.

name: Wildseed Cradle
source: Cache of the Moon in Ardenweald.
description:
This unique mount is contained within the Cache of the Moon, which is a treasure located at Tirna Vaal in Ardenweald. However, this treasure isn't visible until you help the nearby faerie, Twinklestar, find her lost tools. All five items can be found in the Garden of the Night, which is located south-west of the Heart of the Forest or east of the Root-Home flight point. The items you need to collect are:

Gardener's Basket - in the north of the garden, by two rocks at the edge of a pool, around 40, 53
Gardener's Flute - in the south of the garden, between a large seed pod and a smaller one, around 38, 58
Gardener's Hammer - in a broken cart, around 40, 54
Gardener's Wand - under a different cart, in the south of the garden, around 38, 58 (not far from the flute)
Diary of the Night - on a table on a tree platform in the middle of the garden, around 39, 57. This is the second tree connected by bridges.

Once you've collected all five items, right-click on one of them to assemble them into Twinklestar's Gardening Toolkit. Return them to a grateful Twinklestar, who will then cast Moonsight on you. This will allow you to finally see and open the Cache of the Moon behind her.

name: Phalynx of Purity
source: Adjutant Galos in Elysian Hold, Bastion. Requires Renown 23 with Kyrian Covenant. Cost: 5000
description: This mount can be purchased upon reaching renown level 23 with the Kyrian Covenant.

name: Eternal Phalynx of Purity
description: This mount is awarded upon reaching renown level 39 with the Kyrian Covenant.

name: Eternal Phalynx of Courage
description: This phalynx is a quest reward for completing the Kyrian campaign quest A New Age. This is the culmination of the "A Vessel of Ardenweald" story arc, which forms the sixth chapter in the Kyrian Campaign and requires Renown level 17 to begin.

name: Eternal Phalynx of Loyalty
source: Achievement: Death Foursworn. Path of Ascension (Kyrian Covenant) in Bastion. Cost: 2500
description: This mount can only be obtained from the Path of Ascension feature by players who are members of the Kyrian Covenant in Shadowlands. It can be purchased from Binkiros for 2500 Reservoir Anima after you've completed the achievement, Death Foursworn. To begin this you must activate the Path of Ascension at Elysian Hold, and upgrade it to rank 4 using Reservoir Anima.

name: Eternal Phalynx of Humility
source: Achievement: Learning from the Masters. Path of Ascension (Kyrian Covenant) in Bastion. Cost: 2500
description: This mount can only be obtained from the Path of Ascension feature by players who are members of the Kyrian Covenant in Shadowlands. It can be purchased from Binkiros for 2500 Reservoir Anima after you've completed the achievement, Learning from the Masters. To begin this you must activate the Path of Ascension at Elysian Hold, and upgrade it to rank 3 or 4 using Reservoir Anima.

name: Silverwind Larion
source: Vesper of the Silver Wind (treasure) in Bastion.
description: This mount is contained within the Vesper of the Silver Wind, which is a treasure located at approximately 36, 25 in Bastion. However, it's not that simple! First you have to locate and collect 50 unique Anima Crystal Shards, which can be found at specific locations throughout Bastion. It has been reported you need to be level 60 to see these shards. The list of locations is too long to report here, but you can find them in the mount's this detailed comment on Wowhead. You should then speak to Forgelite Hephaesius will forge a Crystal Mallet of Heralds for you. The mallet will allow you to unlock the Vesper treasure.

name: Restoration Deathwalker
source: Sold by Lindormi <Mythic Keystones>Cost: 1
description: The Timelost Saddle required to purchase this mount is awarded to players after earning the current season's 'Keystone Myth' achievement, from obtaining a Mythic+ rating of 3400. It can be used to buy an achievement mount from any of the previous Mythic+ seasons, plus several previously-unused colour variants of these mounts. These are sold by Lindormi in the current expansion hub / capital. Currently, just one Saddle can be earned per season.This mount was originally a Keystone Master achievement reward for Shadowlands Season Four.

name: Marrowfang
source: Dropped by Nalthor the Rimebinder in The Necrotic Wake (Mythic Dungeon). / Chance loot from Reins of the Quantum Courser dropped by Chrono-Lord Deios in Dawn of the Infinite (dungeon)
description: Marrowfang has a small chance of dropping from Nalthor the Rimebinder the last boss of The Necrotic Wake dungeon, but on Mythic (and Mythic+) difficulty only.

name: Callow Flayedwing
source: Hatched from Blight-Touched Egg in Maldraxxus.
description: This chimaera mount hatches from a Blight-Touched Egg, which is a rare drop from various chimaera NPCs in Maldraxxus, including Galescreamers, Flayedwings and Boneteeth (see the link for a complete list on Wowhead). After five days it will become a Cracked Blight-Touched Egg, which can be opened with a 100% chance of looting the mount.

name: Gruesome Flayedwing
source: Abomination Factory (Necrolord Covenant) in Butchers Block, Maldraxxus. Requires Exalted with Stitchmasters. The Ember Court (Venthyr Covenant) in Revendreth. Queen's Conservatory (Night Fae Covenant) in Ardenweald. Path of Ascension (Kyrian Covenant) in Bastion.
description:
This mount can be obtained in different ways depending on which of the four Shadowlands Covenants you're a member of. In each case it requires the use of your covenant's special feature (below), which must be activated and upgraded with Reservoir Anima:

Venthyr Covenant - The Ember Court. Chance loot from tribute chests at the end of your Court session, possibly only when Alexandros Mograine or Baroness Vashj are guests, and their happiness probably has to reach Elated. This requires the Court to be upgraded to rank 3 or 4.
Night Fae Covenant - Queen's Conservatory. Chance loot from the reward cache when you use an "Martial" type spirit and there are four Wildseed Root Grains active in the adjacent catalyst plots. There's only one plot that fulfils this criterion and it requires the Conservatory to be upgraded to rank 5.
Kyrian Covenant - Path of Ascension. Can be purchased from Binkiros for 2500 Reservoir Anima after you've completed the achievement, All the Colors of the Painbow. This requires the feature to be upgraded to rank 2.
Necrolord Covenant - Abomination Factory. Can be purchased from Atticus for 5000 Reservoir Anima after you've reached Exalted with the associated faction, Stitchmasters. This doesn't require the feature to be upgraded beyond rank 1, although your reputation will increase more quickly with higher ranks.

name: Bonesewn Fleshroc
source: Abomination Factory (Necrolord Covenant) in Butchers Block, Maldraxxus. Requires Exalted with Stitchmasters.
description: This mount can only be created using the Abomination Factory feature by players who are members of the Necrolord Covenant in Shadowlands, but it can be used by anyone. Your Abomination Factory must first be activated and upgraded to rank 5, using Reservoir Anima. The Fleshroc can then be crafted using your Abominable Stitching Table. It requires 50 Malleable Flesh, 5 Superior Parts, and 3500 Reservoir Anima  to create.

name: Hulking Deathroc
source: Dropped by Violet Mistake in House of Plagues, Maldraxxus.
description: This purple deathroc has a small chance of dropping from the Violet Mistake, a specially-summoned NPC that appears at the Pool of Mixed Monstrosities (59,74) in the House of Plagues, Maldraxxus. To summon this rare you should be familiar with the mechanics of the Pool of Mixed Monstrosities and achieve a purple (even balance of blue and red ingredients) mixture. Essentially, you need to kill red and blue slime creatures in the area and pick up the materials they leave after they die (Viscous Oil and Mephitic Goo, respectively) and add them in even amounts to the pool until it reaches an ingredient count of 30. It is also allowable to add some yellow ingredients (Miscible Ooze) to the pool, providing that the amount of yellow remains lower than the other two colours. This means that you must add between 11 and 15 each of red and blue ingredients, and 0 to 8 yellow (and the amount of yellow must be an even number). The Violet Mistake will spawn as soon as the addition count reaches 30, providing the pool is purple.Note that this pool is a communal effort and it's possible another player will show up and unwittingly mess up your mixture balance.

name: Predatory Plagueroc
source: Dropped by Gieger in House of Constructs, Maldraxxus.
description: This mount can only be looted by members of the Necrolord Covenant. It's a rare drop from Gieger, who must be activated by a Necrolord player who has their Anima Conductor channeling to the House of Constructs. Other Necrolord players also have a chance of looting the mount, not just the summoner.

name: Dauntless Duskrunner
source: Abomination Factory (Necrolord Covenant) in Butchers Block, Maldraxxus. Requires Exalted with Stitchmasters. The Ember Court (Venthyr Covenant) in Revendreth. Queen's Conservatory (Night Fae Covenant) in Ardenweald. Path of Ascension (Kyrian Covenant) in Bastion.
description:
This mount can be obtained in different ways depending on which of the four Shadowlands Covenants you're a member of. In each case it requires the use of your covenant's special feature (below), which must be activated and upgraded with Reservoir Anima:

Venthyr Covenant - The Ember Court. Chance loot from tribute chests at the end of your Court session, possibly only when Polemarch Adrestes or Mikanikos are guests, and their happiness probably has to reach Elated. This requires the Court to be upgraded to rank 3 or 4.
Night Fae Covenant - Queen's Conservatory. Chance loot from the reward cache when you use an "Dutiful" type spirit and there are four Wildseed Root Grains active in the adjacent catalyst plots. There's only one plot that fulfils this criterion and it requires the Conservatory to be upgraded to rank 5.
Kyrian Covenant - Path of Ascension. Awarded after defeating the boss Azaruux on Wisdom difficulty. This requires the feature to be upgraded to rank 4.
Necrolord Covenant - Abomination Factory. Can be purchased from Atticus for 5000 Reservoir Anima after you've reached Exalted with the associated faction, Stitchmasters. This doesn't require the feature to be upgraded beyond rank 1, although your reputation will increase more quickly with higher ranks.

name: Sinrunner Blanchy
source: Dead Blanchy.
description:
It appears that in death Old Blanchy did not go to a better place. In Revendreth you can earn her trust, and her reins, through a six-day quest chain. To begin, locate Dead Blanchy in the Endmire in Revendreth. Note that she isn't up all the time: she respawns every 1-2 hours and is only up for 5 minutes at a time.
Day 1: bring her 8 Handfuls of Oats from Oat Packs around Saldean's and Molsen's farms in Westfall.
Day 2: groom her with a Grooming Brush which you obtain by speaking to Snickersnee in Darkhaven, Revendreth.
Day 3: bring her 4 Sturdy Horseshoes which can be found randomly by the roads between Endmire and Darkhaven.
Day 4: bring her a Bucket of Clean Water. To obtain this, first collect an Empty Water Bucket which can be found near Snickersnee in Darkhaven, Revendreth. Then proceed to a water source in either Bastion or Ardenweald and fill the bucket.
Day 5: bring her a Comfortable Saddle Blanket which may be purchased from Ta'tru at the Night Market in southern Revendreth. The barter items required for this purchase may change weekly.
Day 6 - the final day: feed her 3 Dredhollow Apples which may be purchased from Mims, the Innkeeper at the Hole in the Wall in western Revendreth.
Thanks to Unholypriest's quest description on Wowhead.

name: Arboreal Gulper
source: Dropped by Humon'gozz.
description: This toad is a guaranteed drop from the rare NPC Humon'gozz in Ardenweald. To summon this beast you need an Unusually Large Mushroom, which has a low chance of dropping from most creatures in Ardenweald. You must then plant the mushroom in the Damp Loam pile north-west of Dreamsong Fenn, at roughly 32,30, and wait for Humon'gozz to appear.

name: Mawsworn Charger
source: Achievement: Flawless Master (Layer 12).
description: This dark, deathly steed is the reward for completing the Flawless Master (Layer 12) achievement. This requires you to complete a Flawless run on layer 12 in each wing of Torghast, Tower of the Damned.

name: Hand of Hrestimorak
source: Achievement: Glory of the Dominant Raider.
description: This grey hand mount is the meta-achievement reward for the Sanctum of Domination raid in the Maw.

name: Sintouched Deathwalker
source: Sold by Lindormi <Mythic Keystones>Cost: 1
description: The Timelost Saddle required to purchase this mount is awarded to players after earning the current season's 'Keystone Myth' achievement, from obtaining a Mythic+ rating of 3400. It can be used to buy an achievement mount from any of the previous Mythic+ seasons, plus several previously-unused colour variants of these mounts. These are sold by Lindormi in the current expansion hub / capital. Currently, just one Saddle can be earned per season.This mount was originally a Keystone Master achievement reward for Shadowlands Season One.

name: Umbral Scythehorn
source: Spindlenose in Hibernal Hollow, Ardenweald. Requires Revered with Court of Night. Cost: 5000 5

name: Court Sinrunner
source: Mistress Mihaela in Darkhaven, Revendreth. Requires Exalted with Court of Harvesters. Darvel the Frugal in The Enclave, Oribos. Requires Exalted with Court of Harvesters. Cost: 30000

name: Warstitched Darkhound
description: This mount can be obtained from a level 60 (the highest level) mission on your Shadowlands Covenant Adventure Table. It will take some time to advance your followers and adventure ranking to a level where you're able to complete these.

name: Highwind Darkmane
description: This mount can be obtained from a level 60 (the highest level) mission on your Shadowlands Covenant Adventure Table. It will take some time to advance your followers and adventure ranking to a level where you're able to complete these.

name: Snowstorm
source: Battle.net Shop (US/EU)
description: This ice-studded polar bear was part of a Blizzard 30th Anniversary / BlizzConline bundle on the Blizzard Shop. It was part of the Heroic and Epic Packs. The offer ended 20 February, 2022.

name: Gilded Prowler
source: Adjutant Nikos in Hero's Rest, Bastion. Requires Exalted with The Ascended. Adjutant Mikaros in The Enclave, Oribos. Requires Exalted with The Ascended. Cost: 30000

name: Ascended Skymane
source: Cache of the Ascended (Ascended Council fight) in Bastion.
description:
The Ascended Skymane has a small chance of dropping from the Cache of the Ascended, which is the loot chest reward from defeating the Ascended Council in Bastion. Summoning the Council can be difficult as it requires ringing all five vespers in Bastion within a 5-minute period, which is not possible without help and/or alts at each vesper's location (players must be level 60). Farming this mount can therefore be difficult, and it may be hard to find enough interested players in the zone at any given time, so it could well be easiest to keep checking group finder for "Ascended" groups.The vespers become inactive 5 minutes after the first has been rung and they take 1-2 hours to reset, which is why group coordination is important. Once all five vespers have been rung, the Ascended Council will assemble at Aspirant's Awakening, in the south of Bastion (~ 53, 88). They can be a challenging fight.Vesper locations are:

Vesper of Courage: The Necrotic Wake, south of Temple of Courage (~ 33, 60)
Vesper of Humility: at the back of the Temple of Humility (~ 72, 39)
Vesper of Purity: at the back of Purity's Pinnacle (~ 64, 70)
Vesper of Wisdom: on the floating platform in The Eonian Archives (~ 39, 20)
Vesper of Loyalty: Exaltation Rise, in the north-east of Citadel of Loyalty (~ 32, 18)

See also the achievement Rallying Cry of the Ascended.

name: Amber Ardenmoth
source: Wild Hunt Supplies (Paragon reward).
description: There's a small chance of obtaining this mount in a Wild Hunt Supplies chest, which is a 'Paragon'-level reputation reward. To obtain one of these chests you must first reach Exalted reputation with The Wild Hunt faction in Shadowlands, and then continue performing daily activities for them. Every time you earn 10 000 rep with this faction above Exalted, you'll be eligible to receive another Wild Hunt Supplies chest from Aithlyn in the Heart of the Forest in Ardenweald.

name: Vibrant Flutterwing
source: Cortinarius in Ring, Ardenweald. Requires Revered with Marasmius. Cost: 5000
description: To unlock Marasmius rep you must have chosen the Night Fae covenant (Ardenweald) and complete the quest chain beginning with A Mycelial Network. You'll then unlock daily quests to advance your reputation.

name: Desertwing Hunter
description: This grey progenitor hawk can be created through Protoform Synthesis - a new crafting system in Zereth Mortis that requires a recipe and reagents. The recipe is taught by Schematic: Desertwing Hunter.

name: Pale Regal Cervid
source: Protoform Synthesis.
description: This grey progenitor stag can be created through Protoform Synthesis - a new crafting system in Zereth Mortis that requires a recipe and reagents. The recipe is taught by Schematic: Pale Regal Cervid.

name: Vespoid Flutterer
source: Protoform Synthesis.
description: This brass and grey progenitor wasp can be created through Protoform Synthesis - a new crafting system in Zereth Mortis that requires a recipe and reagents. The recipe is taught by Schematic: Vespoid Flutterer.

name: Deepstar Aurelid
source: Dropped by Hirukon in Zereth Mortis.
description: This progenitor jellyfish drops from Hirukon, a rare elite in Zereth Mortis. Hirukon is located underwater at the coordinates 52.2, 75.3 and initially cannot be attacked. You can coax it to rise to the surface by fishing near its location.

name: Battle-Hardened Aquilon
source: Duchess Mynx in Keeper's Respite, Korthia. Achievement: On the Offensive. Cost: 1000
description: This coppery aquilon can be purchased from Duchess Mynx in Korthia, but only after completing the achievement, On the Offensive. This is a meta-achievement for activities related to covenant assaults on the Maw in patch 9.1.

name: Battle-Bound Warhound
description: This mount has a small chance of dropping from any of the bosses that can appear in the Theater of Pain, except for Sabriel the Bonecleaver who is a special summons. There are four bosses in rotation on any given day and you have one chance of looting per boss per day.Possible bosses are: Azmogal, Devmorta, Xantuth the Blighted, Unbreakable Urtz, Ti'or, and Mistress Dyrax.

name: Bulbous Necroray
source: Hatched from a Necroray Egg in Tribute of the Ambitious or Tribute of the Duty-Bound.
description: This manaray mount is one of three that may hatch from a Necroray Egg, which is an extremely rare reward from the chests you receive for completing your Covenant's 'Calling' quests for Maldraxxus: see Tribute of the Ambitious or Tribute of the Duty-Bound. A new Calling quest is offered every day from your Covenant base in the Shadowlands, but Maldraxxus ones appear on average once every 4-5 days. Your Covenant affiliation doesn't appear to matter.Much like the Primal Egg in Pandaria, you must hold on to the Necroray Egg for three days, after which time it turns into an Oozing Necroray Egg which can be opened.

name: Infested Necroray
source: Hatched from a Necroray Egg in Tribute of the Ambitious or Tribute of the Duty-Bound.
description: This manaray mount is one of three that may hatch from a Necroray Egg, which is an extremely rare reward from the chests you receive for completing your Covenant's 'Calling' quests for Maldraxxus: see Tribute of the Ambitious or Tribute of the Duty-Bound. A new Calling quest is offered every day from your Covenant base in the Shadowlands, but Maldraxxus ones appear on average once every 4-5 days. Your Covenant affiliation doesn't appear to matter.Much like the Primal Egg in Pandaria, you must hold on to the Necroray Egg for three days, after which time it turns into an Oozing Necroray Egg which can be opened.

name: Pestilent Necroray
source: Hatched from a Necroray Egg in Tribute of the Ambitious or Tribute of the Duty-Bound.
description: This manaray mount is one of three that may hatch from a Necroray Egg, which is an extremely rare reward from the chests you receive for completing your Covenant's 'Calling' quests for Maldraxxus: see Tribute of the Ambitious or Tribute of the Duty-Bound. name: Bound Shadehound
description: The palest of the soulhunter mounts, the Bound Shadehound can be earned by anyone with access to Ve'nari in the Maw. The tasks required to craft this mount are complicated, but check out Wowhead's guide for an overview.

name: Corridor Creeper
source: Achievement: Twisting Corridors: Layer 8.
description: This shadowy, armoured hound is the reward for completing Twisting Corridors: Layer 8 in Torghast, Tower of the Damned - a special challenge dungeon added in Shadowlands.

name: Voracious Gorger
source: Achievement: Glory of the Shadowlands Hero.
description: This shiny anima gorger is the reward for the Mythic Dungeon meta-achievement in Shadowlands: Glory of the Shadowlands Hero.

name: Viridian Phase-Hunter
source: Battle.net Shop (US/EU)
description: This warp stalker mount can be purchased from the Battle.net Shop, but was originally available as part of the Deluxe Edition of Burning Crusade Classic.

name: Slime Serpent
source: Dropped by Curious Slime Serpent in Plaguefall (Heroic or Mythic).
description: To obtain this mount you must solo the Plaguefall dungeon on either Heroic or Mythic mode. Once you've defeated Margrave Stradama (the final boss), return to the location of Domina Venomblade (the third boss) and you should find that the Curious Slime Serpent in Plaguefall (H/M) has spawned nearby. You don't need to defeat this NPC, simply click on it to receive your mount.Thanks to the Secret Finders Discord for discovering how to obtain this mount.

name: Tazavesh Gearglider
source: Achievement: Fake It 'Til You Make It.
description: This mount is an achievement reward for the dungeon: Tazavesh, the Veiled Market. You have to defeat the encounter boss So'leah after being caught using forged credentials on Mythic Difficulty.

name: Serenade
source: Protoform Synthesis.
description: This gold and white progenitor snail can be created through Protoform Synthesis - a new crafting system in Zereth Mortis that requires a recipe and reagents. The recipe is taught by Schematic: Serenade.

name: Lord of the Corpseflies
source: Dropped by Fleshwing.
description: This stinging corpsefly can be obtained as rare loot from the rare, Fleshwing in Korthia. This beast spawns during a Necrolord-only vignette event called "Corpse Heap", located around 60, 43, south-east of Seeker's Quorum in Korthia. If the event is active then Cadaverous and friends will appear at this location and request that players fetch Restless Necromancer corpses and add them to the pile. Fleshwing spawns after 25 corpses have been added.

name: Soaring Razorwing
source: Archivist Roh-Suir in Keeper's Respite, Korthia. Requires Tier 6 with The Archivists' Codex. Cost: 5000

name: Vicious War Croaker
source: Deathguard Netharian in Orgrimmar. Cost: 1
description:
This formidable battle toad is the Horde rated PvP match reward for Shadowlands Season 3. To obtain this mount:

 Reach the PvP rank of Combatant during the Season. You can obtain this ranking by reaching a rating of 1400 by competing in 2v2, 3v3, or 10v10 arenas and battlegrounds.
 Once you've reached Combatant ranking you must win further matches in the same season, until your progress bar reaches 100% (2400 points). You'll then receive the mount.
 It appears the 1400 rating is specific to the match type you earned it in. For example, if you only earned the rating in 10v10 then you cannot progress towards the mount in 2v2 (until you also earn a 1400 rating in the latter).
 The number of matches required to fill your progress bar depends on the type of match. According to comments on Wowhead, by Rainewater, you require 40 wins in 10v10 (60 points / win),  80 wins in 3v3 (30 points / win), or  240 wins in 2v2 (10 points / win).
 For each subsequent time you fill your progress bar you'll receive a Vicious Saddle, which you may use to purchase older Vicious mounts .

name: Tamed Mauler
source: Supplies of the Archivist's Codex (Paragon reward).
description: From its database info, it appears that players have a small chance of obtaining this mount from a Supplies of the Archivist's Codex emissary chest, which is a 'Paragon'-level reputation reward chest. It is therefore likely that the method to obtain it will be to reach Tier 6 (maximum) reputation ranking with the Archivist's Codex faction, and then continue performing daily acitvities for them until you've earned enough reputation to be gifted another chest. Since the Archivist's Codex doesn't use the regular "Exalted" reputation scheme, we're unsure how much reputation will be required at this stage.

name: Beryl Shardhide
source: Death's Advance Supplies (Paragon reward).
description: There's a small chance of obtaining this mount in a Death's Advance Supplies chest, which is a 'Paragon'-level reputation reward. To obtain one of these chests you must first reach Exalted reputation with the Death's Advance faction in Korthia, and then continue performing daily activities for them. Every time you earn 10 000 rep with this faction above Exalted, you'll be eligible to receive a Death's Advance Supplies chest from Duchess Mynx at Keeper's Respite in Korthia.

name: Sapphire Skyblazer
source: Battle.net Shop (US/EU)
description: This brilliant blue phoenix is available from the Battle.net Shop, but was previously part of a 6-month subscription promotion.

name: Wandering Ancient
source: Poll: 'Choose the Next Shadowlands Mount'.
description: The Wandering Ancient's appearance changes with the seasons, much like the Blossoming Ancient companion pet. This mount was awarded for free to all players with Shadowlands activated on their account, and for those who purchased Shadowlands at a later date. Now that Shadowlands is part of the base purchase this is sadly no longer possible and the mount isn't included in purchases of later expansions.Before it was created, the concept for this mount was selected by a player poll, from a list of mount suggestions that Blizzard offered in 2020.

name: Vicious Warstalker
source: Necrolord Sipe in Stormwind City. Cost: 1
description: This progenitor wolf is the Alliance reward for Shadowlands rated PvP match season 4.

name: Vicious Warstalker
source: Deathguard Netharian in Orgrimmar. Cost: 1
description: This progenitor wolf is the Horde reward for Shadowlands rated PvP match season 4.

name: Noble Bruffalon
source: Sold by Storykeeper Ashekh in Morqut Village, The Forbidden Reach. Cost: 100 000
description: This bruffalon may be purchased from Storykeeper Ashekh in Morqut Village, The Forbidden Reach. While 100 000 Elemental Overflow seems daunting, it's much easier to obtain in this zone.

name: Amber Skitterfly
source: The Trading Post (seasonal)Cost: 500
description: This orange skitterfly has returned to the Trading Post for the month of September, 2026. Visit the Trading Post in your faction's capital city for more information.The Trader's Tender used to purchase this mount can be earned through a wide range of in-game activities listed in the "Traveler's Log" tab of your Adventure Guide. You also receive a bonus 500 Tender a month just by visiting the Trading Post and opening the chest.

name: Magmashell
description: To obtain this mount: first kill magma snails in The Waking Shores until you obtain an Empty Magma Shell. See the Wowhead link for a full list of NPCs and locations, but they're spread across volcanic regions of the zone.Once you've obtained the shell, journey to the Empowered Snail (actually a slug!) around 71.0, 25.0, in the east of the Scalecracker Keep region, in the north of the zone. Bring along as many health/protection buffs as you can. Enter the magma and interact with the snail to cast 'Embiggening Snail' on it. It takes 20 seconds to complete the cast, and during this time you'll be taking a lot of damage from the magma. Having a healer on hand will help, as will any class abilities that mitigate damage or heal over time. You'll need to use these just before interacting with the snail as you can't do anything once you start without interrupting the channel. After the channel is complete you'll receive this mount.

name: Liquid Hot Magma Slug
source: Sold by Xydan in Valdrakken. Cost: 5000
description: This molten slug can be only purchased during Dragonflight Timewalking events, added in Patch 12.0.7. Purchase requires Timewarped Badges, which are earned by running Timewalking Dungeons during the events, with a bonus 500 by handing in a quest item which drops at the end of your first dungeon for the event.

name: Vengeance
source: Dropped by Sylvanas Windrunner in Sanctum of Domination (Mythic).
description: This deathly dragonhawk drops from Sylvanas Windrunner in the Sanctum of Domination raid, on Mythic difficulty only. As with previous Mythic raid mounts, it is possible that it will be a guaranteed drop (for all party members) at the time the raid is current, but it'll become a rare drop once the next expansion is released.

name: Bestowed Thunderspine Packleader
source: Achievement: Centaur of Attention.
description: This green thunderspine is awarded when you complete the achievement, Centaur of Attention, which is the zone meta-achievement for the Ohn'ahran Plains. See the link for more information.

name: Hand of Bahmethra
source: Dropped by Tormentors of Torghast rares in The Maw.
description: This pale hand mount is a possible reward from a Tormentor's Cache. These caches are awarded by defeating the final boss in the Tormentors of Torghast event in The Maw. The events appear every two hours, with a rotating roster of 15 bosses.

name: Wild Hunt Legsplitter
description: This green gorm is a possible reward from a War Chest of the Wild Hunt, which is awarded for completing Night Fae Assaults in The Maw. These assaults are available to players of any covenant.

name: Undying Darkhound
source: Found in War Chest of the Undying Army.
description: This darkhound is a possible reward from a War Chest of the Undying Army. These chests appear to be awarded for Necrolord Assaults upon The Maw in Patch 9.1. These assaults can be completed by players of any covenant.

name: Skyskin Hornstrider
source: Brendormi. Cost: 150 3000
description: This blue hornstrider can be purchased from Brendormi in the Primalist Tomorrow, which can be reached via a portal in the Temporal Conflux in Thaldraszus. Essences of the Storm can be obtained from bosses and quests during Storm's Fury events in the same area.

name: Unchained Gladiator's Soul Eater
source: Retired
description: This malevolent shadow beast was the reward for Shadowlands PvP Arena Season 2.

name: Cartel Master's Gearglider
source: Dropped by So'leah in Tazavesh, the Veiled Market (Dungeon). / Chance loot from Reins of the Quantum Courser dropped by Chrono-Lord Deios in Dawn of the Infinite (dungeon)

name: Xy Trustee's Gearglider
source: Awarded by Someone Like Me.
description:
Earning this gearglider requires you to be at least Renown 8 with the Manaforge Vandals, which is earned by running the Manaforge Omega raid. To earn it you have to use three different 'Cartel Deal' items, crafted by Scribes (can be available on the Auction House), and locate thee associated 'dead drop' items inside the raid. Each Cartel faction unlocks a different dead drop item (see below).Note that earlier reports said you could only use one 'Deal' (and gain one dead drop) per week without using a cheat script, so it should require three weeks to obtain, but I found I was able to learn all three on the same day, gather the drops from the raid and earn the mount without using any cheat scripts. So maybe that has changed.

The cartel deals and associated dead drop locations are:
Deal: Cartel Ba - the Cartel Ba Dead Drop can be found after Plexus Sentinel (first boss). Follow the path to the right, and the drop (which looks like a small, grey cylinder) can be found by the right-hand phase warp teleporter that takes you to the centre ring of the raid.
Deal: Cartel Zo - the Cartel Zo Dead Drop can be found before Forgeweaver Araz and is the trickiest to obtain. It's located on a pipe around the wall inside Mana-Vent Aphis. You have to jump off the end of the walkway and onto the pipe without dying in the process.
Deal: Cartel Om - the Cartel Om Dead Drop can be found after Fractillus. Look behind the building after the boss, and you'll find the drop on a rock.

After locating all three drops, speak to Zo'turu just outside the raid and he'll offer you the quest Someone Like Me which awards the mount.
See the mount's Wowhead page for more information.

name: Vandal's Gearglider
source: Ba'choso in Shadow Point, K'aresh. Requires Renown Rank 8 with Manaforge Vandals. Cost: 500
description: Manaforge Vandals is a raid-only renown faction. The only way to increase your renown is by running the Manaforge Omega raid in K'aresh. Renown is initially gated to one level per week, but there are catch-up mechanics for later weeks (i.e. if you only begin on week 4 you can earn up to renown 4 with no time gating).

name: Ardenweald Wilderling
description: This mount is awarded upon reaching renown level 45 with the Night Fae Covenant.

name: Autumnal Wilderling
source: Elwyn in The Heart of the Forest, Ardenweald. Requires Renown 70 with Night Fae Covenant. Cost: 7500
description: This mount can be purchased upon reaching renown level 70 with the Night Fae Covenant.

name: Winter Wilderling
source: Sold by Duchess Mynx in Keeper's Respite, Korthia. Requires achievement On the Offensive. Cost: 1000
description: This snow-white wilderling can be purchased from Duchess Mynx in Korthia, but only after completing the achievement, On the Offensive. This is a meta-achievement for activities related to covenant assaults on the Maw in patch 9.1.

name: Summer Wilderling
source: Talon-Pierced Mawsworn Lockbox in Korthia.
description: This green wildering is rare loot from a probable Night Fae-only event in Korthia. If the event is active then Karras at Hope's Ascent will ask your Night Fae player to join them in a party to capture an Escaped Wilderling. During this event you must battle the Escaped Wilderling, reduce its health to 20%, and then mount it when prompted. During the subsequent flight you must use the right buttons when prompted until you subdue it and return it to camp. The reward for this event, a Talon-Pierced Mawsworn Lockbox, has a small chance of containing this mount.

name: Obsidian Gravewing
source: Chachi the Artiste in Sinfall, Revendreth. Requires Renown 70 with Venthyr Covenant. Cost: 7500
description: This mount can be purchased upon reaching renown level 70 with the Venthyr Covenant.

name: Sinfall Gravewing
description: This mount is awarded upon reaching renown level 45 with the Venthyr Covenant.

name: Pale Gravewing
source: Duchess Mynx in Keeper's Respite, Korthia. Achievement: On the Offensive. Cost: 1000
description: This pale-grey Revendreth gargoyle can be purchased from Duchess Mynx in Korthia, but only after completing the achievement, On the Offensive. This is a meta-achievement for activities related to covenant assaults on the Maw in patch 9.1.

name: Elysian Aquilon
description: This mount is awarded upon reaching renown level 45 with the Kyrian Covenant.

name: Forsworn Aquilon
source: Reward from quest Intact Aquilon Core. Quest started by item Intact Aquilon Core. Core dropped by Wild Worldcracker in Korthia.
description: The rare Wild Worldcracker is triggered by a Kyrian-only vignette event, Popo's Potion Patrol. When the event is active, the steward Popo appears at Keeper's Respite and requests help from Kyrian players to escort him while he delivers some potions. The Wild Worldcracker spawns at the culimation of this event, at approximately 47, 36. The aquilon mount isn't direct loot from the Wild Worldracker, but is instead a reward from a quest started by an Intact Aquilon Core which has a small chance of dropping from the rare.

name: Ascendant's Aquilon
source: Adjutant Galos in Elysian Hold, Bastion. Requires Renown 70 with Kyrian Covenant. Cost: 7500
description: This mount can be purchased upon reaching renown level 70 with the Kyrian Covenant.

name: Maldraxxian Corpsefly
description: This mount is awarded upon reaching renown level 45 with the Necrolord Covenant.

name: Regal Corpsefly
source: Su Zettai in Seat of the Primus, Maldraxxus. Requires Renown 70 with Necrolord Covenant. Cost: 7500
description: This mount can be purchased upon reaching renown level 70 with the Necrolord Covenant.

name: Battlefield Swarmer
source: Duchess Mynx in Keeper's Respite, Korthia. Achievement: On the Offensive. Cost: 1000
description: This green corpsefly with striking copper wings can be purchased from Duchess Mynx in Korthia, but only after completing the achievement, On the Offensive. This is a meta-achievement for activities related to covenant assaults on the Maw in patch 9.1.

name: Sanctum Gloomcharger
source: Dropped by The Nine in Sanctum of Domination.
description: This deathly steed can be obtained as rare loot from The Nine encounter in the Sanctum of Domination raid. It can drop from any difficulty level, including Raid Finder.

name: Soulbound Gloomcharger
source: Mysterious Gift from Ve'nari (Paragon reward).
description: Players have a small chance of obtaining this mount from a Mysterious Gift from Ve'nari, which is a Paragon-level reputation reward chest. You can obtain this chest by completing daily quests for Ve'nari in The Maw until you've earned maximum standard reputation, and then more boxes by continuing to repeat daily quests until you gain enough 'Paragon' level reputation for another.

name: Fallen Charger
source: Dropped by Fallen Charger in The Maw.
description: This deathly steed is noted as dropping from a rare elite NPC of the same name: the Fallen Charger in the Maw. We don't have any further information at this stage.

name: Hand of Nilganihmaht
description: The method of obtaining this striking golden hand seems to be complicated and hasn't yet been fully determined. It seems to involve the gathering and assembly of various rings, which are then placed on the Hand of Nilganihmaht. See Slumber's comment on the Nilganihmaht Control Ring Wowhead page for up-to-date findings.

name: Hand of Salaranga
source: Achievement: Breaking the Chains.
description: This black hand mount is the reward for completing the meta-achievement for activities in Korthia, added in patch 9.1.

name: Amber Shardhide
source: Duchess Mynx in Keeper's Respite, Korthia. Requires Revered with Death's Advance. Cost: 5000

name: Crimson Shardhide
source: Dropped by Malbog in Korthia.
description: The NPC that drops this mount: Malbog, must be spawned through a vignette event offered by Caretaker Kah-Dee at Keeper's Respite in Korthia. It can only be spawned if you can see the vignette star at Kah-Dee's location. Speak to Caretaker Kah-Dee and he'll offer you the assistance of his pet shardhide, Kah-Bear, in tracking down Malbog. Follow the tracks revealed by the pet until you reach some meat that can be interacted with. Click on the meat to reveal Malbog.

name: Darkmaul
description: There's a chance of receiving this gorgeous purple shardhide mount every time you go for a ride on his namesake NPC, Darkmaul, found just west of Mauler's Overlook in Korthia. To ride Darkmaul, you must first collect a Tasty Mawshroom, which can sometimes be found in Invasive Mawshroom lootable objects around Korthia. Once you get a Mawshroom, go speak to Darkmaul, and he'll offer to take you for a ride. Each time you ride him there's a chance you'll receive the mount, but it may take a few attempts.

name: Fierce Razorwing
source: Death's Advance Supplies (Paragon reward).
description: There's a small chance of obtaining this mount in a Death's Advance Supplies chest, which is a 'Paragon'-level reputation reward. To obtain one of these chests you must first reach Exalted reputation with the Death's Advance faction in Korthia, and then continue performing daily activities for them. Every time you earn 10 000 rep with this faction above Exalted, you'll be eligible to receive a Death's Advance Supplies chest from Duchess Mynx at Keeper's Respite in Korthia.

name: Garnet Razorwing
source: Dropped by Reliwik the Defiant in Vault of Secrets, Korthia.
description: To summon Reliwik the Defiant, who drops this mount, click on an Uncorrupted Slitherwing Egg that can be found around coordinates 56, 66.

name: Dusklight Razorwing
description: This purple razorwing mount can be earned by finding and returning ten Lost Razorwing Eggs to the Dusklight Matriarch's nest in Korthia. (Note that it only required six eggs during the PTR). The nest is located on the far western edge of the Windswept Aerie, around 25.8,51.2, and is obvious as it's the only nest that is interactive. Lost Razorwing Eggs can be obtained as loot from various anima-devouring invaders in Korthia, including Ravenous Gorgers, Melded Gorgers, Nimble Scavengers, Ravenous Scavengers, and Colossal Worldeaters. Check the Lost Razorwing Eggs Wowhead link for an up-to-date list. Note that you don't need to return all ten eggs at the same time.

name: Maelie, the Wanderer
source: Maelie the Wanderer in Korthia.
description: To obtain this mount, you need to find and interact with a wayward dreamrunner named Maelie the Wanderer six times. She'll appear at one location in Korthia on any given day, but switches locations daily so ask around in chat or look for groups where people have found her. It's also possible that on some days she simply doesn't appear (or is so well hidden that nobody has found her). Upon reassuring her, she returns home to Keeper's Respite and you'll have to wait until the next day before you can search for her again. Earning this mount will take a minimum of six days.

name: Sarge's Tale
source: Hearthstone Mercenaries Game Mode Promotion.
description: This cute rat is free when you try out the Mercenararies game mode in Blizzard's card game, Hearthstone. You need to complete the Mercenaries tutorial in Hearthstone and then start your first bounty to automatically unlock Sarge on your World of Warcraft account.Mercenaries game mode begins 12 Oct 2021.

name: Rampaging Mauler
source: Dropped by Konthrogz the Obliterator in Korthia.
description: This dark purple-black devourer has a small chance of dropping from the rare Konthrogz the Obliterator in Korthia. At the commencement of the event there is a zone-wide announcement: "A massive devourer tears an opening into Korthia." You then have to find the rift, which can appear at one of several locations, and defeat several waves of mobs before Konthrogz itself appears. At level, this rare will require a group to defeat it.

name: Bound Blizzard
source: Battle.net Shop (US/EU)
description: This flying blizzard mount is one of the in-game rewards for buying the BlizzCon Collection Legendary Pack from the Blizzard Shop, or for attending BlizzCon 2023 in person. Note that this mount is only part of the Legendary pack, not the Epic one.

name: Soultwisted Deathwalker
source: Sold by Lindormi <Mythic Keystones>Cost: 1
description: The Timelost Saddle required to purchase this mount is awarded to players after earning the current season's 'Keystone Myth' achievement, from obtaining a Mythic+ rating of 3400. It can be used to buy an achievement mount from any of the previous Mythic+ seasons, plus several previously-unused colour variants of these mounts. These are sold by Lindormi in the current expansion hub / capital. Currently, just one Saddle can be earned per season.This mount was originally a Keystone Master achievement reward for Shadowlands Season Two.

name: Val'sharah Hippogryph
source: Aridormi in Krasus' Landing, Dalaran (Broken Isles). Only available during Timewalking Cost: 5000
description: This dusky hippogryph can be only purchased during Legion Timewalking events. Purchase requires Timewarped Badges, which are earned by running Timewalking Dungeons during the events, with a bonus 500 by handing in a quest item which drops at the end of your first dungeon for the event.

name: Heartlight Vombata
source: Vilo in Haven, Zereth Mortis. Requires Exalted with The Enlightened. Cost: 5000
description: You may purchase this gold-and-grey vombata from Vilo once you reach Exalted with The Enlightened in Zereth Mortis.

name: Curious Crystalsniffer
source: Protoform Synthesis.
description: This bronze and black vombata can be created through Protoform Synthesis - a new crafting system in Zereth Mortis that requires a recipe and reagents. The recipe is taught by Schematic: Curious Crystalsniffer.

name: Darkened Vombata
source: Protoform Synthesis.
description: This dark vombata can be created through Protoform Synthesis - a new crafting system in Zereth Mortis that requires a recipe and reagents. The recipe is taught by Schematic: Darkened Vombata.

name: Adorned Vombata
source: Protoform Synthesis.
description: This red and grey vombata can be created through Protoform Synthesis - a new crafting system in Zereth Mortis that requires a recipe and reagents. The recipe is taught by Schematic: Adorned Vombata.

name: Deathrunner
source: Protoform Synthesis.
description: This red progenitor stag can be created through Protoform Synthesis - a new crafting system in Zereth Mortis that requires a recipe and reagents. The recipe is taught by Schematic: Deathrunner.

name: Sundered Zerethsteed
source: Protoform Synthesis.
description: This dark progenitor stag can be created through Protoform Synthesis - a new crafting system in Zereth Mortis that requires a recipe and reagents. The recipe is taught by Schematic: Sundered Zerethsteed.

name: Anointed Protostag
source: Vilo in Haven, Zereth Mortis. Requires Revered with The Enlightened. Cost: 5000
description: You may purchase this rosy-grey cervid from Vilo once you reach Revered with The Enlightened in Zereth Mortis.

name: Wen Lo, the River's Edge
source: Battle.net Shop (US/EU)
description: Celebrating the Year of the Tiger (2022), this watery blue tiger can be purchased from the Blizzard Shop. It was originally part of a 6-month subscription promotion.

name: Soaring Spelltome
source: Achievement: A Tour of Towers.
description: This mount is awarded to players who complete every unique challenge during the special Legion Timewalking version of the Mage Tower in the Broken Isles. Legion Timewalking was added in Patch 9.1.5.

name: Forged Spiteflyer
source: Protoform Synthesis.
description: This red and silver progenitor wasp can be created through Protoform Synthesis - a new crafting system in Zereth Mortis that requires a recipe and reagents. The recipe is taught by Schematic: Forged Spiteflyer.

name: Buzz
source: Protoform Synthesis.
description: This silver-black progenitor wasp can be created through Protoform Synthesis - a new crafting system in Zereth Mortis that requires a recipe and reagents. The recipe is taught by Schematic: Buzz.

source: Protoform Synthesis.
description: This bronze and black progenitor wasp can be created through Protoform Synthesis - a new crafting system in Zereth Mortis that requires a recipe and reagents. The recipe is taught by Schematic: Bronzewing Vespoid.

source: Protoform Synthesis.
description: This black progenitor hawk can be created through Protoform Synthesis - a new crafting system in Zereth Mortis that requires a recipe and reagents. The recipe is taught by Schematic: Mawdapted Raptora.

name: Raptora Swooper
source: Protoform Synthesis.
description: This red progenitor hawk can be created through Protoform Synthesis - a new crafting system in Zereth Mortis that requires a recipe and reagents. The recipe is taught by Schematic: Raptora Swooper.

name: Bronze Helicid
description: This bronze progenitor snail can be created through Protoform Synthesis - a new crafting system in Zereth Mortis that requires a recipe and reagents. The recipe is taught by Schematic: Bronze Helicid.

name: Unsuccessful Prototype Fleetpod
source: Protoform Synthesis.
description: This silver and white progenitor snail can be created through Protoform Synthesis - a new crafting system in Zereth Mortis that requires a recipe and reagents. The recipe is taught by Schematic: Unsuccessful Prototype Fleetpod.

source: Protoform Synthesis.
description: This pink and grey progenitor snail can be created through Protoform Synthesis - a new crafting system in Zereth Mortis that requires a recipe and reagents. The recipe is taught by Schematic: Scarlet Helicid.
