source: Protoform Synthesis.
description: This brass and grey progenitor spider can be created through Protoform Synthesis - a new crafting system in Zereth Mortis that requires a recipe and reagents. The recipe is taught by Schematic: Genesis Crawler.

name: Tarachnid Creeper
source: Protoform Synthesis.
description: This dark progenitor spider can be created through Protoform Synthesis - a new crafting system in Zereth Mortis that requires a recipe and reagents. The recipe is taught by Schematic: Tarachnid Creeper.

name: Ineffable Skitterer
source: Protoform Synthesis.
description: This red and dark grey progenitor spider can be created through Protoform Synthesis - a new crafting system in Zereth Mortis that requires a recipe and reagents. The recipe is taught by Schematic: Ineffable Skitterer.

name: Wastewarped Deathwalker
source: Sold by Lindormi <Mythic Keystones>Cost: 1
description: The Timelost Saddle required to purchase this mount is awarded to players after earning the current season's 'Keystone Myth' achievement, from obtaining a Mythic+ rating of 3400. It can be used to buy an achievement mount from any of the previous Mythic+ seasons, plus several previously-unused colour variants of these mounts. These are sold by Lindormi in the current expansion hub / capital. Currently, just one Saddle can be earned per season.This mount was originally a Keystone Master achievement reward for Shadowlands Season Three.

name: Divine Kiss of Ohn'ahra
description:
This mount is a reward from the quest A Whispering Breeze. To be offered this quest, you must first have completed several pre-requisites:
Attain renown 25 with Maruuk Centaur and complete The Highest Honor (which is a simple turn-in quest for reaching renown 25).
You must have completed the quest chain for Lizi.
You must have collected 3 Stolen Breath of Ohn'ahra, which is a chance drop from Balakar Khan, the last boss in The Nokhud Offensive dungeon, on any difficulty level.
After you've complete these prerequisites, speak to Godoloto, north-west of Ohn'iri Springs in the Ohn'ahran Plains and receive the quest.

name: Iskaara Trader's Ottuk
source: Sold by Tattukiaka in Iskaara. Cost: 1 1
description: The items used to purchase this mount are two amulets that can be dropped by bosses in the Vault of the Incarnates raid in Dragonflight. Terros's Captive Core is dropped by Terros and Eye of the Vengeful Hurricane is dropped by Dathea, Ascended. Both amulets appear to drop in Raid Finder mode and above.

name: Goldplate Bufonid
source: Protoform Synthesis.
description: This gold and grey progenitor toad can be created through Protoform Synthesis - a new crafting system in Zereth Mortis that requires a recipe and reagents. The recipe is taught by Schematic: Goldplate Bufonid.

name: Shimmering Aurelid
source: Achievement: Glory of the Sepulcher Raider.
description: This progenitor jellyfish is the meta-achievement reward for the Sepulcher of the First Ones raid in Zereth Mortis.

name: Depthstalker
source: The Trading Post (seasonal)Cost: 600
description: This striking pale aurelid has returned to the Trading Post for the month of September, 2026. Visit the Trading Post in your faction's capital city for more information.The Trader's Tender used to purchase this mount can be earned through a wide range of in-game activities listed in the "Traveler's Log" tab of your Adventure Guide. You also receive a bonus 500 Tender a month just by visiting the Trading Post and opening the chest.

name: Cryptic Aurelid
source: Achievement: From A to Zereth.
description: This dark red and grey ornamented aurelid is the reward for the achievement From A to Zereth, which involves completing a number of exploration and participation achievements in Zereth Mortis.

name: Carcinized Zerethsteed
description: This versatile machine can convert between a walking and a flying unit. It is the Ahead of the Curve reward for the Sepulcher of the First Ones and will no longer be obtainable once Dragonflight launches. To obtain the Carcinized Zerethsteed, you must defeat The Jailer fight in Heroic mode or higher. You receive an item that begins a quest that rewards this mount.

name: Liberated Slyvern
source: Dropped by Breezebiter in The Azure Span.
description: This mount has a low chance of dropping as loot from Breezebiter, a rare in The Azure Span at approximately 27,46.

name: Tangled Dreamweaver
source: Battle.net Shop (US/EU)
description: Now purchasable from the Battle.net Shop, this mount was originally part of the Dragonflight Heroic and Epic edition promotions.

name: Highland Drake
description: This drake is the third configurable mount granted to you as you explore the Dragon Isles. You earn it by completing the main storyline of The Azure Span, which is the third questing zone of the continent.This mount is heavily customizable at any Rostrum of Transformation, with many of the appearances obtainable from Dragonflight content. See Wowhead's Highland Drake Customization Guide for more information.

name: Colossal Soulshredder Mawrat
source: Achievement: Flawless Master (Layer 16).
description: This dark yellow mawrat is the reward for completing the Flawless Master (Layer 16) achievement. This requires you to complete a Flawless run on layer 16 in each wing of Torghast, Tower of the Damned.

name: Colossal Umbrahide Mawrat
description: This purple mawrat is a rare drop from Torghast bosses on layers 13 and above.

name: Colossal Ebonclaw Mawrat
source: Achievement: The Jailer's Gauntlet: Layer 4.
description: This dark maroon mawrat is awarded by completing Layer 4 of The Jailer's Gauntlet in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.

name: Lightforged Ruinstrider
description: This lightforged talbuk is the class mount for Lightforged Draenei paladins.

name: Patient Bufonid
description: This dark progenitor toad is the reward of a multi-day quest chain in Zereth Mortis. The quest chain starts with The Burrowed Bufonid given by Avna at Haven. The chain involves speaking to Avna daily and fetching the items she asks of you.

name: Prototype Leaper
source: Protoform Synthesis.
description: This bronze and black progenitor toad can be created through Protoform Synthesis - a new crafting system in Zereth Mortis that requires a recipe and reagents. The recipe is taught by Schematic: Prototype Leaper.

name: Russet Bufonid
source: Protoform Synthesis.
description: This red and grey progenitor toad can be created through Protoform Synthesis - a new crafting system in Zereth Mortis that requires a recipe and reagents. The recipe is taught by Schematic: Russet Bufonid. This schematic has a small chance of being contained in Enlightened Broker Supplies which is a Paragon reputation reward cache in Zereth Mortis. Every time you earn 10 000 rep with this faction above Exalted, you'll be eligible to receive another Supplies cache.

name: Cosmic Gladiator's Soul Eater
source: Retired
description: This russet shadow beast was the reward for Shadowlands PvP Arena Season 3.

name: Magenta Cloud Serpent
source: The Trading Post (seasonal)Cost: 500
description: This stunning purple cloud serpent has returned to the Trading Post for the month of September, 2026. Visit the Trading Post in your faction's capital city for more information.The Trader's Tender used to purchase this mount can be earned through a wide range of in-game activities listed in the "Traveler's Log" tab of your Adventure Guide. You also receive a bonus 500 Tender a month just by visiting the Trading Post and opening the chest.

name: Crusty Crawler
source: The Trading Post (seasonal)Cost: 700
description: This intrepid blue crab has returned to the Trading Post for the month of September, 2026. Visit the Trading Post in your faction's capital city for more information.The Trader's Tender used to purchase this mount can be earned through a wide range of in-game activities listed in the "Traveler's Log" tab of your Adventure Guide. You also receive a bonus 500 Tender a month just by visiting the Trading Post and opening the chest.

name: Quawks
source: The Trading Post (seasonal)Cost: 750
description: This regal purple parrot has returned to the Trading Post for the month of September, 2026. Visit the Trading Post in your faction's capital city for more information.The Trader's Tender used to purchase this mount can be earned through a wide range of in-game activities listed in the "Traveler's Log" tab of your Adventure Guide. You also receive a bonus 500 Tender a month just by visiting the Trading Post and opening the chest.

name: Jigglesworth Sr.
source: Sold by Mirioszin in The Parting Glass, Valdrakken, Thaldraszus. Cost: 3
description: This slimey saber mount has returned in Dragonflight Season 4 and can be purchased from Mirioszin in The Parting Glass in Valdrakken. This inn is located on the west side of the Bronze Enclave. The mount can be purchased for 3 Antique Bronze Bullion which is a new currency that can be earned from Dragonflight Season 4 'Awakened' raids.Originally, this mount was a reward for completing all three Shadowlands raids (Castle Nathria, Sanctum of Domination, and Sepulcher of the First Ones) while they had the Season 4 'Fated' affix, on Normal difficulty or higher.The opportunity to obtain this mount will probably end once The War Within launches.

name: Ash'adar, Harbinger of Dawn
source: The Trading Post (seasonal)Cost: 900
description: The appearance of this spectacular saber mount changes, depending on whether it's currently day (gold) or night (silver).Ash'adar has returned to the Trading Post for the month of September, 2026. Visit the Trading Post in your faction's capital city for more information.The Trader's Tender used to purchase this mount can be earned through a wide range of in-game activities listed in the "Traveler's Log" tab of your Adventure Guide. You also receive a bonus 500 Tender a month just by visiting the Trading Post and opening the chest.In China, this mount was also awarded as part of a special NetEase promotion for returning players when World of Warcraft returned to China during The War Within pre-patch.

name: Coral-Stalker Waveray
source: Razer World of Warcraft Bundle.
description: This striking lime green & blue fathom ray is part of a Razer promotion bundle for World of Warcraft's 20th Anniversary. While stocks last, if you purchase specific items from Razer (including select mice, headphone, and keyboard) you'll receive a bundle of in-game items, including both this mount and the Iron Skyreaver. See the Razer World of Warcraft 20th Anniversary page for more information. This is a limited-time offer and not all Razer items award this bundle, so double check their website before purchasing.

name: Heartbond Lupine
source: Protoform Synthesis.
description: This progenitor wolf can be created through Protoform Synthesis - a new crafting system in Zereth Mortis that requires a recipe and reagents. The recipe is taught by Schematic: Heartbond Lupine. It can fly, oddly, by swimming through the air!

name: Nether-Gorged Greatwyrm
source: Battle.net Shop (US/EU)
description: This cerulean flying serpent is available as a standalone mount purchase in the Battle.net Shop. It was previously part of a subscription promotion.

name: Savage Green Battle Turtle
source: The Trading Post (seasonal)Cost: 500
description: This armoured turtle has returned to the Trading Post for the month of September, 2026. Visit the Trading Post in your faction's capital city for more information.The Trader's Tender used to purchase this mount can be earned through a wide range of in-game activities listed in the "Traveler's Log" tab of your Adventure Guide. You also receive a bonus 500 Tender a month just by visiting the Trading Post and opening the chest.

name: Armored Siege Kodo
source: Battle.net Shop (US/EU)
description: Currently, this mount only comes in a bundle with its matching Crushhoof companion pet.

name: Colossal Plaguespew Mawrat
source: Dropped by Rhuv, Gorger of Ruin in Endless Sands, Zereth Mortis.
description: This green mawrat drops from Rhuv, Gorger of Ruin, a rare-spawn in the Endless Sands of Zereth Mortis. Rhuv serves as the mount of Iska, Outrider of Ruin, but Iska only attacks once Rhuv is defeated, and it is Rhuv that can drop the mount.

name: Colossal Wraithbound Mawrat
description: This teal-grey mawrat is marked as dropping from Mawsworn Supply Chests in Zereth Mortis. These chests can spawn in a number of different locations in the zone (follow the link for a map on Wowhead), but we haven't yet confirmed if it's simply a low-chance drop from any of them.

name: Armored Golden Pterrordax
source: The Trading Post (seasonal)Cost: 500
description: This shining gold pterrordax has returned to the Trading Post for the month of September, 2026. Visit the Trading Post in your faction's capital city for more information.The Trader's Tender used to purchase this mount can be earned through a wide range of in-game activities listed in the "Traveler's Log" tab of your Adventure Guide. You also receive a bonus 500 Tender a month just by visiting the Trading Post and opening the chest.

name: Zereth Overseer
source: Dropped by The Jailer in Sepulcher of the First Ones (Mythic).
description: This elegant, gold flying unit has a low chance of dropping from The Jailer in the Sepulcher of the First Ones raid, on Mythic difficulty only.

name: Winding Slitherdrake
description: This sinuous drake is the fifth configurable mount granted to you as you explore the Dragon Isles. It is awarded to you after you progress through much of the storyline of Zaralek Cavern, culminating in the quest, Worst of the Worst.This mount is heavily customizable at any Rostrum of Transformation, with many of the appearances obtainable from Dragonflight content. See Wowhead's Winding Slitherdrake Customization Guide for more information.

name: Renewed Proto-Drake
description: This proto-drake is the first configurable mount granted to you as you explore the Dragon Isles. You earn it part of the way through the main storyline of The Waking Shores, which is the first questing zone of the continent.This mount is heavily customizable at any Rostrum of Transformation, with many of the appearances obtainable from Dragonflight content. See Wowhead's Renewed Proto-Drake Customization Guide for more information.

name: Windborne Velocidrake
description: This wyvern-drake is the second configurable mount granted to you as you explore the Dragon Isles. You earn it by completing the main storyline of the Ohn'ahran Plains, which is the second questing zone of the continent.This mount is heavily customizable at any Rostrum of Transformation, with many of the appearances obtainable from Dragonflight content. See Wowhead's Windborne Velocidrake Customization Guide for more information.

name: Cliffside Wylderdrake
description: This wind rider-like wylderdrake is the fourth configurable mount granted to you as you explore the Dragon Isles. You earn it by completing the main storyline of Thaldrazsus, which is the fourth and final main questing zone of the continent.This mount is heavily customizable at any Rostrum of Transformation, with many of the appearances obtainable from Dragonflight content. See Wowhead's Cliffside Wylderdrake Customization Guide for more information.

name: Jade, Bright Foreseer
source: Battle.net Shop (US/EU)
description: Celebrating the Year of the Rabbit (2023), this watery blue bunny is available through the Battle.net Shop.

name: Cerulean Marsh Hopper
source: The Trading Post (seasonal)
description: This rich blue loa toad will be obtainable from the Trading Post in an upcoming month. Unfortunately, we can't say when exactly, as Blizzard don't announce Trading Post offerings ahead of time.

name: Amalgam of Rage
source: Diablo IV - Any Edition.
description: This mount is a Diablo IV cross-promotion. Pre-order the Standard Edition of Diablo IV (or higher!) and you'll receive this mount in World of Warcraft. There's no indication that this mount is exclusive to pre-orders, and it'll quite likely still be available once Diablo IV launches, but we can't that for sure at this stage.

name: Grimhowl
description: This beautiful darkhound model is the reward for a Dark Iron Dwarf heritage questline, added in Patch 9.2.5. This questline is only offered to characters who achieve Heritage of the Dark Iron, which requires reaching level 50 as a Dark Iron Dwarf without any boosts or race-changing. However this mount appears to be usable by other Alliance characters on your account. See Wowhead's Dark Iron Dwarf Heritage Guide for more information.

name: Eternal Gladiator's Soul Eater
source: Retired
description: This bronzed shadow beast was the reward for Shadowlands PvP Arena Season 4.

name: Elusive Emerald Hawkstrider
description: This green hawkstrider was added to the database during Burning Crusade and finally became available in Patch 9.2.5! It's one of the rewards from a special heritage quest chain for Blood Elves. The chain beings with Liadrin in Oribos and is only offered if your Blood Elf character is Exalted with Silvermoon City.

name: Tuskarr Shoreglider
source: Wrath of the Lich King Classic Northrend Epic Upgrade Edition.
description: This glider mount is for use in retail WoW, but comes from purchasing the "Northrend Epic Upgrade" Edition of Wrath of the Lich King Classic (US / EU).Players who purchase the Epic Upgrade edition will also receive an equivalent glider mount for exclusive use in WotLK Classic: the Kalu’ak Whalebone Glider. The latter mount won't be available for use in the retail game.

name: Subterranean Magmammoth
source: Sold by Saccratros in Loamm, Zaralek Cavern. Cost: 100
description: You require 100 Coveted Baubles to purchase this brilliant blue magmammoth. These can be obtained from Spinsoa (standing right next to Saccratros) for one Coveted Bauble per Unearthed Fragrant Coin. The latter can be obtained from various world quests and events in Zaralek Cavern.

name: Loyal Magmammoth
source: Yries Lightfingers in The Waking Shores.
description:
We're still unsure how you obtain this magmammoth mount, but so far we know you need to:

Obtain 1 Netherforged Lavaproof Boots and 1 Sturdy Obsidian Glasses. We yet don't know where you get these two items.
Use the obtained boots and glasses to purchase a Magmammoth Harness from Yries Lightfingers at the Obsidian Throne in The Waking Shores.
Find a Qalashi magmammoth that can be liberated and ridden. We haven't confirmed which mammoth this is, but there's a good chance it's the Tame Magmammoth. Ride the magmammoth and apply the harness.

name: Stormtouched Bruffalon
source: Achievement: Across the Isles.
description: You can obtain this night blue bruffalon by completing the achievement, Across the Isles, which is the meta-meta-achievement for a series of other meta-achievements involving aiding various factions and zones of the Dragon Isles. See the link for more information.

name: Tamed Skitterfly
source: Granpap Whiskers in Dragonscale Basecamp. Requires Renown Rank 25 with Dragonscale Expedition. Cataloger Jakes in Dragonscale Basecamp. Requires Renown Rank 25 with Dragonscale Expedition. Cost: 5 20 750
description: There are two different types of feathers required for the purchase of this mount. Refer to the following Wowhead links for Iridescent Plume and Contoured Fowlfeather to find suitable areas to farm them.

name: Azure Skitterfly
source: Granpap Whiskers in Dragonscale Basecamp. Requires Renown Rank 25 with Dragonscale Expedition. Cataloger Jakes in Dragonscale Basecamp. Requires Renown Rank 25 with Dragonscale Expedition. Cost: 5 20 750
description: There are two different types of feathers required for the purchase of this mount. Refer to the following Wowhead links for Iridescent Plume and Contoured Fowlfeather to find suitable areas to farm them.

name: Verdant Skitterfly
description: This green skitterfly has a chance to appear in loot from Expedition Scout's Packs which can be found widely in the Waking Shores and other parts of the Dragon Isles, and will show up on your minimap. According to the game database, the mount can only be looted once you've reached renown Rank 25 with the Dragonscale Expedition, though the packs normally don't require any renown to open and loot.

name: Bestowed Sandskimmer
source: Achievement: Closing Time.
description: This golden skitterfly is awarded when you complete the achievement, Closing Time, which is a meta-achievement for aiding the Timewalkers / Time Rifts. See the link for more information.

name: Ancient Salamanther
description: This green salamanther, without gills or fins, is a rare drop from most or all of the rare NPCs in the Forbidden Reach.

name: Coralscale Salamanther
source: Achievement: Into the Storm.
description: This pink salamanther is awarded when you complete the achievement, Into the Storm, which is a meta-achievement for Primal Storm events in the Dragon Isles. See the link for more information.

name: Stormhide Salamanther
source: Sold by Mythressa in Valdrakken. Cost: 2000
description: This purple salamanther is purchased with Elemental Overflow, which can be looted from a number of Primalist and elemental NPCs in the Dragon Isles. See the Wowhead link above for a list.

name: Seething Slug
description: To obtain this mount, you have to find and click on three Seething Orbs that may be found randomly at random locations around Zaralek Cavern and then open the Seething Cache located at coordinates 32.33 39.35. Each Seething Orb gives you a stack of Insidious Insight and you need three stacks to be able to see and open the chest. However if another player opens the chest before you then all your stacks will be removed. You'll also lose your stacks if you leave the zone and also quite likely if you hope to another realm. Yes, this is a truly awful 'puzzle'.The number of possible spawn locations for the Seething Orbs is too many to list here, but please see the comments section on the Wowhead page for this mount for a list.

name: Shellack
source: Achievement: Glory of the Dragonflight Hero.
description: This red magma snail is the reward for the Mythic Dungeon meta-achievement in Dragonflight: Glory of the Dragonflight Hero.

name: Gooey Snailemental
description: You can create this handsome blue snail mount by combining 50 Leftover Elemental Slime. This reagent drops from the final boss of Froststone Vault Primal Storm events in the Forbidden Reach. This event occurs periodically throughout the day, and a blue skull appears at its location (just outside Froststone Vault) when it's active. You'll only obtain a small number of Elemental Slimes each event (possibly none!), but it's possible to repeat the event multiple times a day.

name: Scrappy Worldsnail
source: Sold by Dealer Vexil in The Waking Shores. Cost: 1000
description: This bright yellow magma snail can be purchased from Dealer Vexil in the Waking Shores, for 1000 Magmotes. In order to farm this item you need to complete a number of prerequisites. For now, see Wowhead's guide on how to farm Magmotes.

name: Bestowed Trawling Mammoth
source: Achievement: Army of the Fed.
description: This grey mammoth is awarded when you complete the achievement, Army of the Fed which is a meta-achievement for the Iskaara Tuskarr in the Azure Span. See the link for more information.

name: Mossy Mammoth
description:
This green-haired mammoth can be obtained in the Forbidden Reach by progressively combining a number of items that can be obtained from Zskera Vaults. You unlock these vaults during the zone intro quest chain, and obtain vault keys mostly from defeating rare NPCs in the zone.The item sequence is:
Obtain a Scrap of Black Dragonscales and a Strange Petrified Orb from chests in the Vaults, and combine them to create a Particularly Ordinary Egg.

Obtain a Drop of Blue Dragon Magic from the Vaults and combine it with the Particularly Ordinary Egg to form a Magically Altered Egg.

Obtain Everburning Ruby Coals from the Vaults and combine it with the Magically Altered Egg to form an Egg of Unknown Contents.

Obtain a Speck of Bronze Dust from the Vaults and combine it with the Egg of Unknown Contents to form a Sleeping Ancient Mammoth.

Obtain an Emerald Dragon Brooch from the Vaults and combine it with the Sleeping Ancient Mammoth to create your Mossy Mammoth.
Note that the Speck of Bronze Dust and Emerald Dragon Brooch seem to come from much later vaults, which will require clearing one vault a week for several weeks.

name: Plainswalker Bearer
source: Maruuk Hunt Spoils.
description:
There's a small chance of finding this mount in your first Maruuk Hunt Spoils cache of the week, which can be awarded after completing a Grand Hunt in the Dragon Isles.

To be eligible to participate in a Grand Hunt, you have to reach Renown Rank 5 with the Maruuk Centaur. Then keep an eye out for Grand Hunts, which will be marked on the Dragon Isles zone maps. The Hunts cycle through the different zones.

name: Explorer's Stonehide Packbeast
source: Provisioner Aristta in Azerothian Archives, Thaldraszus. Cost: 20000
description: The Mysterious Fragments required to purchase this mount can be obtained through Azerothian Archives events in the Dragon Isles. See Wowhead's guide for more information. Provisioner Aristta can be found inside the Azerothian Archives tower, on a precarious, low-hanging isthmus at the north end of Algeth'ar Academy (62, 31). An introductory Azerothian Archives quest, which leads you to their headquarters, can be picked up from a banner hanging on the wall of The Roasted Ram pub in Valdrakken.

name: Lizi, Thunderspine Tramper
description: To be eligible for the quest chain that awards you Lizi, you must be at renown Rank 9 with the Maruuk Centaur. The quest chain is a standard format where you have to complete quest tasks for a number of days and receive the mount at the end.In this case, Initiate Radiya at Ohn'iri Springs will offer you tasks for 5 days (they can be non-consecutive days!), starting with To Tame A Thunderspine on Day 1.

name: Raging Magmammoth
source: Achievement: Glory of the Vault Raider.
description: This fiery red magmammoth is the meta-achievement reward for the Vault of the Incarnates raid in Thaldraszus.

name: Renewed Magmammoth
description:
You can create this yellow magmammoth mount by combining 20 Charred Elemental Remains. These drop from two sources:
The Flame Lieutenant final boss from a Dreamsurge portal event. Dreamsurge portals occur every 30 minutes in the current Dragon Isles Dreamsurge zone. Your Dragon Isles continent map displays a blue-green icon over the current Dreamsurge zone, and hovering your mouse over the same icon on the zone map will show you the time remaining until the next portal. When it's up, the location of the portal is marked on the zone map by a flame icon.NPCs that spawn from Waking Dream portals that can be found sporadically in the current Dreamsurge zone. These fiery portals occur sporadically around the zone and can be difficult to find, though their red-orange colour makes them stand out.

name: Bestowed Ottuk Vanguard
source: Achievement: Flight Club.
description: This black war ottuk is awarded when you complete the achievement, Flight Club, which is a meta-achievement for Valdrakken Accord-related activities. See the link for more information.

name: Brown War Ottuk
source: Tatto in Iskaara. Requires Renown Rank 30 with Iskaara Tuskarr. Cost: 5 5 1000

name: Otterworldly Ottuk Carrier
source: Achievement: Thanks for the Carry!. Achievement: Thanks for the Carry!.
description: This flying, spectral ottuk is the reward for collecting 500 mounts that are usable by any single character on your account.

name: Yellow War Ottuk
source: Tatto in Iskaara. Requires Renown Rank 30 with Iskaara Tuskarr. Cost: 5 5 1000

name: Otto
source: Quest: The Way to an Otto's Heart.
description:
This otter mount is the reward for the quest, The Way to an Otto's Heart, but getting to that point is... kind of nuts.
First, obtain Aquatic Shades which have a 50% chance of appearing in an Immaculate Sac of Swog Treasures, purchased from The Great Swog in the Ohn'ahran Plains at 82.3, 73.2. You'll need a Gold Coin of the Isles to purchase a sac, and these are super-rare items that can be obtained through fishing, or can be traded up from lesser-quality coins - see the Wowhead link for more information.
Once you've obtained your Aquatic Shades, head to the Bubble Bath dive bar in the waters just north of the Obsidian Citadel, around 19.6 36.5 in The Waking Shores (the area above the bar is called the Hissing Grotto). By the bar, locate and stand on a small, 3x3 disco-style dance floor, wear your glasses and dance for 5 minutes. You'll know you have the right spot if you receive the debuff, Dance, Dance 'Til You're Dead which tracks your dancing time.
You'll know your dancing is complete when you are teleported. In your new location you'll see an Empty Fish Barrel, which you should pick up. You need to fill the fish barrel with 100 Frigid Floe Fish, 25 Calamitous Carp, and 1 Kingfin, the Wise Whiskerfish. These fish can be obtained by fishing around the Dragon Isles - see the Wowhead links for location info.Once you've filled your barrel, head to the Hissing Grotto, around 20.3 39.7 and place your barrel on the ground. Otto should then appear with the quest, The Way to an Otto's Heart, granting you the mount.

name: Brown Scouting Ottuk
source: Tatto in Iskaara. Requires Renown Rank 25 with Iskaara Tuskarr. Cost: 2 2 750

name: Ivory Trader's Ottuk
source: Sold by Tattukiaka in Iskaara. Cost: 1 1 1
description: The items used to purchase this mount are three rings that can be dropped by bosses in three Dragonflight dungeons. Thunderous Downburst Ring is dropped by The Raging Tempest in The Nokhud Offensive, Unstable Arcane Loop is dropped by Leymor in The Azure Vault, and Platinum Star Band is dropped by Vexamus in Algeth'ar Academy and is also an optional reward from the quest, The Algeth'ar Academy. These rings appear to drop in Normal mode and above.

name: Yellow Scouting Ottuk
source: Tatto in Iskaara. Requires Renown Rank 25 with Iskaara Tuskarr. Cost: 2 2 750

name: Crimson Gladiator's Drake
source: Retired
description: This mount was the reward for Dragonflight PvP Arena Season 1.Recipients also receive the glyph, Highland Drake: Embodiment of the Crimson Gladiator so they can add its appearance to the customization options for their Highland Drake mount.

name: Telix the Stormhorn
source: Battle.net Shop (US/EU)
description: This storm beetle was part of a special 12-month subscription, for a limited-time in 2022. We don't know if it'll be offered again in the future.

name: Guardian Vorquin
source: Treysh in The Forbidden Reach. Tethalash in Valdrakken. Cost: 80
description: These Dragon Isles windsteeds are the favoured mounts of the Dracthyr playable race. They can be purchased by Dracthyr players in either The Forbidden Reach (the Dracthyr starting zone) or in Valdrakken.Unlike other racial mounts, there's currently no Dracthyr-related reputation faction, so these mounts can never be purchased by players of other races.

name: Swift Armored Vorquin
source: Treysh in The Forbidden Reach. Requires Dracthyr character. Tethalash in Valdrakken. Requires Dracthyr character. Cost: 80
description: These Dragon Isles windsteeds are the favoured mounts of the Dracthyr playable race. They can be purchased by Dracthyr players in either The Forbidden Reach (the Dracthyr starting zone) or in Valdrakken.Unlike other racial mounts, there's currently no Dracthyr-related reputation faction, so these mounts can never be purchased by players of other races.

source: Treysh in The Forbidden Reach. Requires Dracthyr character. Tethalash in Valdrakken. Requires Dracthyr character. Cost: 80
description: These Dragon Isles windsteeds are the favoured mounts of the Dracthyr playable race. They can be purchased by Dracthyr players in either The Forbidden Reach (the Dracthyr starting zone) or in Valdrakken.Unlike other racial mounts, there's currently no Dracthyr-related reputation faction, so these mounts can never be purchased by players of other races.

source: Treysh in The Forbidden Reach. Requires Dracthyr character. Tethalash in Valdrakken. Requires Dracthyr character. Cost: 80
description: These Dragon Isles windsteeds are the favoured mounts of the Dracthyr playable race. They can be purchased by Dracthyr players in either The Forbidden Reach (the Dracthyr starting zone) or in Valdrakken.Unlike other racial mounts, there's currently no Dracthyr-related reputation faction, so these mounts can never be purchased by players of other races.

name: Bestowed Ohuna Spotter
source: Achievement: Wake Me Up.
description: This dark brown ohuna is awarded when you complete the achievement, Wake Me Up, which is the meta-achievement for the Dragonscale Expedition and the Waking Shores zone. See the link for more information.

name: Duskwing Ohuna
source: Sold by Celestine of the Harvest in Dragon Isles (current Dreamsurge zone - rotates). Cost: 1000
description: You can purchase this dark ohuna mount from Celestine of the Harvest, who appears in whichever Dragon Isles zone is currently undergoing a Dreamsurge event. Your Dragon Isles continent map displays a blue-green icon over the current Dreamsurge zone. Hovering your mouse over the same icon on the zone map will reveal Celestine's location in the zone.The currency required for this mount - Dreamsurge Coalescence - can be collected from defeating various Dreamsurge event NPCs and empowered rare NPCs, as well as by flying your mount through small, green, floating orbs that appear in random places around the Dreamsurge zone (usually in higher up locations).

name: Zenet Hatchling
description: This mount can be hatched from a Zenet Egg, which drops from Zenet Avis - a rare NPC that spawns above a small rock peak just west of Teerakai in the Ohn'ahran Plains. Coordinates are 31.5, 64.0. You must keep the egg for 7 days before it hatches.

name: Temperamental Skyclaw
source: Zon'Wogi in Three-Falls Lookout, The Azure Span.
description: As Zon'Wogi at Three-Falls Lookout in The Azure Span explains, he'll give you this mount if you bring him 20 of each of the "treats from da gnoll tribes that not be fallen to decay". The three food items are:Tuskarr Jerky: drops from gnolls around Darktooth Pond (approximately 35.0, 45.0). Possibly also some other camps.Flash Frozen Meat: drops from Snowhide Camp gnolls (around 59.0, 44.0).Gnolan's House Special: drops from gnolls inside, or just outside at the entrance of, a gnoll "inn" in a hollow tree around 23.0, 43.3 at Brackenhide Waterhole (south of the pond), but seemingly not the rest of Waterhole area.

name: Frostbrood Proto-Wyrm
description: This undead proto-drake was awarded to players in retail WoW after completing the Death Knight starting quest chain in Wrath of the Lich King Classic. It was no longer obtainable after Dragonflight launched.

name: Hailstorm Armoredon
source: Sold by Lindormi <Mythic Keystones>Cost: 1
description: The Timelost Saddle required to purchase this mount is awarded to players after earning the current season's 'Keystone Myth' achievement, from obtaining a Mythic+ rating of 3400. It can be used to buy an achievement mount from any of the previous Mythic+ seasons, plus several previously-unused colour variants of these mounts. These are sold by Lindormi in the current expansion hub / capital. Currently, just one Saddle can be earned per season.This mount was originally a Keystone Master achievement reward for Dragonflight Season One.

name: Crimson Vorquin
source: Treysh in The Forbidden Reach. Requires Dracthyr character. Tethalash in Valdrakken. Requires Dracthyr character. Cost: 40
description: These Dragon Isles windsteeds are the favoured mounts of the Dracthyr playable race. They can be purchased by Dracthyr players in either The Forbidden Reach (the Dracthyr starting zone) or in Valdrakken.Unlike other racial mounts, there's currently no Dracthyr-related reputation faction, so these mounts can never be purchased by players of other races.

source: Treysh in The Forbidden Reach. Requires Dracthyr character. Tethalash in Valdrakken. Requires Dracthyr character. Cost: 40

They can be purchased by Dracthyr players in either The Forbidden Reach (the Dracthyr starting zone) or in Valdrakken.Unlike other racial mounts, there's currently no Dracthyr-related reputation faction, so these mounts can never be purchased by players of other races.

They can be purchased by Dracthyr players in either The Forbidden Reach (the Dracthyr starting zone) or in Valdrakken.Unlike other racial mounts, there's currently no Dracthyr-related reputation faction, so these mounts can never be purchased by players of other races.

source: Treysh in The Forbidden Reach. Requires Dracthyr character. Tethalash in Valdrakken. Requires Dracthyr character. Cost: 40
description: These Dragon Isles windsteeds are the favoured mounts of the Dracthyr playable race. They can be purchased by Dracthyr players in either The Forbidden Reach (the Dracthyr starting zone) or in Valdrakken.Unlike other racial mounts, there's currently no Dracthyr-related reputation faction, so these mounts can never be purchased by players of other races.

name: Vicious Sabertooth
source: Necrolord Sipe in Stormwind City. Cost: 1
description: This primal sabertooth was the Alliance reward for Dragonflight rated PvP match season 1.

name: Vicious Sabertooth
source: Deathguard Netharian in Orgrimmar. Cost: 1
description: This primal sabertooth was the Horde reward for Dragonflight rated PvP match season 1.

name: Wondrous Wavewhisker
source: Battle.net Shop (US/EU)
description: This enchanting carp mount can also fly! Available from Battle.net Shop, it was originally part of a subscription promotion.

name: Rocket Shredder 9001
source: Recruit A Friend reward
description: This mech-suit is a reward from the updated Recruit-a-Friend program, added in Patch 10.0.7. You will receive this reward after your recruits subscribe for a combined total of 6 months. Note that if you recruit one player who subscribes for 6 months you'll only receive this mount once the final month has been reached, but if you recruit six players who subscribe for 1 month each you should receive your mount immediately (this is how it worked prior to 10.0.7 and is likely to remain the case). See Blizzard's official announcement for more details.

name: Gleaming Moonbeast
source: Battle.net Shop (US/EU)
description: This beautifully detailed purple moonbeast was part of a 12-month subscription promotion for World of Warcraft. Until 08 January 2024, if you purchased a 12-month subscription, or were already on a recurring 12-month subscription, you received a gift package that included this moonbeast.Perhaps it'll return as a regular Battle.net Shop purchase in the future.

name: Black-Furred Bakar
source: Sold by Xydan in Valdrakken. Cost: 5000
description: This handsome bakar can be only purchased during Dragonflight Timewalking events, added in Patch 12.0.7. Purchase requires Timewarped Badges, which are earned by running Timewalking Dungeons during the events, with a bonus 500 by handing in a quest item which drops at the end of your first dungeon for the event.

name: Inferno Armoredon
source: Sold by Lindormi <Mythic Keystones>Cost: 1
description: The Timelost Saddle required to purchase this mount is awarded to players after earning the current season's 'Keystone Myth' achievement, from obtaining a Mythic+ rating of 3400. It can be used to buy an achievement mount from any of the previous Mythic+ seasons, plus several previously-unused colour variants of these mounts. These are sold by Lindormi in the current expansion hub / capital. Currently, just one Saddle can be earned per season.This mount was originally a Keystone Master achievement reward for Dragonflight Season Two.

name: Tarecgosa's Visage
description: This gorgeous drake mount allows you to take the form of the eminent blue dragon, Tarecgosa, tragically now deceased. To obtain this mount you must first already own the legendary staff, Dragonwrath, Tarecgosa's Rest, which can be obtained through a quest chain that begins in the Firelands, and is only available to classes who can wield staves (shaman, mages, priests, warlocks, druids, evokers). Once you own the staff, you must then complete the epic new Blue Dragonflight storyline, added to the Dragon Isles in Patch 10.1. The quest chain begins with Kalecgos asking to meet you at the Veiled Ossuary. If you own the Dragonwrath staff, Kalecgos will offer you an extra series of quests at the end of the main story, which culminates in you receiving this mount.Currently, it appears you can only use this mount on characters that own the staff.

name: Big Slick in the City
description: Obtaining this mount can take a few weeks of daily effort (less with reputation buffs). To begin, speak to Briggul <Snail Trainer>; in Glimmerogg and pick up the introductory quest, Come Snail Away. As you complete the quests offered each day, your reputation with the faction Glimmerogg Racer will increase. When you reach maximum reputation ('Professional'), Briggul  will offer you the mount.See this Youtube video for a much more detailed explanation.

name: Igneous Shalewing
source: Sold by Saccratros in Loamm, Zaralek Cavern. Cost: 400
description: You require 400 Coveted Baubles to purchase this fiery orange shalewing. These can be obtained from Spinsoa (standing right next to Saccratros) for one Coveted Bauble per Unearthed Fragrant Coin. The latter can be obtained from various world quests and events in Zaralek Cavern.

name: Cobalt Shalewing
description: This fiery blue shalewing has a small chance of dropping from Karokta in the south-west of Zaralek Cavern. A rare icon will appear on your map when it's up.

name: Calescent Shalewing
source: Achievement: Que Zara(lek), Zara(lek).
description: This fiery, gold shalewing is awarded automatically when you complete the achievement, Que Zara(lek), Zara(lek), which is the meta-achievement for the Zaralek Cavern zone. See the link for more information.

name: Shadowflame Shalewing
source: Achievement: Glory of the Aberrus Raider.
description: This fiery red shalewing is the meta-achievement reward for the "Aberrus, the Shadowed Crucible" raid in Zaralek Cavern.

name: Cataloged Shalewing
description: There's a small chance of finding this mount in your reward chest for the Researchers Under Fire event in the centre of Zaralek Cavern. A marker will appear on your main map when the event is close to starting. There are four tiers of reward chest, depending on how many tasks you perform during Phase 1 of the event, but we're currently unsure which of the chests can drop the mount.This event occurs hourly, but is marked as a weekly event, which probably means you can only receive rewards once per week. We're unsure if that means one reward chest total per week, or if you can repeat the event until you receive one of each tier of reward chest.

name: Boulder Hauler
source: Ponzo in Loamm, Zaralek Cavern. Requires Renown Rank 3 with Loamm Niffen. Cost: 170 or 85
description: You only require renown 3 with Loamm Niffen on one character to unlock the ability to obtain the currency required to purchase this mount. Barter Bricks and Barter Boulders are special currency items  that have a chance of being awarded from Zaralek Cavern / Niffen-related activities.  Once you reach renown 12, Barter Boulders replace Barter Bricks (for no apparent reason) as the activity reward and valid currency. At that point you can exchange your remaining Bricks for Boulders at Ponzo, at a bad exchange rate. At renown 20 Harlowe Marl will sell you Barter Boulders for 100 Dragon Isles Supplies.

name: Sandy Shalewing
source: All Timewalking vendors. Cost: 5000
description: The Sandy Shalewing can be purchased from any Timewalking vendor for 5000 Timewarped Badges.It was originally the reward for the Master of the Turbulent Timeways achievement, a part of the first Turbulent Timeways event.

name: Morsel Sniffer
source: Harlowe Marl in Loamm, Zaralek Cavern. Requires Renown Rank 18 with Loamm Niffen. Cost: 800
description: The vendor that sells this mount, Harlowe Marl, is the Loamm Niffen Quartermaster and can be found in the large central building in Loamm.

name: Obsidian Gladiator's Slitherdrake
description: This mount is the reward for Dragonflight PvP Arena Season 2.Recipients also receive the glyph, Winding Slitherdrake: Embodiment of the Obsidian Gladiator so they can add its appearance to the customization options for their Winding Slitherdrake mount.

name: Vicious War Snail
source: Necrolord Sipe in Stormwind City. Cost: 1
description: This fiery snail was the Alliance reward for Dragonflight rated PvP match season 2.

name: Vicious War Snail
source: Deathguard Netharian in Orgrimmar. Cost: 1
description: This fiery snail was the Horde reward for Dragonflight rated PvP match season 2.

name: Felcrystal Scorpion
source: The Trading Post (seasonal)Cost: 500
description: This green crystal scorpion has returned to the Trading Post for the month of September, 2026. Visit the Trading Post in your faction's capital city for more information.The Trader's Tender used to purchase this mount can be earned through a wide range of in-game activities listed in the "Traveler's Log" tab of your Adventure Guide. You also receive a bonus 500 Tender a month just by visiting the Trading Post and opening the chest.

name: Grotto Netherwing Drake
description: This dragonriding version of a nether drake is awarded from the quest, Dragon Keeping, which is the final quest in a chain to recruit both Netherwing and Storm Drake flights to the Dragon Isles. The chain begins with A Dragon in Hand is Worth Two in the Roost, offered by Wrathion at Central Camp in the Emerald Dream.This mount can be customised at any Rostrum of Transformation, with various extra appearances obtainable from Dragonflight content. See Wowhead's Grotto Netherwing Drake Customization Guide for more information.Prior to 10.2, this mount was also the Trading Post bonus reward for the month of July, 2023.

name: Scarlet Pterrordax
source: Beast Handler Kalatak in Dazar'alor.
description: This brilliant red pterrordax is the Horde reward from the quest Time to Fly in Patch 10.1.5. This quest is automatically bestowed upon new players when they reach level 30 and can finally use a flying mount. However, you don't need to level a fresh level 30 in order to receive it: if you don't have the mount then the quest will be autobestowed on an existing high-level Horde character as soon as they enter Dazar'alor.The Alliance equivalent mount is the Harbor Gryphon. These two mounts aren't bundled, so you have to claim them separately.

name: Harbor Gryphon
source: Leila Stafford in Tradewinds Market, Boralus.
description: This grand gryphon is the Alliance reward from the quest Time to Fly in Patch 10.1.5. This quest is automatically bestowed upon new players when they reach level 30 and can finally use a flying mount. However, you don't need to level a fresh level 30 in order to receive it: if you don't have the mount then the quest will be autobestowed on an existing high-level Alliance character as soon as they enter Boralus.The Horde equivalent mount is the Scarlet Pterrordax. These two mounts aren't bundled, so you have to claim them separately.

name: Valiance
source: Dropped by Valiance in Naxxramas.
description: This previously unused colour variant of the Forsaken racial mount drops from an NPC of the same name in Naxxramas.

name: White War Wolf
source: Looted from Time Rift Bosses in Tyrhold Reservoir, Thaldraszus. / Sold by Warden Krizzik in Tyrhold Reservoir, Thaldraszus. Cost: 3000 / Gifted from a Horde player using item dropped by Time Rift Bosses in Tyrhold Reservoir, Thaldraszus.
description: There are three ways of obtaining this mount, depending on which faction you're playing. Both are linked to the the hourly Time Rift events in Thaldraszus.Horde players can purchase this mount with Paracausal Flakes, which are earned by running the Time Rift events. It can also be obtained by Horde players as chance loot from Time Rift bosses. name: Mimiron's Jumpjets
description:
This mount was introduced during the Secrets of Azeroth event in 2023, but it can still be created even after that event has ended. To assemble Mimiron's Jumpjets, you need to collect three booster items that are located around Azeroth. Two of the three require multiple people to obtain.
The First Booster Part drops from a specially summoned rare NPC in the middle of Jaguero Isle in the Cape of Stranglethorn (59.4, 79.0). Look for a place with three large bowls on the ground. The rare is named Enigma Ward and it can only be spawned by 3 players with a Torch of Pyrreth toy. Other players can loot the component.
The Second Booster Part can be looted after a special event involving the Enigmamental in northern Felwood, at 50.0, 26.3, and requires 4 players. One player should click on the translucent yellow "Engine" item beneath the Enigmamental, activating it. The Enigmamental will then "absorb" the player (non-lethally). After it has absorbed a further 3 players (4 total), it will drop the Booster object from which anyone can loot the Second Booster Part.

The Third Booster Part requires no helpers. Simply go to the steps on the Dark Portal in the Blasted Lands, at 54.8, 52.2, where you'll see a "Mimiron's Booster Part" that you can loot. However, you can't loot it while in combat, and the periodically spawning hostile NPCs will interrupt you. The easiest way to loot it is simply to ride a flying mount and hover close enough to loot the item without attracting any aggro.
After you've gathered your three components, you can fuse them to create the mount at the Empowered Arcane Forge in Valdrakken (36.4, 62.2). After the Secrets of Azeroth is over, the forge permanently empowered, but while it's running it must be empowered via special 15-minute events every 4 hours (look for a blue forge icon on your Valdrakken map and mouse over it to see the time until the next event). These events involve carrying Power Source items back to the forge and require a community effort. See this Wowhead guide for more information.

source: Elianna in Central Encampment, Emerald Dream. Cost: 1
description:
This ottuk is one of six transparent, green "Emerald" mounts that are purchasable from Elianna in the Emerald Dream. To obtain this mount, you must:


Reach renown rank 5 with the Dream Wardens.
Speak to Elianna in the Central Encampment and complete the quest Emerald Reawakening. This unlocks an account-wide ability to obtain Dream Infusions.
You can acquire Dream Infusions by accumulating Dream Energy through various activities around the Dream, until you fill a progress bar. Speak to Elianna to check your Dream Energy progress bar.
Once your Dream Energy progress bar has reached 100%, you can obtain a Dream Infusion from Elianna, which you can use to purchase the green mounts and pets.
However! There's one extra restriction: you must already own a mount that has the same model as the green one you're purchasing, just in a different colour. See the "Other Mounts Using the Same Model" section on this page for a list of mounts that should work (they're currently untested).

description: This teal flying carpet with a pink duckie passenger has a low chance to be contained in a Loot-Filled Basket, which is awarded from a daily quest that starts by killing the Noblegarden festival boss Daetan Swiftplume / Daetan Swiftplume in Elwynn Forest or Durotar, respectively. Look for the 4-pointed star on the zone map for the location. You can do this once per character per day. There's also a quest chain leading up to the boss, but it isn't necessary to repeat that part on multiple characters for them to be eligible for loot.Noblegarden occurs around Easter - roughly March to April each year. Check your in-game calendar for the precise dates.

source: Plunderstore. Cost: 5000
description: When Plunderstorm is active, this mount is purchasable from the 'Plunderstore', using currency earned during the event.Plunderstorm is an occasional 'battle royale' style feature is hosted on a different server and uses different characters and abilities to regular World of Warcraft - in fact, it's pretty much a different game that happens to use WoW assets, but the rewards are available in the regular game. See Wowhead's Guide for more information.

name: Voyaging Wilderling
source: Achievement: Awakening the Dragonflight Raids.
description: This wilderling is the reward for completing all three Dragonflight raids (Vault of the Incarnates, Aberrus, and Amirdrassil) while they have the 'Awakened' affix, on Normal difficulty or higher. 'Awakened' is a special raid feature for Dragonflight Season 4 in which every week one of the three raids will become Awakened, and have a higher degree of difficulty (and better gear) for that week.It is likely this mount will no longer be obtainable once The War Within launches.Note: the stretched-out teeth seem to be a graphical bug with the model and hopefully they'll be fixed.

name: Zovaal's Soul Eater
source: Achievement: Back from the Beyond.
description: This soul eater is the reward for completing the achievement, Back from the Beyond, which is a meta-achievement for quests and activities in the Shadowlands. Note that this mount was added during Dragonflight - long after Shadowlands - and a new version of the achievement created, since the original achievement was retired as a Feat of Strength at the end of the Shadowlands expansion. Players with the original Feat of Strength were awarded this mount automatically when it was added, but everyone else is able to earn it via the new achievement.

description: This mount could be obtained by Alliance players while The War Within pre-expansion event was underway. The Horde equivalent is the Remembered Wind Rider.

name: Astral Emperor's Serpent
source: Achievement: Vale of Eternal Blossoms.
description: This celestial serpent was awarded by a meta-achievement for completing two of four specific achievements during 'Pandaria: Remix Timerunning' in Patch 10.2.7. The achievements relate to: completing Looking for Group Dungeons, defeating rare foes in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms, and reaching Exalted status with August Celestials or Golden Lotus. We're hoping the event will return some day but there haven't been any announcements, yet.

name: Delver's Dirigible
description: You can earn this configurable air ship by completing the quest Bountiful Delves.The mount image depicted on this page is the most basic, barebones version of the Delver's Dirigible. Like the Dragonriding mounts of Dragonflight, this mount can be modified and upgraded at a Rostrum of Transformation. You can learn the multitude of modifications from Delver's Dirigible Schematics, which can be earned mostly through Delves in The War Within. See Wowhead's Delves Rewards Guide for more information.

The bundle included this mount and a bunch of 'Black Tropical' transmog with a beach / swimwear theme.Hopefully the pack will return in the future, or the mount will be offered on the Trading Post.

name: Crowd Pummeler 2-30
description: This mount can be crafted through Khaz Algar Engineering in The War Within. Learning the recipe is a little complicated and can take time and some luck with the expansion's Pilfering and Inventing system. Gathering the required parts will also require around 3.1 million gold if buy them from a vendor, or many hours Pilfering through Engineering parts to hopefully obtain components and save some gold. See Wowhead's Crowd Pummeler 2-30 Engineering Guide for in-depth information, as the procedure is too complicated to detail here.

You need to reach Conspirator (rank 8) renown with The Weaver (and perform some follow-up quests)  in order to purchase this mount. Once you have 10 you can combine them into a Storm Vessel which can be used on her to break her shield and defeat her.

name: Beledar's Spawn

description: This purple-tinted shadow elemental has a chance of dropping from the rare spawn NPC, Beledar's Spawn in Hallowfall. The event lasts for 30 minutes before the crystal becomes light again.Beledar's Spawn has many possible spawn points in the zone, but the item Beledar's Attunement can allow you to see on your map the location at which it appears. This item can be purchased from from Auralia Steelstrike in Mereldar once you reach Renown Rank 23 with Hallowfall Arathi.

name: Blackrock Warsaber
description:
This mount is a reward from the Warcraft 30th Anniversary Direct event, from 13 November, 10:00 am PST, until 11 December, 10:00 am PST. You can earn it by watching Warcraft 30th Anniversary Direct content on participating Twitch or TikTok channels (note: apparently not YouTube, although it was originally advertised).
The requirements for receiving the rewards vary between media:
For Twitch you must link your social media account to your Battle.net account and then watch at least 20 minutes of participating content.
For TikTok you must watch at least 3 minutes of participating content and receive a code that you can redeem in your Battle.net account page.
For full details of what's required, see Warcraft 30th Anniversary Direct page.
.

name: Wick
description: This brown mole drops from The Darkness in Darkflame Cleft on Mythic / Mythic+ difficulty only.

name: Ol' Mole Rufus
description:
This dark brown mole can drop from the Lurker of the Deeps, an elite rare encounter in The Ringing Deeps. This rare requires a coordinated group to summon, which can be quite difficult to assemble as interest in the expansion wanes.To spawn the Lurker, your group must pull 5 levers located around The Ringing Deeps within 10 seconds of each other. The levers are located at roughly:

49.5 8.8
53.9 25.3
57.6 23.6
59.1 92.4
62.8 44.6

Upon pulling the levers, a zone-wide message occurs and the Lurker should spawn in a lake in the far south of The Ringing Deeps, around 60.8 76.7.

description: This teal skyrazor can be purchased during the Midnight pre-expansion 'Twilight Ascension' event in the Twilight Highlands. The Twilight's Blade Insignias used to purchase this mount may be obtained by participating in event quests and activities, including defeating rare spawns. Materialist Ophinell can be found at Ascension Basecamp in the far south of the zone. See Icy Veins' Twilight Ascension Guide for more information.

name: Siesbarg
description: This mount is the reward from a quest chain in Azj-Kahet that starts by killing and looting the rare NPC, Tka'ktath who spawns around 60, 62 in that zone. Tka'ktath drops Vial of Tka'ktath's Blood which starts the first quest and sets you on your way. Some of the core quests in this chain are gated to one per day. Quests will require you to collect 1500 Nerubian Chitin, 1000 Nerubian Venom, and 500 Nerubian Blood, respectively, so it's a good idea to start the chain early if you can, so you can farm these items alongside your normal daily activities.

name: Ascendant Skyrazor
source: Dropped by Queen Ansurek in Nerub-ar Palace (Mythic).
description: This abominable creature drops from Queen Ansurek in the Nerub-ar Palace raid on Mythic difficulty only. It is a guaranteed drop while the raid is current and after that she should continue to drop 3 per kill until The War Within ends.

name: Frayfeather Hippogryph
source: Bobadormu in 20th Anniversary Event, Tanaris. Cost: 5000
description: This classic blue hippogryph is available from a special Timewalking vendor during WoW's 20th Anniversary celebrations. Although still unclear, it is possible that this vendor will become a regular part of Classic Timewalking and therefore the items he sells may be available after the anniversary has ended.

name: Amani Hunting Bear
source: Cupri in Shattrath. Cost: 5000
description: This Amani bear was added to the Burning Crusade Timewalking vendor in Patch 11.0.5 as part of a refresh to Timewalking rewards.

name: Ivory Goliathus
source: Achievement: Glory of the War Within Delver.
description: This large, tan beetle is awarded for completing Glory of the War Within Delver which is a meta-achievement for activities in Delve instances in The War Within.

name: Savage Ebony Battle Turtle
description: This turtle is a reward from the Steelseries gaming gear promotion for World of Warcraft's 20th Anniversary. Purchase specific items from the Steelseries World of Warcraft 20th Anniversary Collection and you'll receive a code that can be redeemed for the Savage Ebony Battle Turtle. See the Steelseries 20th Anniversary Celebration page for more information. Not all items in the collection award this mount, so check individual gear pages before purchasing to see which in-game item they award.

name: Earthen Ordinant's Ramolith
description: This spectacular armoured stone ram is the class mount for Earthen paladins. This allied race must be unlocked before you can create an Earthen character and the unlocking requires completing The War Within campaign quests, as well as some other quests in Khaz Algar. Wowhead has a useful Earthen Allied Race Guide that explains it in detail.

name: Startouched Furline
source: Battle.net Shop (US/EU)
description: This stellar feline was part of a limited-time 12-month subscription promotion in 2024. Hopefully it'll be added to the Battle.net Shop as a standalone purchase in the future.

name: Grizzly Hills Packmaster
source: Battle.net Shop (US/EU)
description: Unlike a number of other mounts that offer utility services, the Grizzly Hills Packmaster doesn't carry any NPCs.

description: The Timelost Saddle required to purchase this mount is awarded to players after earning the current season's 'Keystone Myth' achievement, from obtaining a Mythic+ rating of 3400. These are sold by Lindormi in the current expansion hub / capital. You can learn customizations from Delver's Gob-Trotter Schematics, which can be purchased from Reno Jackson in Dornogal. See Wowhead's Delves Season 2 Guide for more information.

name: Thrayir, Eyes of the Siren
description:
This stormy, night-blue crow has existed in the database since early in Patch 5.4, but was only finally added 6 expansions later - in Patch 11.0.7!It can be earned by finding 5 unique Runekeys around the Siren Isle and returning them to the Forgotten Vault, where Thrayir's body lies (inert). Most of the Runekeys can only be obtained while you're in the Special Assignment / Storm phase of the zone, which you can access by first completing the zone's weekly quest, Serpent's Wrath and then talking to Suzie Boltwrench in the main quest hub.The Runekeys can be obtained around the Siren Isle in the following ways:

Cyclonic Runekey: can be fished on the coast just south of Zek'ul the Shipbreaker in the Special Assignment / Storm phase (around 32.0, 78.0). It may take quite a few casts.
Thunderous Runekey: can be assembled from 5 Thunderous Fragments. These can be obtained (randomly) from treasures and chests around the isle (probably only the Storm phase now).
Torrential Runekey: can be assembled from 7 Torrential Fragments. These have a low chance of dropping from any NPC in the Special Assignment / Storm phase.
Turbulent Runekey: can be assembled from 3 unique Turbulent Fragments. which are all found in the Special Assignment / Storm phase. These can be obtained: (i) a dirt pile in the garden of an old inn, around 38.2, 51.8, by a ghost;  (ii) a small crystal by a ghost inside the Rotting Hole cave in the south-east, around 67.1, 78.4; a small crystal in the hands of a ghost in the Spirit-Scarred Cave, around 52.4, 38.6.
Whirling Runekey: drops from Ksvir the Forgotten inside the Forgotten Vault in the Special Assignment / Storm phase (Deadfin Mire - around 33.2, 73.6).
Once you've obtained all the Runekeys, head to the Forgotten Vault (entrance around 38.2, 51.8) and interact with Thrayir's body to revive it.

name: Prismatic Snapdragon
description:
You can earn this mount through a multi-day quest chain in which you gain the trust of a Starving Snapdragon Runt - found near Zexel Fingersnap at the main quest hub of the Siren Isle. Interact with it to pick up the first quest, A Lifeline. Each day after that you'll be offered a new quest. If you miss a day you can just pick up where you left off, but you can still only complete one quest a day.You can change your mount's colour by feeding it special treats! These are sold by Zexel Fingersnap, but only after you first unlock them by finding them around the Isle. There are eight and you can only obtain them after unlocking the mount:

Teal: You receive this one when you first receive your mount.
Crimson: Has a low chance of dropping from various 'Bilge Rats'-associated NPCs on weeks when Pirate invasions are active.
Inky: Awarded by Gazix Fusegrease, who wanders around the base camp. Talk to him and follow a dialogue by selecting 'I am the Trashmaster!'. For this option to be available you may need either the 'Trashmaster' title or to have obtained Trashmaster's Mantle from Operation: Mechagon some time in the past. But first just give him a try and see if it works!
Kaja'Cola-Braised: Obtained from Blinky Greasefingers at the base camp. Ignore his vendor window, instead follow his dialogue options until you receive the treat.
Muddy: Has a low chance of dropping from various Vrykul NPCs outside the Forgotten Vault in the north-west of the Isle. Can also drop from other Vrykul NPCs that appear around the Isle on weeks when Vrykul invasions are active.
Royal: Has a low chance of dropping from various Naga NPCs on weeks when Naga invasions are active.
Sandy: Can be looted from Seafarer's Caches which are found in the sea surrounding the Isle.
Storminfused: Has a low chance of dropping from various crabs in the Storm phase of the Isle.

description:
This flying purple panther can be crafted by players with the jewelcrafting skill. The recipe, Design: Void-Crystal Panther drops only for jewelcrafters, but is guaranteed loot from Big Keech in the Revisited Horrific Vision of Orgrimmar (added in Patch 11.1.5). For him to appear, you have to have at least one mask active; he'll then appear in a hut on the eastern side of the Valley of Honor (which is the easternmost area of the Vision) around 72.4, 34.8.
The recipe requires several components that can also be obtained within Revisited Visions. These components can be obtained by players without the jewelcrafting profession and they can then have a Void-Crystal Panther crafted by work order.
You must have at least one mask active before you can obtain any of these items:

1 Void-Bound Orb of Mystery is a guaranteed unique drop (you won't see it if you already have one) from Big Keech in the Valley of Honor (Orgrimmar Vision,  around 72.4, 34.8) with at least one mask active. You must obtain this item first, before you can see/loot any of the other components.
20 Shadow Infused Onyx can be obtained from your end reward chests with at least one mask active. You must already have a Void-Bound Orb of Mystery (above) before they will appear.
4 Black Blood Infused Bars can be obtained from a lootable object (one per run) at the altar in the Valley of Wisdom (Orgrimmar Vision, around 45.2, 52.7) with at least one mask active. You must already have a Void-Bound Orb of Mystery (above) before it will appear.
1 Unusual Gems can be obtained from Valeera's end chest, after completing the Old Town area (Stormwind Vision) with at least one mask active. You must already have a Void-Bound Orb of Mystery (above) before it will appear.

See Wowhead's Revisited Horrific Visions Guide for more information.

description: This mount can only be purchased during Legion Remix - a time-limited event held on specially-dedicated servers, using accelerated levelling and some changes to features. The 'Bronze' currency required for this mount can be earned in large amounts from various Remix activities.

name: Voidlight Surger
source: Midnight - Epic Collector's Edition.
description: This mount is essentially a combination of the Lightwing Dragonhawk and Voidwing Dragonhawk appearances and will switch between them as you ride. It is one of the rewards for purchasing Midnight - Epic Edition. Visit the Blizzard Shop for more information (US / EU). Unlike the Lightwing Dragonhawk, this appearance switching version isn't available in the Heroic Edition.

name: Unarmored Deathtusk Felboar
source: The Trading Post (seasonal)Cost: 325
description: This non-armoured version of the Deathtusk Felboar was last obtainable from the Trading Post during the month of July, 2025. It's currently on hiatus, but should return at a later (currently unknown) date.

name: Pearlescent Krolusk
source: Dropped by Urmag in K'aresh.
description: When available, Urmag can be found just north of Eco-Dome: Rhovan, but only when you're in the 'phase diving' phase. See Wowhead's phase diving guide for more information.

name: Translocated Gorger
source: Devoured Energy-Pods from Devourer Swarms in K'aresh.
description: To acquire this mount you must first obtain 20 Devoured Energy-Pods. These drop from the final bosses in Devourer Swarm events in K'aresh, but you can only earn a maximum of 4 a week. Each of the four swarm bosses will only drop one pod per week for your warband, so it'll take at least 5 weeks to create the mount. The Devourer Swarm events occur every half an hour, in a rotating location with the order: The Oasis; Eco-Dome Primus; The Atrium; Tazavesh.

name: Sthaarbs's Last Lunch
source: Dropped by Sthaarbs in The Oasis, K'aresh.
description: Sthaarbs appears to spawn every hour in The Oasis in K'aresh, but only when you're in the 'untethered space' phase. See Wowhead's phase diving guide for more information.

name: OC91 Chariot
source: Achievement: Titan Console Overcharged.
description: This mount is awarded for an achievement related to Overcharged Delves - a special 'challenge-mode' version of delves added in Patch 11.1.7. You need to earn enough Titan Discs to unlock all of the skills in the Overcharged Titan Console. See Wowhead's Overcharged Delves Guide for more information on this game system.

name: Inarius' Charger
description: This darker variant of Tyrael's Charger could be obtained from the second Greedy Emissaries event in July, 2025. During this event, portals that spawn Treasure Goblins appeared on the hour in Stormwind, Orgrimmar, and Dornogal, and also frequently when rares were killed in Undermine. They could drop a range of rewards, including this mount.Hopefully it will return in future Emissaries events.

name: Royal Voidwing
description: This royal void dragon is the reward for completing Heroic Manaforge Omega while the raid is current and will be no longer obtainable once The War Within ends. To earn this mount you must defeat Dimensius in Heroic mode or higher. You will receive a Mark of the Twilight Oath that begins the quest A Twilight Oath's End that rewards this mount. Note that the mount isn't tied to the Ahead of the Curve achievement for this raid, and the latter is ending sooner (with the pre-expansion patch rather than Midnight launch).

name: Ashes of Belo'ren
source: Midnight Falls encounter in March on Quel’Danas (Mythic).
description: This void-tainted phoenix drops from the 'Midnight Falls' encounter in the March on Quel’Danas raid on Mythic difficulty only. As with previous mythic raid mounts, it is likely to be a guaranteed drop while the raid is current and after that the encounter should continue to drop 3 per kill until Midnight ends. After the expansion has ended it will probably have a very low (~1%) drop rate.

name: Light-Forged Mechsuit
source: Achievement: Two Minutes to Midnight.
description: This citrine mechsuit is the reward for the achievement, Two Minutes to Midnight during the Midnight pre-expansion event. To complete this achievement you must defeat all of the special event bosses in the Twilight Highlands. See Icy Veins' Twilight Ascension Guide for more information.

name: Dusk Grimlynx
source: Awarded by History Lesson.
description: This mount is awarded by the quest, History Lesson which is part of the Legacy of the Amani storyline, added in Patch 12.0.7. The chain begins with the quest, Hagar's Invitation, offered by Orweyna at the Sanctum of Light in Silvermoon. You only need to complete a few short quests to earn the mount.

name: Fierce Grimlynx
source: Naynar in The Den, Harandar. Requires Renown Rank 16 with Hara'ti. Cost: 6000
description: You must reach Renown Rank 16 with the Hara'ti faction in Harandar in order to purchase this mount from Naynar. See Wowhead's Hara'ti Renown Guide for more information on this faction.The Voidlight Marls required to purchase this mount are an expansion-wide currency for Midnight, similar to Resonance Crystals in The War Within.

name: Rootstalker Grimlynx
source: Looted from Rare NPCs in Harandar.
description: There's a chance of obtaining this mount from the various rare NPCs found in Harandar.

name: Ivory Grimlynx
source: Achievement: Allied Race: Haranir.
description: This pale grimlynx can be earned by completing the Harandar campaign thereby unlocking the Haranir as an Allied Race.

name: Thunder-Ridged Elekk
description:
So far, this fel elekk has only been available in a limited Pringles promotion that was restricted to Germany and which rapidly turned into a fiasco. In the promotion, players were asked to scan QR codes in German cities, which led them to a website with a quiz. Completing the quiz could award the mount. But the number of mount codes were severely limited and multiple codes could be claimed per participant, resulting in the codes being depleted very quickly and widespread scalping of extras.
However, Blizzard has confirmed that each promotional mount will eventually be made obtainable from the Trading Post. Unfortunately, we can't say when this will be.

description: This fel elekk will be obtainable from the Trading Post in an upcoming month. Unfortunately we can't say exactly when, as Blizzard don't announce Trading Post offerings ahead of time.

description: This fel elekk is part of a limited-time 'Amethyst Felfire Pack' bundle in the Battle.net Shop. The pack also includes the "Felreaver's Arcane Attire" transmog set and Mustyfur Fel Snooter companion pet.

name: The Headless Horseman's Ghoulish Charger
source: Looted from Loot-Filled Pumpkin. Loot Pumpkin awarded by killing The Headless Horseman in Hallow’s End Instance. Only available during Hallow's End
description: Introduced in 2025, this demonic steed can only be obtained during Hallow’s End. This festival occurs during later October each year, but the precise dates change annually so check your in-game calendar. During the event period you can use the Dungeon Finder to access a special festival boss version of the Headless Horseman. The mount has a chance of dropping from the Loot-Filled Pumpkin you receive after defeating him, but only on your first attempt per account per day, and on a character of sufficient level to receive the epic version of the Pumpkin. Your chance of receiving the mount reportedly increases with each daily attempt.For cosmetic gear designed to match this mount, check out: Ensemble: The Horseman's Ghoulish Collection, The Horseman's Ghoulish Great Blade, The Horseman's Ghoulish Blade, and The Horseman's Ghoulish Bulwark.

name: Scarlet Void Flyer
source: Sold by Lindormi <Mythic Keystones>Cost: 1
description: The Timelost Saddle required to purchase this mount is awarded to players after earning the current season's 'Keystone Myth' achievement, from obtaining a Mythic+ rating of 3400. It can be used to buy an achievement mount from any of the previous Mythic+ seasons, plus several previously-unused colour variants of these mounts. These are sold by Lindormi in the current expansion hub / capital. Currently, just one Saddle can be earned per season.This mount was originally a Keystone Legend achievement reward for The War Within Season Three.

name: Astral Aurochs
source: Battle.net Shop (US/EU) / 12-month subscription promotion.
description: This celestial bovine is part of a limited-time 12-month subscription promotion in 2025. Players who sign up to a 12-month subscription, or are already on an existing 12-month recurring subscription with a future renewal date, will receive this mount and a bunch of other rewards, including the Grandiose Grrloc, the Herald of Sa'bak (also available with 6-month subs), and the upcoming  2026 Lunar New Year 6-month Subscription bonuses (to be officially revealed, but they are horse-related). See Blizzard's news article for more details.Note that this information was valid at the time of writing (October 2025) but may change without notice and you should check Blizzard's official pages carefully before signing up to a subscription. Once the promotion period has ended it is likely - though not guaranteed - that this mount will become available as a standalone product in the Battle.net shop.

name: Azure Void Flyer
source: Sold by Lindormi <Mythic Keystones>Cost: 1
description: The Timelost Saddle required to purchase this mount is awarded to players after earning the current season's 'Keystone Myth' achievement, from obtaining a Mythic+ rating of 3400. These are sold by Lindormi in the current expansion hub / capital. Currently, just one Saddle can be earned per season.This mount was originally a Keystone Master achievement reward for The War Within Season Three.

name: Scorching Valor
source: Battle.net Shop (US/EU) / 6- or 12-month subscription promotion.
description: Celebrating the Year of the Fire Horse (2026), this fiery steed is part of a subscription promotion that coincides with Lunar New Year. If you're on a recurring 6- or 12-month subscription then this mount should appear in your collection automatically (initially at the top, as a wrapped gift). You can also purchase it as a stand-alone item from the Battle.net Shop.

name: Brewfest Bomber
source: Looted from Keg-Shaped Treasure Chest. Chest is dropped by Coren Direbrew in Blackrock Depths (Brewfest Instance). Only available during Brewfest
description: First added in 2025, this beer barrel-themed copter can only be obtained during Brewfest. This festival occurs during late September to early October of each year, but the precise dates change annually so check your in-game calendar. During the event period you can use the Dungeon Finder to access a special festival boss, Coren Direbrew. The mount has a chance of dropping from the Keg-Shaped Treasure Chest you receive after defeating him, but only on your first attempt per account per day.

source: Looted from Sporespawned Cache in Fungara Village, Harandar.
description: To obtain this mount, head to Fungara Village in the south of Harandar. Click on the Fungal Mallet leaning against an orange door at 41.3, 68.0 (this is in a rocky alcove - if you're at those coordinates but standing on an open rock shelf you need to head a bit east then down). Clicking on the Fungal Mallet should give you a 5-minute buff with the same name. Then head to the east side of the village and look for a Mycelium Gong underneath a small pavilion with a red fungal roof, around 46.6, 67.8.
