name: Echo of Aln'sharan
description: After completing To Sow the Seed in the main Harandar quest chain, a side-quest chain will open up, beginning with Tales of the Sky and ending with The Legend of Aln'sharan.After completing this chain you can now loot Mysterious Skyshards from NPCs in Harandar (including Harandar delves). These have a low drop rate and you have to collect 500 of them! When you're done return to Kuri and use the extra action button to throw them into the water.Before the next step, (unless you're a druid) prepare some kind of slow fall, or have something suitable ready in your bags as the next interaction requires you to dismount in mid-air. It's also useful to switch to steady flying before the next step.When you're ready, go find Aln'sharan, the translucent blue cloud serpent who flies about the edge of the zone, but be careful: the hostile winds around the periphery can cause you a lot of damage, so you need to be quick! Fly right up to him and dismount and quickly interact with him to receive his mount item.

name: Ancestral War Bear
source: Looted from Honored Warrior's Cache in Solemn Valley, Zul'Aman (Midnight).
description:
This mount can be looted from the Honored Warrior's Cache, found in a cavern under a tree - entrance at 47.0, 82.3 in Solemn Valley below the mountain west of Temple of Akil'zon in Zul'Aman (Midnight).

First, you should visit and interact with the cache, but you won't be able to open it yet. Now you need to kill and loot four Echoes of the Past around the zone. You summon them by clicking on Honored Warrior's Urns at specific locations:

Nalorakk's Chosen - found at 32.7, 83.5 - on a rocky outcropping between waterfalls just east of Nalorakk's Prowl. Drops a Bear Tooth.
Akil'zon's Chosen - found at 51.6, 84.9 - on a ridge half way down the mountainside south of the Temple of Akil'zon. Drops an Eagle Feather.
Jan'alai's Chosen - found at 54.8, 22.4 - just south of the Temple of Jan'alai. Drops a Dragonhawk Feather.
Halazzi's Chosen - found at 34.5, 33.5 - above a lynx den, east of Temple of Halazzi. Drops a Lynx Claw.


These are level 90 NPCs and will be more difficult at lower levels.
With the four looted items in hand, return to the Honored Warrior's Cache and you should be able to loot the mount.

name: Witherbark Warbear Mother
source: Broken Throne special activity.
description:
This mount can easily be obtained from the 'Broken Throne' Ritual Site instance which is available every second week in Zul'Aman. Check for a purple instance marker in the south of the zone map.
First, obtain a Chubs minipet inside the instance. To do this, you'll find a Lost Bear Cub at 55.8, 49.7, behind a small tree on a terrace next to the north-eastern stairs. Interact with it and feed it one Practically Pork to obtain the pet item.
Learn and summon Chubs and head to 55.8, 39.3, which is in the north-east of the instance. It's marked by scattered raw meat or animal remains just to the east of the northern ritual buildings and terrace, and just west of an enormous tree. Approaching the meat will summon an Angry Amani Warbear. Subdue it in combat then interact with it and feed it 5 Practically Pork to receive the mount item.

Ritual Sites are small, scaling instances for 1-5 players, with optional challenge tiers, added in Patch 12.0.5.  See Wowhead's Ritual Sites Guide for more information.

name: Spawn of Vyranoth
source: Awarded by Master of the Turbulent Timeways V.
description:
This mount is awarded by completing Master of the Turbulent Timeways V, which is part of the fifth Turbulent Timeways event, added in Patch 12.0.7. Turbulent Timeways is a special Timewalking event in which five different sets of Timewalking dungeons are available over five or more consecutive weeks.Assuming it works like previous events, to obtain this mount:
Run four Timewalking dungeons on one character for each of four weeks (was previously five weeks) of the event. You can switch characters between weeks of the event.
Each Timewalking dungeon should award your character one stack of the experience buff Knowledge of Timeways. As this buff only lasts two hours you need to complete the next dungeon in less than two hours after completing the previous one.
Gaining four stacks of Knowledge of Timeways on one character will grant you the Mastery of Timeways buff. This is all you need to do for that week.
Repeat this each week, for four weeks of the event. You can complete the weekly requirement on different characters in different weeks (as the achievement is account-wide), but you must complete each weekly buff on a single character for that week.
After you gain Mastery of Timeways for each of the four weeks you'll complete the achievement and receive this mount!As with rewards from previous Turbulent Timeways events, it's likely this mount will become purchasable from any Timewalking vendor some time after the event concludes.

description: While this mount is classed as a raid drop, it's a tiny bit more complicated than that. You create it by combining four Delicious Sporesnacks, which are dropped by Rotmire in the Sporefall raid (reportedly on any difficulty). It's likely you'll only be eligible to receive one snack a week so it will probably take a minimum of four weeks.

name: Void-Corrupted Hex Eagle
source: Broken Throne special activity.
description:
This mount can be obtained from the 'Broken Throne' Ritual Site instance which is available every second week. Check for the purple instance marker in the south of the zone.Inside the instance, on tier 2 or higher, you can find a ritual circle at around 50.6, 47.3. The circle perimeter has four skulls, but one is missing its candle. Pick up the purplish 'Missing Ritual Candle' under a small tree just near the circle and restore it to the skull. Once the candle is restored, click on the small cluster of candles in the middle of the circle to summon a Void-Corrupted Hex Eagle which drops the mount upon defeat.

Ritual Sites are small, scaling instances for 1-5 players, with optional challenge tiers, added in Patch 12.0.5.  See Wowhead's Ritual Sites Guide for more information.

name: Void-Touched Snapdragon
description:
This mount can be obtained from the 'Daggerspine Point' Ritual Site instance which is only available every second week (check for the purple ritual site mark on the Eversong Woods zone map). Inside the instance you can find occasional piles of Washed Up Kelp. Interacting with these has a chance of spawning a Void-Touched Snapdragon which can drop the mount.
Ritual Sites are small, scaling instances for 1-5 players, with optional challenge tiers, added in Patch 12.0.5.  See Wowhead's Ritual Sites Guide for more information.

name: Void-Corrupted Lynx
description: This mount can be crafted by Leatherworkers in Patch 12.0.5. This is rather odd, since the player creates a harness, yet the mount is clearly not wearing one.The leatherworking recipe that teaches this skill is Pattern: Rope Lynx Harness which has a low chance of appearing in the final reward chest of Tier 5 (and up) Ritual Sites for players of any profession. The Broken Lynx Leash, which is a component of the recipe, also has a low chance of appearing in Ritual Site reward chests for players of any profession, but at any tier of difficulty.Ritual Sites are small, scaling instances for 1-5 players, with optional challenge tiers, added in Patch 12.0.5.  See Wowhead's Ritual Sites Guide for more information.

name: The Writhing Brood
source: Dropped by Zul'jan in Altar of Fangs (Dungeon).
description: There's a chance of looting this writhing serpent mount from Zul'jan in the Altar of Fangs dungeon. There's currently no mention of it being restricted to any difficulty level.

name: Indigo Coiled Horror
source: Sold by Jan'sari the Watchful in Tokka's Landing, The Coiled Isle. Requires Renown Rank 17 with Zul'jarra's Forces. Cost: 6000
description: You must reach Renown Rank 17 with Zul'jarra's Forces before you can purchase this mount. Renown is earned through various activities on the Coiled Isle.

name: Ruby Writhe
source: Looted from Rare NPCs on the Coiled Isle.
description: There's a chance of obtaining this mount from the various rare NPCs found on the Coiled Isle.

name: Venomous Coiler
source: Achievement: Assault the Vault.
description: This writhing serpent mount is the meta-achievement reward for completing various activities in the Vaults of Atal'Utek on the Coiled Isle.

name: Breath of Blight
source: Achievement: Midnight Keystone Master: Season Two.
description: This skeletal wind serpent is a reward for attaining a Mythic+ Rating of at least 2000 during Midnight Season 2.

name: Breath of Ruin
source: Achievement: Midnight Keystone Legend: Season Two.
description: This skeletal wind serpent is a reward for attaining a Mythic+ Rating of at least 3000 during Midnight Season 2.

name: Umbral Ashes
source: Achievement: Umbral Champion: Midnight Season 1.
description: This red phoenix is a reward for ending Midnight Mythic+ Season 1 with a Mythic+ Rating in the top 1% of all players in your region.

name: Whoofle Bramblewing
source: Battle.net Shop (US/EU)
description: This cute little owl is listed as an upcoming Battle.net Shop item but we don't yet know its release date.

name: Crested Ember Leafmimic
source: The Trading Post (seasonal)
description: This quirky, red chameleon is the Trading Post bonus reward for the month of September, 2026. You can obtain it simply by capping your Traveler's Log activities for the month. These can completed through a wide range of in-game activities listed in the "Traveler's Log" tab of your Adventure Guide.

name: Crested Aqua Leafmimic
source: The Trading Post (seasonal)Cost: 500
description:
This quirky chameleon makes its debut on the Trading Post during the month of September, 2026. Visit the Trading Post in your faction's capital city for more information.

The Trader's Tender used to purchase this mount can be earned through a wide range of in-game activities listed in the "Traveler's Log" tab of your Adventure Guide. You also receive a bonus 500 Tender a month just by visiting the Trading Post and opening the chest.

source: The Trading Post (seasonal)Cost: 500
description:
This quirky chameleon makes its debut on the Trading Post during the month of September, 2026. Visit the Trading Post in your faction's capital city for more information.

name: Crested Violet Leafmimic
source: The Trading Post (seasonal)
description: This quirky chameleon will be obtainable from the Trading Post in an upcoming month. Unfortunately, we can't say when exactly, as Blizzard don't announce Trading Post offerings ahead of time.

name: Wintry Witchwick's Rider
source: Battle.net Shop (US/EU)
description: This Hallow's End-themed broomstick is listed as an upcoming Battle.net Shop item but we don't yet know its release date. Perhaps around Hallow's End in October?
